question: For non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state whose display name is in the top 10 display names with the largest MEMORY_MB range among non-deleted instances, list the instance UUID, display name, power state, system metadata key and value, cached network_info JSON, and the per-key row number (ordered by instance UUID). Also show, per metadata key, the total rows and average power state (suppressing repeated metadata keys), along with the display name’s memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and whether it has any non-deleted instance_info_cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH shelved_metadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid ), top_memory_range_display_names AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC, sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid;

From the top 10 instance display names with the largest MEMORY_MB range (max minus min) among non-deleted instances, show the display name, the memory range, variance, and standard deviation, and indicate whether any instance with that display name has a non-deleted instance_info_cache record.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded';

SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, hostname, cached network_info JSON, and the running sum of instance IDs within its VM state (ordered by instance ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per VM state and the average of those per-state totals across VM states; also include the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory_mb for the "forge" display name (among non-deleted instances that have system metadata and where the display name has more than 5 such instances) and how far that standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) deviates from the overall average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts ), display_name_memory_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.NETWORK_INFO, f.window_column, f.total_forge_instances_in_state, f.avg_forge_instances_per_state, dms.memory_mb_stddev, dms.deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM forge_instances f JOIN display_name_memory_stddev dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.UUID;

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: List each instance display name that either (a) has total memory greater than 20000 MB among instances in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' with at least one system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' (including the overall average of these totals as a benchmark and a HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE memory category), or (b) has a memory (MB) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across its system-metadata-joined rows (only where it has more than 2 such rows) that is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such display names; include a “reason” column indicating which condition caused the display name to appear. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Only include display names whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB.
sql: WITH MemoryByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.total_memory_mb, am.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > am.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < am.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am), StddevOutliersByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), CombinedDisplayNames AS ( SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High Total Memory vs Benchmark' AS reason FROM MemoryByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS total_memory_mb, NULL AS benchmark, NULL AS memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, 'High Memory Stddev vs Average' AS reason FROM StddevOutliersByDisplayName ) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, reason FROM CombinedDisplayNames ORDER BY display_name, reason;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.total_memory_mb, am.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > am.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < am.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', for the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records, list each display name along with its cache record count, the overall average cache record count across these top-10 display names as a benchmark, its cache category (HIGH_CACHE/LOW_CACHE/AVERAGE_CACHE), and the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of non-deleted system metadata entry counts per non-deleted instance for that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_CACHE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_CACHE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_CACHE'.
sql: WITH CacheTop10 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), AverageCache AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_records > ac.avg_cache_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE' WHEN ic.cache_records < ac.avg_cache_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE' END AS cache_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageCache ac ), MetadataDispersion AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(meta_count_range) AS meta_count_range, AVG(meta_count_variance) AS meta_count_variance, AVG(meta_count_stddev) AS meta_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ) SELECT ct.display_name, ct.cache_records, ct.benchmark, ct.cache_category, md.meta_count_range, md.meta_count_variance, md.meta_count_stddev FROM CacheTop10 ct LEFT JOIN MetadataDispersion md ON md.display_name = ct.display_name ORDER BY ct.cache_records DESC, ct.display_name;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(meta_count_range) AS meta_count_range, AVG(meta_count_variance) AS meta_count_variance, AVG(meta_count_stddev) AS meta_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

question: For instances with display name "forge", give (1) the total count of instances whose memory-per-vCPU ratio is greater than 2048 MB per vCPU, (2) the total count of instances whose memory is greater than 75% of the maximum memory among these "forge" instances, and (3) the ratio of (1) to (2).
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, ie.flavor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY i.hostname ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.hostname, ic.flavor, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) AS memory_per_vcpu_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = ic.uuid WHERE (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) > 2048 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / (SELECT MAX(inner_cte2.memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) > 0.75 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Meeting_MemoryPerVcpu_Threshold, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Above_75pct_Max_Memory, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid), 0), 2 ) AS Ratio_MemoryPerVcpuQualified_To_Above75pctMaxMemory FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: How many (VM state, availability zone) groups have total memory (MB) across non-deleted instances that exceeds the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and how many instance display names are categorized as SLOWER_THAN_AVG based on days-to-launch for instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type'? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' (at least 50% slower than the benchmark), 'FASTER_THAN_AVG' (at least 50% faster than the benchmark), or 'ABOUT_AVG'.
sql: WITH mem_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) ), StateZoneTotals AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, i.availability_zone, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.vm_state = i.vm_state WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state, i.availability_zone ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateZoneTotals GROUP BY vm_state, availability_zone WITH ROLLUP ), launch_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_days_to_launch) AS benchmark_avg_days_to_launch FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_days_to_launch > b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch * 1.5 THEN 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' WHEN ic.avg_days_to_launch < b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch * 0.5 THEN 'FASTER_THAN_AVG' ELSE 'ABOUT_AVG' END AS speed_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ), slow_display_names AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS slower_than_avg_display_name_count FROM launch_stats WHERE speed_category = 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' ), high_mem_groups AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_memory_state_zone_group_count FROM mem_rollup WHERE availability_zone NOT IN ('SUBTOTAL') AND vm_state NOT IN ('GRAND TOTAL') ) SELECT hmg.high_memory_state_zone_group_count, sdn.slower_than_avg_display_name_count FROM high_mem_groups hmg CROSS JOIN slow_display_names sdn;

c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS ( SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, sql: WITH memory_stats_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC ), forge_metadata_windowed AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_stats_by_display_name) AS qualifying_display_name_count, (SELECT total_rows FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_total_rows, (SELECT avg_window_column question: Among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', find the display names whose average memory (MB) is greater than the overall average memory across such non-deleted instances, and for those display names report (by VM state and display name) the instance count, the minimum memory (MB), the deviation of that minimum memory from the overall average of per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories, plus the minimum instance ID and the average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, q2.min_instance_id, q2.avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For completed migrations (where the instance info cache row is not deleted) and for instances in availability zone “flare3” whose memory_mb is above the overall flare3 average, return the migration ID, source/destination compute, instance display name, the migration’s rank within the completed status group (ordered by migration ID), the instance’s memory (MB) and its deviation from the average memory of instances involved in completed migrations, along with the matching flare3 instance UUID, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ), InstanceMemory AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory ) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ORDER BY im.migration_id ), Flare3HighMemInstances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_display_name, cm.rank_within_status, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb, f.uuid AS flare3_instance_uuid, f.vm_state AS flare3_vm_state, f.memory_mb AS flare3_memory_mb, f.network_info AS flare3_network_info, f.window_column AS flare3_windowed_avg_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN Flare3HighMemInstances f ON f.display_name = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id, f.memory_mb;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is 'ether-60', list each migration’s ID, instance UUID, migration status, source and destination compute, instance display name, instance VM state, instance memory in MB (with row numbers within each migration status ordered by migration ID), the instance’s project ID, whether that project has any other active non-deleted migrations, and also (based on the instance VM state) the geometric mean of total memory migrated (MEMORY_TOTAL) across migrations for instances with non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO (only where MEMORY_TOTAL > 0), the overall geometric-mean benchmark across all VM states, and the VM state’s migration category (HIGH_MIGRATION/LOW_MIGRATION/AVERAGE_MIGRATION). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_MIGRATION' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MIGRATION' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION'.
sql: WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC ), benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC ), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id ) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total AS vm_state_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.benchmark AS vm_state_benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.migration_category AS vm_state_migration_category FROM confirmed_ether60_migrations AS cem LEFT JOIN vm_state_migration_stats AS vms ON cem.instance_vm_state = vms.vm_state ORDER BY cem.migration_status, cem.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations, show the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_TOTAL by availability zone and instance display name (including subtotals per availability zone and a grand total), and also return (as overall summary values) the total number of system-metadata rows and the average running-sum of instance IDs for instances whose display name is 'forge'. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ar.avg_memory_range_mb AS benchmark_memory_range_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_range_mb > ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_range_mb < ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.benchmark_memory_range_mb, q1.variability_category, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS variance_benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name;

sql: WITH ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)), Top10Flare3CacheStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC) SELECT t.display_name, s.total_memory_mb, t.cache_records, t.avg_cache_records, t.deviation_from_avg FROM Top10Flare3CacheStats t JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory s ON s.display_name = t.display_name WHERE s.total_memory_mb > 20000 ORDER BY s.total_memory_mb DESC, t.cache_records DESC;

sql: WITH PerStateDisplayNameMinMemory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ), PerStateMaxGeometricMeanMemory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT vm_state, MAX(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ORDER BY max_geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT psdn.VM_STATE, psdn.DISPLAY_NAME, psdn.instance_count, psdn.min_memory_mb, psdn.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, psgm.max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM PerStateDisplayNameMinMemory psdn JOIN PerStateMaxGeometricMeanMemory psgm ON psdn.VM_STATE = psgm.vm_state ORDER BY psdn.VM_STATE, psdn.DISPLAY_NAME;

sql: WITH stddev_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), min_memory_groups AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sbdn.DISPLAY_NAME) AS display_names_with_high_memory_stddev_count, COUNT(*) AS vm_state_display_name_groups_with_high_min_memory_count FROM stddev_by_display_name sbdn JOIN min_memory_groups mmg ON mmg.DISPLAY_NAME = sbdn.DISPLAY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each VM state and instance display name (considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs), show the instance count, the minimum memory (MB), and how far that minimum memory is from the overall average of per-group minimum memories, but only for display names whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of (instance info cache last-updated time minus instance created time, in days) is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all non-deleted instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH cov_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT display_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), min_mem_stats_by_state_and_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT m.VM_STATE, m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.instance_count, m.min_memory_mb, m.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, c.coefficient_of_variation FROM min_mem_stats_by_state_and_name AS m JOIN cov_by_display_name AS c ON c.display_name = m.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC, m.VM_STATE, m.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: Find non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state that also have a completed migration whose migration ID is greater than the average migration ID among all completed migrations. For those instances, show the instance UUID, display name, power state, system metadata key and value, cached network_info JSON, and the per-key row number (ordered by instance UUID); also include, per metadata key, the total number of rows for that key and the average power state across that key, and do not repeat the metadata key if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH shelved_metadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid ), high_completed_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_availability_zone, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.migration_id > (SELECT AVG(m2.ID * 1.0) FROM MIGRATIONS AS m2 WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed') ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id ), high_completed_migration_instances AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid FROM MIGRATIONS AS m WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND m.INSTANCE_UUID IN ( SELECT i.UUID FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) AND m.ID IN (SELECT migration_id FROM high_completed_migrations) ) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key FROM shelved_metadata AS sm WHERE sm.instance_uuid IN (SELECT instance_uuid FROM high_completed_migration_instances) ORDER BY sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid;

question: For all non-deleted instances whose VM state is one of the “high total memory” VM states (where the VM-state total memory across non-deleted instances exceeds the overall average instance memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), list each instance’s ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and info cache record ID, along with the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (by instance ID), the total non-deleted instances in that project, the average of those per-project totals across projects, and also the VM-state total memory and the (avg + stddev) threshold value. sql: WITH vm_state_memory_thresholds AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 )) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM instances AS i3 JOIN instance_extra AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats ), instance_project_window_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id ) SELECT ips.instance_id, ips.instance_uuid, ips.user_id, ips.project_id, ips.display_name, ips.vm_state, ips.memory_mb, ips.vcpus, ips.info_cache_id, ips.max_instance_id_next_2, ips.total_instances_in_project, ips.avg_instance_count, vst.total_memory_mb AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, vst.avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM instance_project_window_stats AS ips JOIN vm_state_memory_thresholds AS vst ON ips.vm_state = vst.vm_state ORDER BY ips.instance_id;

question: For instance display names that (a) have at least one system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and have a maximum instance memory greater than 16000 MB (reported per display name and launch time with rollup), and (b) also have an average of more than 10 non-deleted system-metadata entries per instance, show the display name, launch time, maximum memory (MB), and the metadata-count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) along with the average metadata-entry count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(launched_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(launched_at AS CHAR) END AS launched_at, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, launched_at WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(per_instance_counts.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS avg_counts ON inner_cte.display_name = avg_counts.display_name WHERE avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.launched_at, q1.max_memory_mb, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.avg_meta_entry_count FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name WHERE q1.display_name <> 'GRAND TOTAL' AND q1.launched_at <> 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY q1.display_name, q1.launched_at;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(per_instance_counts.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS avg_counts ON inner_cte.display_name = avg_counts.display_name WHERE avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For migrations whose related instance is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, list each migration status and migration type where the migration count is greater than the average migration count across all such (status, migration_type) groups, showing the migration count and the minimum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) for those migrations, along with the memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MEMORY_MB) for the “shelved_offloaded” VM state among instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.migration_type, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(m.memory_total) AS min_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY m.status, m.migration_type ), GroupAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.migration_count * 1.0) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.min_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.migration_count > (SELECT avg_migration_count FROM GroupAverages) ), VmStateMemoryDispersion AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, VARIANCE(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ) SELECT ms.status, ms.migration_type, ms.migration_count, ms.min_memory_total, vms.vm_state, vms.memory_mb_variance, vms.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN VmStateMemoryDispersion vms ON vms.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY ms.migration_count DESC, ms.status, ms.migration_type;

question: How many non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state have system metadata rows (joined to cached network_info), and how many non-deleted instances have memory_mb greater than the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.instance_uuid) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_system_metadata_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.display_name) AS above_avg_memory_instances_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

sql: WITH completed_migration_memory_deviation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ), InstanceMemory AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory ) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ORDER BY im.migration_id ), high_memory_shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cmd.migration_id) AS completed_migrations_for_high_memory_shelved_instances_count, COUNT(DISTINCT hms.DISPLAY_NAME) AS high_memory_shelved_instance_display_names_count FROM completed_migration_memory_deviation cmd JOIN high_memory_shelved_instances hms ON cmd.instance_display_name = hms.DISPLAY_NAME;

sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries, MAX(i2.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_in_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_entries DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, q1.metadata_entries, q1.max_vcpus_in_display_name, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.metadata_entries DESC;

question: Among the top 10 instance display names with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (ROOT_GB) computed only from instance system-metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type' (also showing the total vCPUs and total memory summed across those same rows), return only those display names that also have completed migrations whose per-(display name, status, created_at) maximum MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than the overall average of those maximums; for each matching display name, show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total vCPUs, total memory (MB), the migration status, the max MEMORY_TOTAL, and the migration created timestamp. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.max_memory_total * 1.0) FROM inner_cte inner_cte2) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.total_vcpus, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.max_memory_total, q2.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, q2.max_memory_total DESC, q2.created_at DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_total_stddev, a.avg_memory_total_stddev, (c.memory_total_stddev - a.avg_memory_total_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.avg_memory_total_stddev, q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH top10_metadata_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) AS avg_metadata_entries FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_entries, ac.avg_metadata_entries, (ic.metadata_entries - ac.avg_metadata_entries) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_entries DESC ), high_memory_stddev_display_names AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_display_names_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_memory_stddev_display_names) AS high_memory_stddev_display_names_count FROM top10_metadata_by_display_name;

question: For the top 10 projects with the highest total instance memory (considering only non-deleted instances), list each project’s ID, its total memory used (MB), and whether it has any instance whose memory-based dense rank (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) equals 1; for every non-deleted instance in those projects, also show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), plus the total number of non-deleted instances in that project and the average of those per-project totals across all projects. sql: WITH top_projects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id ) SELECT tp.project_id, tp.total_memory_mb, tp.has_rank1_instance_by_window, id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.instance_id;

question: List (1) each instance display name whose total ROOT_GB across instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type' exceeds 50 GB, and (2) each image type (from that same system metadata key) with its maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory_remaining among completed migrations, returning a combined result set with the entity name, the metric value, and a reason label indicating which condition produced the row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RootDiskTotals AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), avg_totals AS ( SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals at ), MigrationMemoryCVByImageType AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ism.value AS image_type, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ism.value ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT rdt.DISPLAY_NAME AS entity_name, rdt.total_root_gb AS metric_value, 'High Total Root Disk (GB)' AS reason FROM RootDiskTotals rdt UNION ALL SELECT mmc.image_type AS entity_name, mmc.max_coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Max Migration Memory Remaining CV (Completed Migrations)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryCVByImageType mmc ) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, calculate the total root disk size (in GB) across instances that have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type', and only include display names where the summed root disk size is greater than 50 GB.

For each instance display name, return the instance display name and the coefficient of variation of migration memory remaining (standard deviation divided by average) for completed migrations of that instance.

For each instance display name, show the total root disk size (in GB) across instances that have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type' (only keeping display names where this total exceeds 50 GB), along with the overall average of these per-display-name totals and the deviation of each display name’s total from that average.

For each image type (from instance system metadata), find the image type and the highest coefficient of variation of migration memory remaining (standard deviation divided by average) among instance display names that have completed migrations.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50;

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), avg_totals AS ( SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals at;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ism.value AS image_type, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ism.value ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state (considering only migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs), return the migration count, earliest migration creation time, and the deviation from the overall average migration count, along with the variance of instance memory (MB) for that VM state among instances that have a network info cache record, the overall average of these variances as a benchmark, and the VM state’s variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
sql: WITH migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.migration_status, i.instance_vm_state, i.migration_count, i.earliest_migration_created_at, (i.migration_count - a.avg_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), memory_variance_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT ms.migration_status, ms.instance_vm_state, ms.migration_count, ms.earliest_migration_created_at, ms.deviation_from_avg_migration_count, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_variance_benchmark, mv.variance_category FROM migration_stats ms JOIN memory_variance_by_state mv ON ms.instance_vm_state = mv.VM_STATE;
