sub_sqls: SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE;
SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.migration_status, i.instance_vm_state, i.migration_count, i.earliest_migration_created_at, (i.migration_count - a.avg_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac;

question: For instances that are not deleted and whose display names are in the top 10 by number of network info cache records, show (for their completed migrations where the VM state is “shelved_offloaded”) the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, display name, instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, the windowed minimum memory (MB) over 3 preceding and 1 following migration rows (ordered by migration ID), the overall average of that windowed minimum and each row’s deviation from it, along with the cache record count, the overall average cache record count across the top 10, and each display name’s deviation from that cache-record average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.key, ic.value, ic.window_column, av.avg_window_min_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - av.avg_window_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte av ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC ) SELECT q1.status AS migration_status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb, q1.key AS system_metadata_key, q1.value AS system_metadata_value, q1.window_column AS window_min_memory_mb, q1.avg_window_min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min, q2.cache_records, q2.avg_cache_records, q2.deviation_from_avg AS cache_records_deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = q1.instance_uuid WHERE i.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY q2.cache_records DESC, q1.instance_uuid;
sub_questions: For completed migrations of instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance memory in MB, the system metadata key and value, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID.

sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded';

SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.key, ic.value, ic.window_column, av.avg_window_min_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - av.avg_window_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte av;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;

question: For instance display names that (a) have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', (b) appear in more than one such instance, and (c) have a memory (MEMORY_MB) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) greater than the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s, show each display name along with its memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory across system metadata rows (for non-deleted instances), and the deviation of that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: List all instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have cached network_info and whose display_name also appears in the per-display-name memory variance calculation (based on instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), returning the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info, the 2-preceding/2-following window average memory_mb per VM state, the total instance count per VM state and the average instance count across VM states, plus the display name’s memory_mb variance, the overall average of those variances, and the display name’s deviation from that overall average; include a “Reason” column indicating whether the row is included as a flare3 instance detail or as a display-name variance summary. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH variance_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), instances_in_flare3_with_cache AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, COUNT(ic.uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.vm_state) AS total_instances_in_vm_state, avg_states.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_states ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY ic.memory_mb ), CombinedInstanceInsights AS ( SELECT iic.uuid, iic.display_name, iic.vm_state, iic.memory_mb, iic.network_info, iic.window_column, iic.total_instances_in_vm_state, iic.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, vbdn.memory_mb_variance, vbdn.avg_memory_mb_variance, vbdn.deviation_from_avg_variance, 'Flare3 Instance With Cache' AS Reason FROM instances_in_flare3_with_cache iic JOIN variance_by_display_name vbdn ON iic.display_name = vbdn.display_name UNION ALL SELECT iic.uuid, iic.display_name, iic.vm_state, iic.memory_mb, iic.network_info, iic.window_column, iic.total_instances_in_vm_state, iic.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, vbdn.memory_mb_variance, vbdn.avg_memory_mb_variance, vbdn.deviation_from_avg_variance, 'Display Name Memory Variance Summary' AS Reason FROM variance_by_display_name vbdn JOIN instances_in_flare3_with_cache iic ON iic.display_name = vbdn.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceInsights ORDER BY display_name, uuid, Reason;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, COUNT(ic.uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.vm_state) AS total_instances_in_vm_state, avg_states.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_states ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY ic.memory_mb;

question: List all instance-related rows that either (a) are for instances with display name 'forge' and have system metadata (including instance UUID, metadata key/value, the row number ordered by metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and instance memory in MB) where the instance memory is greater than 16000 MB, OR (b) are for instances with a completed migration where the migration’s processed memory share (memory_processed divided by memory_total) is greater than 75%, returning the instance UUID and a reason for inclusion; for the migration-based rows, only include instances whose display name is 'forge'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ForgeMetadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB > 16000 ), CompletedMigrationHighProcessed AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column, (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m.status = inner_cte.status AND m.migration_type = inner_cte.migration_type WHERE (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) > 0.75 ), CombinedInstanceSignals AS ( SELECT fm.UUID AS uuid, fm.KEY AS signal_key, fm.VALUE AS signal_value, fm.window_column AS signal_window_column, fm.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, 'Forge metadata (memory > 16000MB)' AS reason, NULL AS display_name, NULL AS availability_zone, NULL AS migration_status, NULL AS migration_type, NULL AS migration_window_column, NULL AS memory_processed_ratio FROM ForgeMetadata fm UNION ALL SELECT cm.uuid AS uuid, NULL AS signal_key, NULL AS signal_value, NULL AS signal_window_column, NULL AS memory_mb, 'Completed migration (memory processed ratio > 0.75)' AS reason, cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.migration_type, cm.window_column AS migration_window_column, cm.memory_processed_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationHighProcessed cm WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceSignals ORDER BY uuid, reason;

question: For instance display names that (a) are from non-deleted instances with a non-empty key name and have an instance-memory range (in MB) greater than the average range across such display names, show each display name’s memory range and memory variance, along with its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (from system metadata rows for non-deleted instances) and the deviation of that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT display_name, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_range_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), AvgTotals AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_total_memory_mb FROM AvgTotals) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, uuid, hostname, memory_mb, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) OVER () AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY uuid ) SELECT q2.uuid, q2.hostname, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.network_info, q2.window_column, q2.total_forge_instances, q2.avg_forge_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY q2.uuid;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, i.hostname FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_display_name_total_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS high_memory_instance_count, SUM(q1.total_memory_mb) AS high_memory_instances_total_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = q2.display_name JOIN q1 ON q1.uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY q2.display_name, q2.total_memory_mb ORDER BY shelved_offloaded_display_name_total_memory_mb DESC;

question: How many instance display-name groups are categorized as HIGH_MEMORY (vs their benchmark) for instances in availability zone 'flare3' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', and how many display-name groups are categorized as HIGH_MEMORY (vs their benchmark) among instances involved in migrations with status = 'completed'? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH az_image_type_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb > am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb < am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ), completed_migration_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), OverallBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT cte.DISPLAY_NAME, cte.avg_memory_mb, cte.memory_mb_variance, ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb > ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb < ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmark ob ORDER BY cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_image_type_memory WHERE memory_category = 'HIGH_MEMORY') AS az_image_type_high_memory_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_migration_memory WHERE memory_category = 'HIGH_MEMORY') AS completed_migration_high_memory_count FROM az_image_type_memory aitm CROSS JOIN completed_migration_memory cmm LIMIT 1;

c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, sql: WITH forge_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), DisplayNameAverages AS ( SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ), flare3_stddevs AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, av.avg_memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - av.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS forge_instances_above_avg_memory_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare3_stddevs) AS flare3_display_names_with_stddev_count FROM forge_above_avg fa JOIN flare3_stddevs fs ON fs.display_name = fa.display_name;

sql: WITH memory_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, a.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > a.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < a.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ), metadata_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, overall_avg.avg_migration_metadata_count AS overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_metadata_count) AS avg_migration_metadata_count FROM ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_counts ) AS overall_avg ), CombinedInstanceStats AS ( SELECT mv.display_name, 'Memory MB Variance' AS metric_type, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metric_value, mv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, mv.variance_category AS category, NULL AS metadata_count_range, NULL AS metadata_count_variance, NULL AS metadata_count_stddev, NULL AS overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM memory_variance mv UNION ALL SELECT ms.display_name, 'Per-migration Metadata Count Dispersion' AS metric_type, NULL AS metric_value, NULL AS benchmark_value, NULL AS category, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev, ms.overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM metadata_stats ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceStats ORDER BY display_name, metric_type;

sql: WITH geom_means_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, EXP(AVG(LN(i.vcpus))) AS geometric_mean_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.vcpus > 0 GROUP BY m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), max_project_memory_range_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), StatusProjectRanges AS ( SELECT m.status, i.project_id, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS project_memory_mb_range FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status, i.project_id ) SELECT spr.status, MAX(spr.project_memory_mb_range) AS max_project_memory_mb_range FROM StatusProjectRanges AS spr JOIN inner_cte AS base ON base.status = spr.status GROUP BY spr.status ORDER BY max_project_memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT g.status, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, g.geometric_mean_vcpus, r.max_project_memory_mb_range FROM geom_means_by_status AS g JOIN max_project_memory_range_by_status AS r ON r.status = g.status ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, EXP(AVG(LN(i.vcpus))) AS geometric_mean_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.vcpus > 0 GROUP BY m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), StatusProjectRanges AS ( SELECT m.status, i.project_id, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS project_memory_mb_range FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status, i.project_id ) SELECT spr.status, MAX(spr.project_memory_mb_range) AS max_project_memory_mb_range FROM StatusProjectRanges AS spr JOIN inner_cte AS base ON base.status = spr.status GROUP BY spr.status ORDER BY max_project_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name that has at least one completed migration with a maximum recorded total memory greater than 0, list the display name, the instance’s MEMORY_MB range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across its records, how far that range deviates from the overall average range across all display names, the completed migration status and maximum migration memory_total, the instance’s configured memory_mb and vcpus, and compute the max migration memory_total to configured memory_mb ratio (rounded).
sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC ), mig_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range, mg.status AS migration_status, mg.max_memory_total, mg.memory_mb AS configured_memory_mb, mg.vcpus AS configured_vcpus, ROUND(mg.max_memory_total / NULLIF(mg.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS max_migration_memory_to_configured_memory_ratio FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mig_stats mg ON mg.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY max_migration_memory_to_configured_memory_ratio DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 (display name, launched-at timestamp) groups with the highest maximum memory among instances launched in 2014 (only keeping groups where that maximum exceeds 16000 MB), show the group’s display name, launched-at timestamp, maximum memory, whether any instance in the group has a non-empty NUMA topology recorded, how many instances in that group are the display name 'forge', and whether any of those 'forge' instances has an instance-extra record marked as deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH top_groups_2014 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NOT NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, COUNT(fi.instance_uuid) AS forge_instance_count_in_group, MAX(CASE WHEN fi.has_deleted_instance_extra = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_forge_instance_has_deleted_instance_extra FROM top_groups_2014 tg LEFT JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME, tg.LAUNCHED_AT, tg.max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology ORDER BY tg.max_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name (considering only instances that are not deleted and that have extra metadata), return only those display names whose instance memory (in MB) variance is greater than the average memory variance across all display names, and for those display names also show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory across their system metadata rows, the number of system metadata rows, and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH variance_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ), cov_and_meta AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT v.display_name, v.memory_mb_variance, v.memory_mb_stddev, c.coefficient_of_variation, c.system_metadata_rows, c.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM variance_above_avg v JOIN cov_and_meta c ON c.display_name = v.display_name ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For VM states that (a) are in the top 10 (among non-deleted instances) by variance in migration memory total and (b) also have an instance memory (MB) variance greater than 1000 among instances with system metadata key = 'image_image_type', show the VM state, the migration memory total variance, the number of distinct migrated instances, whether any migrations are currently active, and the instance memory (MB) variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 1000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS migrated_instance_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_total_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.migrated_instance_count, q2.has_active_migrations, q1.memory_mb_variance FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.VM_STATE = q2.VM_STATE ORDER BY q2.memory_total_variance DESC;

sql: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ), shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ic.UPDATED_AT AS cache_updated_at FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT fi.display_name, fi.uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.network_info AS forge_cached_network_info, fi.cache_id AS forge_cache_id, fi.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, fi.total_forge_instances, fi.avg_forge_memory_mb, so.hostname AS shelved_offloaded_hostname, so.memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb, so.vcpus AS shelved_offloaded_vcpus, so.cache_updated_at AS shelved_offloaded_cache_updated_at, ROUND(fi.memory_mb / NULLIF(so.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS forge_to_shelved_offloaded_memory_ratio FROM forge_instances fi JOIN shelved_offloaded_with_cache so ON so.instance_uuid = fi.uuid ORDER BY fi.memory_mb;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration details (migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, instance memory MB, vCPUs, instance extra id, migration memory total, and the per-migration-type minimum memory total window column), but only for instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state whose total instance memory (summed across system metadata entries) is greater than 50000 MB and also greater than the average of those qualifying totals; additionally compute the ratio of migration MEMORY_TOTAL to that instance total memory.
sql: WITH mem_over_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), completed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id) = MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, migration_id, INSTANCE_UUID, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, MEMORY_MB, VCPUS, instance_extra_id, MEMORY_TOTAL, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id), filtered_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT cm.migration_type, cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, moa.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN mem_over_avg moa ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = moa.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cm.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id, fcm.INSTANCE_UUID, fcm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_HOST, fcm.DISPLAY_NAME, fcm.VM_STATE, fcm.MEMORY_MB, fcm.VCPUS, fcm.instance_extra_id, fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL, fcm.window_column, fcm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL / NULLIF(fcm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS migration_memory_to_instance_total_memory_ratio FROM filtered_completed_migrations fcm ORDER BY fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id;

Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM INSTANCES AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN INSTANCES AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN avg_ids a ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q2.hostname, q2.availability_zone, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.instance_extra_id, q1.instance_extra_created_at, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_instance_extra_id_window_3_preceding_1_following_by_memory_mb, q1.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_category, q2.rank_within_az_by_id, q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, (inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 / totals.grand_total_memory_mb) AS pct_of_included_total_memory FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SUM(total_memory_mb) AS grand_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) totals ON 1 = 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb, q1.pct_of_included_total_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.pct_of_included_total_memory DESC, q2.instance_count DESC, q2.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", list the availability zone (suppressing repeats and including subtotal rows per zone), instance ID, display name, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone by instance ID, and also show (by matching on display name) the variance of instance memory_mb among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, the overall average of these per-display-name variances, and each display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH mem_var_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), shelved_offloaded_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(availability_zone) OVER (ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, id) = availability_zone THEN NULL ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column, total_instances_in_az FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE availability_zone END AS az_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_az FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, id ) SELECT soi.availability_zone, soi.id, soi.display_name, soi.network_info, soi.window_column AS rank_in_availability_zone_by_id, soi.total_instances_in_az, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance, mv.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM shelved_offloaded_instances AS soi LEFT JOIN mem_var_by_display_name AS mv ON soi.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY soi.availability_zone, soi.id;

question: How many instances in availability zone "flare3" have a VM-state running sum of instance IDs (ordered by instance ID) that is above the average of that running-sum value, and how many "flare3" instances with cached network info have total processed memory across completed migrations that is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean processed memory per completed migration? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH az_running_sum_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), high_migration_memory_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed' ) ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, i.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid ), flare3_high_migration_memory_instances AS ( SELECT hmi.instance_uuid, hmi.display_name, hmi.total_memory_processed FROM high_migration_memory_instances hmi JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = hmi.instance_uuid WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_running_sum_above_avg) AS flare3_instances_running_sum_above_avg_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare3_high_migration_memory_instances) AS flare3_instances_high_migration_memory_count ;

SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed' );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed' ) ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, i.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance display name that is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and has total memory (in MB) across its system metadata entries greater than 50000 MB and also greater than the average total memory of those qualifying instances, return the instance display name, that total memory, the variance of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata entries for non-deleted instances, and the deviation of that variance from the overall average memory variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name that (1) has an instance memory (MB) variance higher than the average variance across all non-deleted instances with extra metadata and (2) also has at least 6 “shelved_offloaded” instances with extra metadata, show the display name, its memory variance and overall memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), plus its “shelved_offloaded” memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall benchmark standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for “shelved_offloaded” display names, and the resulting variability category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), AvgStddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgStddev a ) SELECT q2.display_name, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS overall_memory_mb_stddev, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb_stddev, q2.benchmark AS shelved_offloaded_stddev_benchmark, q2.variability_category FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC, q2.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' with the highest average MEMORY_MB among instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the display name, the minimum instance ID, the average memory (MB), whether any instance with that display name has more than one system-metadata row, and also the (non-deleted) memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and deviation from the overall average memory range for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH top10_by_avg_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = i.display_name GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.id = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), display_name_memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT t.display_name, t.min_instance_id, t.avg_memory_mb, t.has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows, s.memory_mb_range, s.memory_mb_variance, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM top10_by_avg_memory t JOIN display_name_memory_stats s ON s.display_name = t.display_name ORDER BY t.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed", list each instance’s migration type (suppressing repeats when it matches the previous row), instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory; also include, for that instance display name, the geometric-mean memory across instances with system metadata key = 'image_image_type', the overall benchmark geometric-mean memory, and the resulting memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). sql: WITH completed_migration_rank_by_zone AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT instance_availability_zone, MAX(window_column) AS max_migration_rank_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_availability_zone ), max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name ) SELECT cmrz.max_migration_rank_in_zone, mtv.max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM completed_migration_rank_by_zone cmrz CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(max_total_vcpus_per_instance) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 ) mtv WHERE cmrz.instance_availability_zone = 'flare3';

SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT instance_availability_zone, MAX(window_column) AS max_migration_rank_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_availability_zone;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name;

question: For instance display names that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and are categorized as HIGH_VARIABILITY in memory range versus the overall benchmark, show the display name, its memory range and variance (MB) with the benchmark memory range and variability category, along with its average memory and memory variance (MB) with the overall variance benchmark and variance category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH MemoryRangeVariability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ar.avg_memory_range_mb AS benchmark_memory_range_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_range_mb > ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_range_mb < ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mrv.display_name, mrv.memory_range_mb, mrv.memory_variance_mb, mrv.benchmark_memory_range_mb, mrv.variability_category, mvbd.avg_memory_mb, mvbd.memory_mb_variance, mvbd.benchmark AS variance_benchmark, mvbd.variance_category FROM MemoryRangeVariability mrv JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName mvbd ON mrv.display_name = mvbd.display_name WHERE mrv.variability_category = 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' ORDER BY mrv.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list each instance display name along with (1) the minimum instance ID and its per-display-name average memory (MB) plus the overall benchmark and memory category, and (2) the same display name’s average and variance of memory (MB) for migrations with status = 'completed' (including the overall benchmark and memory category for completed migrations). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb > am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb < am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), OverallBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT cte.DISPLAY_NAME, cte.avg_memory_mb, cte.memory_mb_variance, ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb > ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb < ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmark ob ORDER BY cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q1_with_display_name AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb AS az_avg_memory_mb, q1.benchmark AS az_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_category AS az_memory_category FROM q1 JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = q1.min_instance_id WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT q1d.DISPLAY_NAME, q1d.min_instance_id, q1d.az_avg_memory_mb, q1d.az_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1d.az_memory_category, q2.avg_memory_mb AS completed_migrations_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance AS completed_migrations_memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS completed_migrations_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_category AS completed_migrations_memory_category FROM q1_with_display_name q1d JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1d.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY question: For each VM state that appears in both (a) instances with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' and memory_mb > 0 and (b) instances that have a corresponding network info cache record, show the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) and its overall average across VM states, plus the memory variance (MB) with its overall average benchmark and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE), ordered by geometric-mean memory descending. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, overall_avg.avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT q1.vm_state, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_variance_benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", return the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the rank within each availability zone ordered by instance ID, and the deviation of each instance ID from the average instance ID across all such instances, along with the completed migration status, maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL), and migration created timestamp for matching (non-deleted) instances where the completed migration’s memory utilization (MEMORY_PROCESSED divided by MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.ID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (ic.ID - ai.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ids ai), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m ON m.created_at = inner_cte.created_at AND m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75) SELECT q1.ID AS instance_id, q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, q1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, q1.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, q1.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_instance_id, q1.deviation_from_avg_instance_id, q2.status AS completed_migration_status, q2.max_memory_total AS completed_migration_max_memory_total, q2.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME;
