WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), DisplayNameAverages AS ( SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: How many distinct instances in availability zone flare3 both (1) have non-deleted image_image_type system metadata values whose instance counts are above the average across all non-deleted image_image_type values, and (2) belong to one of the top 10 instance display names by number of network info cache records in flare3; and how many distinct display names meet both conditions? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH image_type_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.VALUE ORDER BY t1.UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t0.DELETED = 0), ValueCounts AS ( SELECT metadata_value, COUNT(*) AS value_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_value ), AvgValueCount AS ( SELECT AVG(value_instance_count * 1.0) AS avg_value_instance_count FROM ValueCounts ) SELECT i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.metadata_value, i.network_info FROM inner_cte i JOIN ValueCounts vc ON i.metadata_value = vc.metadata_value WHERE vc.value_instance_count > (SELECT avg_value_instance_count FROM AvgValueCount) ), top10_display_names_flare3 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ita.instance_uuid) AS matching_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.display_name) AS matching_display_name_count FROM image_type_above_avg ita JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.uuid = ita.instance_uuid JOIN top10_display_names_flare3 t10 ON t10.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3';

question: For migrations where the instance has system metadata with the key 'image_image_type', and restricting to migrations with status 'completed', list (by migration status and instance VM state) the migration count, the minimum instance memory (MB), the average migration memory_total, the deviation of that group’s migration count from the overall average migration count across all such groups, and the corresponding count of completed migrations for the same VM state and status. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ), avg_counts AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ), group_memory AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_migration_memory_total FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, gm.avg_migration_memory_total, (ic.migration_count - ac.avg_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN group_memory gm ON gm.migration_status = ic.migration_status AND gm.instance_vm_state = ic.instance_vm_state CROSS JOIN avg_counts ac ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q1.avg_migration_memory_total, q1.deviation_from_avg_migration_count, q2.completed_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.status = q1.migration_status AND q2.vm_state = q1.instance_vm_state WHERE q1.migration_status = 'completed';

sql: WITH forge_instances_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb ), display_name_memory_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, avg_variances.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_variances ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.memory_mb, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.window_column, d.memory_mb_variance, d.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM forge_instances_above_avg f JOIN display_name_memory_variance d ON f.display_name = d.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY f.memory_mb;

sql: WITH TopDisplayNameKeyGroups AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i2.created_at) = 2014 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND ism2.key = inner_cte.key AND ism2.value = 'neon' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_neon_value_for_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), InstanceWindowStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, (ic.max_instance_extra_id_next2 - ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS deviation_from_avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT iws.uuid, iws.display_name, iws.vm_state, iws.power_state, iws.memory_mb, iws.vcpus, iws.max_instance_extra_id_next2, iws.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, iws.deviation_from_avg_max_next2, tdkg.key AS system_metadata_key, tdkg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tdkg.has_neon_value_for_key FROM InstanceWindowStats iws JOIN TopDisplayNameKeyGroups tdkg ON iws.display_name = tdkg.display_name ORDER BY tdkg.max_memory_mb DESC, iws.uuid;

question: In availability zone 'flare3', for instances whose total vCPUs across their system metadata rows is greater than 32, show only those whose display name also has a MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) greater than 5000 MB (among instances with extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry), and display the instance UUID, display name, key name, system metadata entry count, total vCPUs, MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and average MEMORY_MB. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > 5000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.metadata_entry_count, inner_cte.total_vcpus FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_vcpus > 32 ) SELECT q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.key_name, q2.metadata_entry_count, q2.total_vcpus, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q1.avg_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose memory in MB is greater than the average memory in MB of all instances in that availability zone, and that also have display name "forge", list the instance UUID, display name, memory in MB, the instance extra flavor JSON, cached network info, the running average of memory in MB (ordered by memory), the system metadata key and value, the instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group (ordered by instance ID), and the total number of such metadata rows plus the average running-sum value across those rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH az_mem AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, flavor, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb ), forge_metadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.window_column, stats.total_rows, stats.avg_window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) AS stats ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT az_mem.instance_uuid, az_mem.display_name, az_mem.memory_mb, az_mem.flavor, az_mem.network_info, az_mem.window_column AS az_running_avg_memory_mb, forge_metadata.metadata_key, forge_metadata.metadata_value, forge_metadata.power_state, forge_metadata.window_column AS forge_running_sum_instance_ids, forge_metadata.total_rows AS forge_total_rows, forge_metadata.avg_window_column AS forge_avg_running_sum_instance_ids FROM az_mem JOIN forge_metadata ON az_mem.instance_uuid = forge_metadata.instance_uuid ORDER BY az_mem.memory_mb;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations (considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), display each display name, the completed migration count, the total vCPUs, the total memory (MB), whether any of those instances have a non-completed migration, and also the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (in bytes) across completed migrations plus the deviation of that instance’s average memory remaining from the overall average across all instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes - oa.overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations AS completed_migrations, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND m2.status <> 'completed' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_non_completed_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.completed_migrations, q2.total_vcpus, q2.total_memory_mb, q2.has_non_completed_migrations, q1.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, q1.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, q1.deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' with the most network info cache records, list the display name and its cache record count, the overall average cache record count across those top 10 and the deviation from that average, and also include the display name’s average and variance of instance memory (MB) for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' (and are not deleted in metadata), plus the deviation of that average memory from the overall average memory across all such instances; finally compute the average memory per cache record (average memory divided by cache record count).
sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ), net_cache_top10 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC ) SELECT nct.display_name, nct.cache_records, nct.avg_cache_records, nct.deviation_from_avg, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_mb / NULLIF(nct.cache_records, 0), 2) AS avg_memory_mb_per_cache_record FROM net_cache_top10 nct JOIN mem_stats ms ON ms.display_name = nct.display_name ORDER BY nct.cache_records DESC;

question: For each instance display name whose non-deleted instances have an average memory size greater than 16384 MB, and restricting to non-deleted instances in availability zone 'flare3', list the display name along with its memory range and variance (in MB), its average memory (in MB), and summarize the dense-rank-by-memory window metric by reporting the average dense rank for that display name, the overall benchmark dense-rank average, and counts of instances categorized as HIGH_RANK, LOW_RANK, or AVERAGE_RANK. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_RANK' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_RANK' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_RANK'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb HAVING AVG(i2.memory_mb) > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), AverageRank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_rank AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > ar.avg_window_rank * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RANK' WHEN ic.window_column < ar.avg_window_rank * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RANK' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RANK' END AS rank_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRank ar ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb, AVG(q2.window_column) AS avg_dense_rank_for_display_name, AVG(q2.benchmark) AS overall_rank_benchmark, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'HIGH_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'LOW_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'AVERAGE_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_rank_instances FROM q1 JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = q1.display_name JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances in the VM state “shelved_offloaded”, show the (non-repeated) system metadata key, instance UUID, display name, power state, metadata value, cached network_info JSON, the per-metadata-key row number, plus the total rows and average power state per metadata key; also attach (when available by matching display name and network_info) the non-deleted instance details for instances whose memory_mb is greater than the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances, including that instance’s display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and dense rank by project_id. sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO question: For the 10 instance display names with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (bytes) across completed migrations, show each display name’s average memory remaining, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and deviation from the overall average memory remaining, and also show the variance of instance memory size (MB) for that display name (only where instances have a matching INSTANCE_EXTRA row), along with the overall average of those variances and the display name’s deviation from that overall average. sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes - oa.overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), mem_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), HighStddevDisplayNames AS ( SELECT ms.display_name FROM mem_stats ms WHERE ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ms.deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance, mv.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mem_variance mv ON ms.display_name = mv.display_name WHERE ms.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM HighStddevDisplayNames) ORDER BY ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC, ms.display_name;

question: For instances that are not deleted and are running on host "prime-35", show (by availability zone and VM state) the instance count and earliest instance creation time, and also include for the same VM state whether migrations are Active or Inactive (using the same active-migration status filter) along with the average variance of migration memory total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceZoneStateRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE AVAILABILITY_ZONE END AS AVAILABILITY_ZONE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 AND GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(earliest_created_at) AS earliest_created_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE, VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ), VmStateMigrationActivityRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VmStateMigrationActivity AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 WHERE m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID AND m2.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity, AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES i JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, migration_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity END AS migration_activity, AVG(avg_memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM VmStateMigrationActivity GROUP BY VM_STATE, migration_activity WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT izs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izs.VM_STATE, izs.instance_count, izs.earliest_created_at, vma.migration_activity, vma.avg_memory_total_variance FROM InstanceZoneStateRollup izs JOIN VmStateMigrationActivityRollup vma ON vma.VM_STATE = izs.VM_STATE WHERE izs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE <> 'GRAND TOTAL' AND izs.VM_STATE <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND vma.VM_STATE <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY izs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izs.VM_STATE, vma.migration_activity;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i2.MEMORY_MB > ( SELECT AVG(i3.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) FROM INSTANCES AS i3 WHERE i3.DELETED = 0 AND i3.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.extra_record_count, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.extra_record_count, 0)) > 16384 ) SELECT q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.network_info, q2.extra_record_count, q2.total_memory_mb, q1.VM_STATE, q1.KEY AS system_metadata_key, q1.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, q1.window_column AS metadata_rank_within_key FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.UUID = q2.instance_uuid ORDER BY q2.instance_uuid, q1.KEY, q1.window_column;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.extra_record_count, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.extra_record_count, 0)) > 16384;

question: For each active (non-deleted) migration status (excluding accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed), show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for migrations with a non-deleted instance info cache entry, include the overall benchmark average memory and label each status as HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY relative to that benchmark, and also show (from migrations joined to instance_extra) the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory plus the overall average instance memory across all such active migrations. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each status as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), overall_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.status, c.avg_memory_mb, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, b.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.avg_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN c.avg_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark b ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_stddev, overall_avg.overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb) AS overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT q1.status, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q1.benchmark AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_category, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_memory_mb_stddev, q2.overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.vm_state) AS total_instances_in_vm_state, avg_counts.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(vm_state_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS vm_state_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.window_column, q2.total_instances_in_vm_state, q2.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, return each instance’s display name, that metadata value, cached network info, and the row-number window value, along with how far the metadata value is from the average across those rows; and for the same instances (restricted to the top 10 prime-matching instances by completed-migration metadata-count range), also show the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata rows per completed migration and whether the instance has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) migrations. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_meta AS ( SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS REAL)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS REAL) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta am ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

sql: WITH migration_mem_window AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT uuid, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, status, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), instance_state_mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_mem AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_mem am ), counts AS ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM migration_mem_window) AS migration_rows_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instance_state_mem_stats) AS instance_rows_count ) SELECT c.migration_rows_count, c.instance_rows_count FROM counts c;

metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4 ) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM sql: WITH cov_results AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT cr.display_name, cr.coefficient_of_variation, cr.avg_coefficient_of_variation, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM cov_results cr JOIN memory_stats ms ON cr.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY cr.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the top 10 instances (by range of system-metadata rows per completed migration) whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', list each instance’s display name, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata rows per completed migration, whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) non-deleted migrations, and also the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of non-deleted system-metadata entries per instance (for instances with a non-deleted network info cache) plus the deviation of that display name’s average metadata-entry count from the overall average across all such 'prime' display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), PerDisplayNameAvg AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(per_instance_meta.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entries_per_instance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_meta_entries_per_instance) AS overall_avg_meta_entries FROM PerDisplayNameAvg ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, (pda.avg_meta_entries_per_instance - oa.overall_avg_meta_entries) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PerDisplayNameAvg AS pda ON pda.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME CROSS JOIN OverallAvg AS oa ORDER BY ic.metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.metadata_count_range AS completed_migration_metadata_count_range, q1.metadata_count_variance AS completed_migration_metadata_count_variance, q1.metadata_count_stddev AS completed_migration_metadata_count_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.metadata_count_range AS per_instance_metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance AS per_instance_metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev AS per_instance_metadata_count_stddev, q2.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type, show (by instance display name) the average memory (MB) and memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for display names matching the pattern prime (including subtotals and a grand total), and for those same display names also list the metadata value and cached network info for instances hosted on blaze8-12, including the instance UUID and the instance info cache record ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP), host_metadata_network AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, iic.ID AS instance_info_cache_id FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_stddev, hmn.metadata_value, hmn.network_info, hmn.window_column, hmn.instance_uuid, hmn.instance_info_cache_id FROM mem_stats AS ms JOIN host_metadata_network AS hmn ON hmn.display_name = ms.display_name WHERE ms.display_name REGEXP 'prime';

question: For the top 10 instance display names (in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type') ranked by average memory (MB), show each display name, its minimum instance ID, its average memory, whether any instance with that display name has system metadata KEY = 'image_image_location', and how many rows of completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12' (keeping only instances whose memory is > 75% of the maximum among those completed migrations) match that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH sq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), sq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS mem_stats WHERE (inner_cte.MEMORY_MB * 1.0 / mem_stats.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ) SELECT s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata, COUNT(s2.migration_id) AS completed_migration_rows_over_75pct_max_mem FROM sq1 s1 LEFT JOIN sq2 s2 ON s2.DISPLAY_NAME = s1.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata ORDER BY s1.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' (limited to instances with more than 8 VCPUs) and considering only migrations with status 'completed', for each VM state and display name that has a minimum memory at least 75% of the maximum minimum-memory across the returned groups, show the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB) and its ratio vs the maximum minimum-memory, along with that VM state’s migration memory-moved range and variance, the overall average memory-moved range benchmark across VM states, and the VM state’s variability category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) >= 0.75 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ORDER BY ic.memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.min_memory_vs_max_ratio, q2.memory_total_range, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.benchmark AS avg_memory_total_range_benchmark, q2.variability_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.VM_STATE = q2.VM_STATE ORDER BY q2.memory_total_range DESC, q1.instance_count DESC;

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and that are among the top 10 by standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration MEMORY_TOTAL (only including display names with more than 5 completed migration records), show the instance display name, its MEMORY_TOTAL standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) non-deleted migrations, and—restricted to those same instances that are on host blaze8-12 with system metadata key image_image_type—also show the instance UUID, the metadata key/value, cached network info, the rolling average instance memory (MB) over 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by metadata value and ordered by created-at), and whether the instance has any other non-deleted system metadata keys besides image_image_type. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ism2.KEY <> 'image_image_type' AND ism2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_other_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.network_info, q2.avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, q2.has_other_system_metadata FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_total_stddev DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_value;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ism2.KEY <> 'image_image_type' AND ism2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_other_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value;

question: For host "blaze8-12" and completed migrations, list each instance’s display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with the total number of completed migrations on that host and the average completed migrations per host; also include, for the same instances, the completed migration rows whose migration id is greater than the overall average migration id (within this host’s completed migrations), showing migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, network info, and the status-partitioned running average migration id. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, instance_display_name, NETWORK_INFO, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE migration_id > (SELECT AVG(migration_id) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migration_id ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.migration_id, q2.migration_status, q2.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q2.DEST_COMPUTE, q2.instance_display_name, q2.NETWORK_INFO, q2.window_column FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.UUID = ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID FROM MIGRATIONS AS m WHERE m.ID = q2.migration_id ) ORDER BY q2.migration_id;

SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, instance_display_name, NETWORK_INFO, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE migration_id > (SELECT AVG(migration_id) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migration_id;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern “prime”, show each display name’s average and variance of total migration memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) across completed migrations, the overall benchmark average of those per-display-name averages, and a memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). Also include how many “prime” instances with that display name are in the “flare3” availability zone, and alongside that report the “flare3” rollup breakdown of info-cache status (HasInfoCache/NoInfoCache, plus subtotals and grand total) with the minimum instance memory (MEMORY_MB) and the sum of INSTANCE_EXTRA.ID values. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH prime_memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_total) AS benchmark_avg_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_total, ic.memory_total_variance, b.benchmark_avg_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_total > b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_total < b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ), flare3_info_cache_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(ie.ID) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), InfoCacheStatus AS ( SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic2 WHERE iic2.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID AND iic2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'HasInfoCache' ELSE 'NoInfoCache' END AS info_cache_status, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(ie.ID) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, info_cache_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(info_cache_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE info_cache_status END AS info_cache_status, MIN(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(total_instance_extra_id_sum) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum, (SELECT min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_min_memory_mb, (SELECT total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM inner_cte) AS overall_total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM InfoCacheStatus GROUP BY availability_zone, info_cache_status WITH ROLLUP ), flare3_prime_instance_counts AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS flare3_prime_instance_count FROM instances i WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT pms.display_name, pms.avg_memory_total, pms.memory_total_variance, pms.benchmark AS benchmark_avg_memory_total, pms.memory_category, fpic.flare3_prime_instance_count, ficr.availability_zone, ficr.info_cache_status, ficr.min_memory_mb, ficr.total_instance_extra_id_sum, ficr.overall_min_memory_mb, ficr.overall_total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM prime_memory_stats pms JOIN flare3_prime_instance_counts fpic ON pms.display_name = fpic.display_name CROSS JOIN flare3_info_cache_rollup ficr WHERE ficr.availability_zone = 'flare3';

For instances that are in the “flare3” availability zone and have a display name matching the pattern “flare”, show the availability zone, a label of 'HasInfoCache' if an instance info cache record exists and 'NoInfoCache' otherwise, along with the minimum memory size in MB and the total (sum) of the INSTANCE_EXTRA.ID values. Include a subtotal for the availability zone and a grand total.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC;

SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(ie.ID) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare';

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_total) AS benchmark_avg_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_total, ic.memory_total_variance, b.benchmark_avg_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_total > b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_total < b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(ie.ID) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), InfoCacheStatus AS ( SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic2 WHERE iic2.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID AND iic2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'HasInfoCache' ELSE 'NoInfoCache' END AS info_cache_status, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(ie.ID) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, info_cache_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(info_cache_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE info_cache_status END AS info_cache_status, MIN(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(total_instance_extra_id_sum) AS total_instance_extra_id_sum, (SELECT min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_min_memory_mb, (SELECT total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM inner_cte) AS overall_total_instance_extra_id_sum FROM InfoCacheStatus GROUP BY availability_zone, info_cache_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instance display names on host 'blaze8-12' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' (and considering the availability zone 'flare3' for the max-average-memory calculation), return each display name’s maximum per-display-name average memory (MB), its memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (only for display names with more than one such instance), the overall average of these standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s as a benchmark, and a variability category (HIGH_VARIABILITY/LOW_VARIABILITY/AVERAGE_VARIABILITY) based on that benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% higher than the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% lower than the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH max_avg_mem_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DISPLAY_NAME ), stddev_mem_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.max_avg_memory_mb, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.benchmark, s.variability_category FROM max_avg_mem_by_display_name m JOIN stddev_mem_by_display_name s ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH root_stats_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(i.root_gb) AS overall_avg_root_gb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_root_gb, ic.root_gb_stddev, (ic.avg_root_gb - oa.overall_avg_root_gb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.root_gb_stddev DESC ), instance_metadata_rows AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN ( SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS per_key ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT imr.instance_uuid, imr.display_name, imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.flavor, imr.metadata_key, imr.metadata_value, imr.window_column, imr.total_rows_for_key, imr.avg_rows_per_key, rsbdn.avg_root_gb, rsbdn.root_gb_stddev, rsbdn.deviation_from_overall_avg_root_gb FROM instance_metadata_rows imr JOIN root_stats_by_display_name rsbdn ON rsbdn.display_name = imr.display_name WHERE imr.display_name IN ( SELECT i.display_name FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ORDER BY rsbdn.root_gb_stddev DESC, imr.metadata_key, imr.instance_uuid;
