question: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list each instance UUID and display name with the migration source and destination compute and status, the instance flavor JSON, the dense-rank value (partitioned by migration status) along with its average and deviation from that average, the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following migration rows ordered by migration ID, the instance project ID and that project’s total vCPUs across all non-deleted instances, and compute the ratio of project total vCPUs to the average dense-rank value.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_column, (ic.window_column - ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id, SUM(i_all.vcpus) AS project_total_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instances AS i_all ON i_all.project_id = i.project_id AND i_all.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id ORDER BY project_total_vcpus DESC, inner_cte.uuid ) SELECT q2.uuid AS instance_uuid, q2.display_name AS instance_display_name, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q1.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, q1.window_column AS dense_rank_value, q1.avg_window_column AS avg_dense_rank_value, q1.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS dense_rank_deviation_from_avg, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following, q2.project_id, q2.project_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.project_total_vcpus / NULLIF(q1.avg_window_column, 0), 2) AS project_vcpus_per_avg_dense_rank FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.status = q2.status AND q1.source_compute = q2.source_compute AND q1.dest_compute = q2.dest_compute AND q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY project_vcpus_per_avg_dense_rank DESC, q2.project_total_vcpus DESC, q2.uuid;

sql: WITH MemoryAboveVcpuAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS question: For each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' (and with a non-deleted network info cache record), show the display name, total number of qualifying instances, average instance memory (MB), variance of instance memory (MB), and the maximum (worst-case) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the network info cache update lag (in days) for that display name, including a grand total row. sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name ), lag_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS avg_cache_update_lag, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS cache_update_lag_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_update_lag_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, MAX(cache_update_lag_stddev) AS max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) SELECT mem_stats.display_name, mem_stats.total_instances, mem_stats.avg_memory_mb, mem_stats.memory_mb_variance, lag_stats.max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM mem_stats LEFT JOIN lag_stats ON lag_stats.display_name = mem_stats.display_name ORDER BY mem_stats.display_name;

sql: WITH GeoMeanByAZ AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.availability_zone ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OverallGeoMean AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS overall_geometric_mean FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.geometric_mean > (SELECT overall_geometric_mean FROM OverallGeoMean) ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC ), MaxNetworkCacheInstancesByAZ AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneCounts AS (SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, COUNT(*) AS instances_with_network_cache_on_host FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT availability_zone, MAX(instances_with_network_cache_on_host) AS max_instances_with_network_cache_on_host FROM ZoneCounts GROUP BY availability_zone ) SELECT g.availability_zone, g.geometric_mean AS geometric_mean_instance_memory_mb, m.max_instances_with_network_cache_on_host FROM GeoMeanByAZ g JOIN MaxNetworkCacheInstancesByAZ m ON g.availability_zone = m.availability_zone ORDER BY g.geometric_mean DESC;

sql: WITH root_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_root_gb, inner_cte.root_gb_range, inner_cte.root_gb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.root_gb_range DESC ), migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_total_range > 10000000000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, rs.avg_root_gb, rs.root_gb_range, rs.root_gb_variance, rs.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance FROM migration_stats AS ms JOIN root_stats AS rs ON ms.VM_STATE = rs.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC;

sql: WITH prime_memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, mx.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ) mx ON mx.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mx.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), blaze8_12_state_name_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_counts.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts ) SELECT b.VM_STATE, b.DISPLAY_NAME, b.instance_count, b.min_memory_mb, b.avg_instance_count, p.avg_memory_mb, p.memory_mb_variance, p.max_memory_mb FROM blaze8_12_state_name_counts b JOIN prime_memory_stats p ON p.display_name = b.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY b.VM_STATE, b.DISPLAY_NAME;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_migration_id, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb, b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC ) SELECT q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg, q1.min_migration_id, q1.avg_instance_memory_mb, q1.benchmark, q1.memory_category FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.metadata_records DESC;

SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC;

question: List all instance display names matching the pattern "prime" that either (a) have a 2014-created max memory (MB) over 16000 when grouped by system-metadata key (including subtotals per display name and a grand total), or (b) have completed migrations (with DELETED = 0) whose average instance memory (MB) is above the overall average across such "prime" completed migrations; return the display name, metadata key (when applicable), the metric value, and a reason indicating which condition produced the row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxMemoryRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(`key`) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE `key` END AS `key`, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, `key` WITH ROLLUP ), MigrationMemoryAboveAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT mmr.display_name AS display_name, mmr.`key` AS metadata_key, mmr.max_memory_mb AS metric_value, '2014 Prime Max Memory (Rollup)' AS reason FROM MaxMemoryRollup mmr UNION ALL SELECT mma.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, NULL AS metadata_key, mma.avg_instance_memory_mb AS metric_value, 'Completed Migration Avg Memory Above Overall Avg' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryAboveAvg mma ) SELECT display_name, metadata_key, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY display_name, reason, metadata_key;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(`key`) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE `key` END AS `key`, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, `key` WITH ROLLUP;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 );

question: On host 'blaze8-12', for the top 10 instances that have an instance_system_metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (ranked by total memory processed across all their migrations), show each instance’s UUID, display name, migration status, migration count, total memory processed, and whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) migrations; additionally, for those same instances, include the completed-migration rollup metrics for metadata_key = 'image_image_type' (total migrations and the running sum of migration IDs). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_processed DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN LAG(instance_display_name) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key ORDER BY instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = instance_display_name THEN NULL ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, total_migrations, running_sum_migration_ids FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_migrations, MAX(window_column) AS running_sum_migration_ids FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key, instance_display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.migration_count, q1.total_memory_processed, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.metadata_key, q2.total_migrations, q2.running_sum_migration_ids FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.instance_display_name WHERE q2.metadata_key = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.total_memory_processed DESC, q1.instance_uuid;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_processed DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN LAG(instance_display_name) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key ORDER BY instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = instance_display_name THEN NULL ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, total_migrations, running_sum_migration_ids FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_migrations, MAX(window_column) AS running_sum_migration_ids FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key, instance_display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name;

question: For host "blaze8-12", list each instance that has a completed migration with its display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with (a) the total number of completed migrations on that host and the average number of completed migrations per host across all hosts, and (b) the total memory (MB) by VM state for instances in availability zone "flare3" on "blaze8-12" (only VM states whose summed memory exceeds 50000 MB, including the final TOTAL row). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_name, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.vm_state AS az_host_vm_state, q2.total_memory_mb AS az_host_total_memory_mb FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.UUID, q2.vm_state;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_name, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name;

question: List (1) each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' with its cache-update time coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) as a benchmark, and a variability category, and (2) each instance in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare' with its deviation from the overall average memory (using that overall average as the benchmark), returning a combined result set with a reason indicating which rule produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH prime_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), flare_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory fm ) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name;

question: For instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'blaze8-12', return (by VM state) the average/range/variance of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) and the average/range/variance of ROOT_GB, also showing the overall average of the per-VM-state average ROOT_GB across all VM states; include the subtotal row across all VM states and do not repeat the VM state label when it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH mem_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ), root_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_root_gb, inner_cte.root_gb_range, inner_cte.root_gb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT m.vm_state, m.avg_memory_mb, m.memory_mb_range, m.memory_mb_variance, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance, r.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM mem_by_vm_state AS m LEFT JOIN root_by_vm_state AS r ON r.VM_STATE = m.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.vm_state IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.vm_state;

ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ), instance_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_in_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS state_counts ON inner_cte.vm_state = state_counts.vm_state JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_state_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column AS memory_mb_window_avg, id.total_in_state, id.avg_instances_per_state, md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.flavor, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, md.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank, md.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS migration_dense_rank_deviation FROM instance_details AS id JOIN migration_details AS md ON id.display_name = md.display_name WHERE id.total_in_state > id.avg_instances_per_state ORDER BY id.memory_mb;

sql: WITH top_display_names_by_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), vm_state_display_name_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_counts.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts ) SELECT tdn.DISPLAY_NAME, tdn.min_instance_id, tdn.avg_memory_mb, tdn.has_image_location_metadata, vsd.VM_STATE, vsd.instance_count, vsd.min_memory_mb, vsd.avg_instance_count FROM top_display_names_by_memory AS tdn JOIN vm_state_display_name_counts AS vsd ON vsd.DISPLAY_NAME = tdn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY tdn.avg_memory_mb DESC, vsd.VM_STATE, vsd.instance_count DESC;

sql: WITH prime_migration_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10 ), blaze8_12_memory_by_display AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ) SELECT pms.display_name, pms.memory_total_stddev, pms.has_active_migrations, bmd.min_instance_id, bmd.avg_memory_mb, bmd.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM prime_migration_stddev pms JOIN blaze8_12_memory_by_display bmd ON bmd.DISPLAY_NAME = pms.display_name ORDER BY pms.memory_total_stddev DESC, pms.display_name;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' (considering only non-deleted instances), show each display name’s instance-record count and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB, and also show how many completed migrations for that same display name have a window row number greater than the average window row number across those completed 'prime' migrations (including the final TOTAL row from the memory statistics). sql: WITH memory_stats_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_records, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_records, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ), completed_prime_migrations_above_avg_window AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime') SELECT migration_status, instance_display_name, instance_network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), migration_counts_by_display_name AS ( SELECT cpm.instance_display_name AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_above_avg_window_count FROM completed_prime_migrations_above_avg_window cpm GROUP BY cpm.instance_display_name ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.total_records, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, COALESCE(mcd.completed_migrations_above_avg_window_count, 0) AS completed_migrations_above_avg_window_count FROM memory_stats_by_display_name ms LEFT JOIN migration_counts_by_display_name mcd ON ms.display_name = mcd.display_name ORDER BY ms.display_name;

question: For each instance display name, for instances on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' (and are not deleted where applicable), show the minimum instance ID, the per-display-name average memory (MB), the overall average of those per-display-name average memory values, the per-display-name memory variance, and the deviation of each display name’s average memory from the overall average memory across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ), q2_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb AS q1_avg_memory_mb, q1.avg_of_avg_memory_mb, q2.avg_memory_mb AS q2_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM q1_inner_cte q1 JOIN q2_inner_cte q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name matching the pattern 'prime', show the display name, total number of non-deleted instances that also have a non-deleted network info cache record, the average and variance of their instance memory (in MB), and (when available) the average and variance of instance memory (in MB) for completed migrations where the average memory is greater than 16384 MB. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_instances, q1.avg_memory_mb AS avg_memory_mb_non_deleted_with_netinfo, q1.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance_non_deleted_with_netinfo, q2.avg_memory_mb AS avg_memory_mb_completed_migrations_gt_16384, q2.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance_completed_migrations_gt_16384 FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.display_name;

question: For host "blaze8-12", list each instance that has a completed migration, showing its display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with the total number of completed migrations on that host and the average number of completed migrations per host across all hosts; additionally, attach the availability-zone "flare3" rollup counts for that same host (per-instance SUBTOTAL and GRAND TOTAL labels) including the count of distinct instance extra record IDs and distinct system metadata keys. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, CASE WHEN GROUPING(hostname) = 1 AND GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(hostname) = 1 AND GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE hostname END AS hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_extra_id) AS total_instance_extra_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT metadata_key) AS total_metadata_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_uuid, hostname WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.instance_uuid AS rollup_instance_uuid_label, q2.hostname AS rollup_hostname_label, q2.total_instance_extra_ids, q2.total_metadata_keys FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_uuid = q1.UUID ORDER BY q1.UUID, q2.instance_uuid, q2.hostname;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' that (a) have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and (b) have a non-deleted instance info cache entry and completed migrations, show each display name’s MEMORY_MB range, MEMORY_MB variance, deviation of its memory range from the average memory range across these display names, along with its completed migration count, the average completed migration count benchmark, and its migration category (HIGH_MIGRATION/LOW_MIGRATION/AVERAGE_MIGRATION). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MIGRATION' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_MIGRATION' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION'.
sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC ), migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY migration_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.DISPLAY_NAME, c.migration_count, a.avg_migration_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.migration_count > a.avg_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN c.migration_count < a.avg_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY c.migration_count DESC, c.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb, mig.migration_count, mig.benchmark AS avg_migration_count_benchmark, mig.migration_category FROM mem_stats ms JOIN migration_stats mig ON ms.display_name = mig.display_name ORDER BY mig.migration_category, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC, mig.migration_count DESC, ms.display_name;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' (using only non-deleted instance info cache rows and non-deleted system metadata entries for key 'image_image_type'), show the image type, host migration activity label (Active/Inactive), instance display name, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (GB) with rollup subtotals and a grand total, the row count, and (when the display name matches REGEXP 'prime') the maximum completed-migration memory_total observed for that display name (only when that maximum is greater than 0). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Enriched AS ( SELECT ic.display_name, ism2.value AS image_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS host_migration_status, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND ism2.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_info_caches iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(image_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host_migration_status END AS host_migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Enriched GROUP BY image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name ) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list the VM state (suppressing repeats), instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance extra ID, along with each instance’s system metadata key/value and the per-key row numbering and key-level totals/average; only include rows where the total number of instances in that VM state is more than 75% of the total rows for the corresponding metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN ( SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS per_key ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid ), vm_state_totals AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_vm_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT q2.vm_state, q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, q1.total_rows_for_key, q1.avg_rows_per_key, vst.total_instances_in_vm_state, (vst.total_instances_in_vm_state * 1.0 / NULLIF(q1.total_rows_for_key, 0)) AS vm_state_to_metadata_key_row_ratio FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.instance_uuid JOIN vm_state_totals AS vst ON vst.vm_state = q2.vm_state WHERE (vst.total_instances_in_vm_state * 1.0 / NULLIF(q1.total_rows_for_key, 0)) > 0.75 ORDER BY q2.vm_state, q2.instance_uuid, q1.metadata_key;

question: For each instance display name matching the pattern 'prime', return (1) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total migration memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) across completed migrations along with the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s as a benchmark and a variability category (HIGH_VARIABILITY/LOW_VARIABILITY/AVERAGE_VARIABILITY), and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration counts per instance (grouped by destination compute), plus the total number of non-deleted instances with that display name and the average number of non-deleted instances per 'prime' display name. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH mem_stddev_by_instance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, a.avg_memory_total_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_stddev > a.avg_memory_total_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_stddev < a.avg_memory_total_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ), migration_count_stats_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev, COUNT(i2.id) AS total_instances_with_display_name, avg_name_counts.avg_instance_count_per_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_display_name FROM ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS instance_count FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0 AND display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY display_name ) AS sub ) AS avg_name_counts GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev, avg_name_counts.avg_instance_count_per_display_name ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_count_range DESC ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_total_stddev, ms.benchmark AS avg_memory_total_stddev_benchmark, ms.variability_category, mc.migration_count_range, mc.migration_count_variance, mc.migration_count_stddev, mc.total_instances_with_display_name, mc.avg_instance_count_per_display_name FROM mem_stddev_by_instance ms JOIN migration_count_stats_by_display_name mc ON mc.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY ms.memory_total_stddev DESC, mc.migration_count_range DESC, ms.display_name;

question: For instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have completed migrations, return only those instances that (1) have at least one (display name, migration status, created-at) group whose maximum migration MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than the overall average of these per-group maxima (and greater than 0), and (2) have an average instance MEMORY_MB (for completed, not-deleted instances) greater than the overall average of those per-instance averages; show the instance display name, migration status, per-group maximum MEMORY_TOTAL, migration created timestamp, minimum migration ID, and average instance memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Q1_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), AvgOfGroupMax AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) AS avg_group_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT avg_group_max_memory_total FROM AvgOfGroupMax) ), Q2_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.status, q1.max_memory_total, q1.created_at, q2.min_migration_id, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM Q1_inner_cte q1 JOIN Q2_inner_cte q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME;
sub_questions: For each instance display name and migration status, show the maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) among its migrations and the migration created timestamp, considering only migrations with status = 'completed', only for instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', and where the maximum total memory is greater than 0.

For each instance display name, what is the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory (in MB) for migrations where the migration status is 'completed', the instance is not deleted (DELETED = 0), and the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime'?

For each instance display name and migration status, considering only completed migrations for instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and where the maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 0, list only those instance/status/created-at groups whose maximum total memory is greater than the overall average of these per-group maximum total memory values; show the instance display name, migration status, per-group maximum total memory, and the migration created timestamp.

For each instance display name, show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory (in MB) for completed migrations where the instance is not deleted (DELETED = 0) and the display name matches the pattern 'prime', but only include those instance display names whose average instance memory is greater than the overall average instance memory across all such matching completed migrations.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0;

SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), AvgOfGroupMax AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) AS avg_group_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT avg_group_max_memory_total FROM AvgOfGroupMax);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 );

question: On host 'blaze8-12', list (1) each (instance display name, metadata key) group for non-deleted instances whose maximum MEMORY_MB is above the overall average of these per-group maxima (also showing that max memory and the launched timestamp), and (2) each (VM state, display name) group for instances with more than 8 VCPUs (showing instance count, the group’s minimum MEMORY_MB, and how far that minimum is above the overall minimum); return all rows together with a “Reason” indicating which rule produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxMemoryGroups AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), MaxMemoryAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM MaxMemoryAverages) ), VcpuMinMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om ), CombinedInstanceInsights AS ( SELECT mmg.DISPLAY_NAME, mmg.metadata_key, mmg.max_memory_mb, mmg.LAUNCHED_AT, NULL AS VM_STATE, NULL AS instance_count, NULL AS min_memory_mb, NULL AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min, 'High Max Memory Group' AS Reason FROM MaxMemoryGroups mmg UNION ALL SELECT vms.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS max_memory_mb, NULL AS LAUNCHED_AT, vms.VM_STATE, vms.instance_count, vms.min_memory_mb, vms.min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min, 'VCPU>8 Min Memory Stats' AS Reason FROM VcpuMinMemoryStats vms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceInsights ORDER BY DISPLAY_NAME, Reason;

SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), MaxMemoryAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM MaxMemoryAverages);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are hosted on “blaze8-12”, show each migration’s ID and instance display name along with the instance memory (MB), the running sum of instance memory (MB) within the completed-status group ordered by migration ID, and the deviation of that running sum from the overall average running-sum value; additionally, for the same instances (non-deleted, in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12”), include the instance UUID, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows, the overall average memory benchmark, and the instance’s memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH migration_memory_analysis AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), instance_memory_benchmark AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.max_instance_id_next_2, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ) SELECT mma.migration_id, mma.instance_display_name, mma.instance_memory_mb, mma.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mma.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imb.instance_uuid, imb.display_name, imb.vm_state, imb.power_state, imb.memory_mb, imb.vcpus, imb.instance_extra_id, imb.max_instance_id_next_2, imb.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, imb.memory_category FROM migration_memory_analysis mma JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = mma.instance_display_name JOIN instance_memory_benchmark imb ON imb.instance_uuid = i.UUID;
