SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.max_instance_id_next_2, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am;

question: For instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' (and having a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), show only those display names whose average instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average of these per-display-name averages, and for each such display name return its average memory, memory variance, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING across completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), mig_cv AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS sort_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, mc.coefficient_of_variation FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mig_cv mc ON ms.display_name = mc.display_name ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_variance DESC;

For each instance display name, list the display name, the coefficient of variation of the instance’s migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) across its completed migrations (STATUS = 'completed') for instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', and include a final TOTAL row that aggregates across all such instances. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS sort_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name;

question: For completed migrations of instances hosted on 'blaze8-12', show the migration id, instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, system metadata key and value, the running average migration id within each instance UUID (ordered by migration id), and (per instance UUID) the total number of system metadata rows and the average of those running-average values; also include the host-level memory rollup fields for the same instance display name on host 'blaze8-12' (memory status label, number of display-name rows, and average geometric-mean memory in MB). sql: WITH migration_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY ic.memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column, am.avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.instance_memory_mb > am.avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.instance_memory_mb < am.avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ) SELECT q2.migration_id, q2.instance_display_name, q2.instance_memory_mb, q2.window_column, q2.benchmark, q2.memory_category, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.display_name;

question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list the VM state, the number of instances, the total vCPUs, the maximum memory (MB) used by any instance in that VM state, and compute the max-to-average memory ratio (max memory divided by the average memory for that VM state, rounded to 2 decimals) along with the average deviation from overall average memory (rounded to 2 decimals).
sql: WITH max_mem_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, MAX(inner_cte.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE ), instance_mem_deviation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_mem AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_mem am ) SELECT imd.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS instance_count, SUM(imd.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, mmbs.max_memory_mb, ROUND(mmbs.max_memory_mb / NULLIF(AVG(imd.memory_mb), 0), 2) AS max_to_avg_memory_ratio, ROUND(AVG(imd.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb), 2) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM instance_mem_deviation imd JOIN max_mem_by_state mmbs ON imd.vm_state = mmbs.VM_STATE GROUP BY imd.vm_state, mmbs.max_memory_mb ORDER BY max_to_avg_memory_ratio DESC;

question: For instances hosted on “blaze8-12”, return the instance display name, the minimum instance ID, the average memory (MB), and the average memory utilization ratio (average memory divided by the maximum memory for that display name) for instances that are either in VM state “shelved_offloaded” or have at least 8 VCPUs and are in availability zone “flare3”; and, for the same display names, also include the completed migration details (instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, migration status) where the windowed minimum instance memory (over 3 preceding and 1 following migrations ordered by migration ID) is greater than the average of that windowed minimum across all such migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE (i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' OR i.VCPUS >= 8) AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) AS avg_memory_utilization_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT uuid, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, status, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.avg_memory_utilization_ratio, q2.uuid AS migration_instance_uuid, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS windowed_min_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name;

sql: WITH az_host_vmstate_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP), completed_migration_windowed AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(max_migration_id_next2) AS avg_max_migration_id_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.HOSTNAME, ic.VM_STATE, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.VCPUS, ic.UUID, ic.STATUS, ic.max_migration_id_next2, ac.avg_max_migration_id_next2, (ic.max_migration_id_next2 - ac.avg_max_migration_id_next2) AS deviation_from_avg_max_migration_id_next2 FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac) SELECT (SELECT total_instances FROM az_host_vmstate_rollup WHERE vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL') AS flare3_blaze8_12_total_instances, (SELECT total_memory_mb FROM az_host_vmstate_rollup WHERE vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL') AS flare3_blaze8_12_total_memory_mb, (SELECT total_vcpus FROM az_host_vmstate_rollup WHERE vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL') AS flare3_blaze8_12_total_vcpus, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_instances_on_blaze8_12, AVG(max_migration_id_next2) AS avg_windowed_max_migration_id_next2, AVG(deviation_from_avg_max_migration_id_next2) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_windowed_max_migration_id_next2 FROM completed_migration_windowed WHERE UUID IN ( SELECT i.UUID FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' );

question: Return (1) the per–instance display name memory variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) summary (including the final TOTAL row) for instances that have system metadata key = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'prime-35', together with (2) the detailed list of completed migrations whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12' (including the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average memory, the overall benchmark of that windowed average, and the HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE memory category), by outputting both result sets side-by-side via a cross join. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS benchmark_window_avg FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.window_column, b.benchmark_window_avg AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > b.benchmark_window_avg * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.window_column < b.benchmark_window_avg * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY ic.migration_id ) SELECT q1.display_name AS instance_display_name, q1.total_instances, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q2.migration_id, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.dest_host, q2.memory_mb AS migration_instance_memory_mb, q2.window_column AS migration_window_avg_memory_mb, q2.benchmark AS migration_window_avg_benchmark, q2.memory_category FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS benchmark_window_avg FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.window_column, b.benchmark_window_avg AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > b.benchmark_window_avg * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.window_column < b.benchmark_window_avg * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY ic.migration_id;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_memory_mb, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migration_id ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT display_name, migrations FROM inner_cte WHERE migrations > (SELECT AVG(migrations) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migrations DESC ) SELECT q1.migration_id, q1.instance_display_name, q1.instance_memory_mb, q1.window_column AS running_instance_memory_mb_within_status, q2.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.migrations DESC, q1.migration_id;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, list each instance display name along with (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for completed migrations and its deviation from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and (2) the image_image_type metadata value and cached network info, including the overall average metadata value length benchmark and whether the value is categorized as LONG_VALUE, SHORT_VALUE, or AVERAGE_VALUE. Do not return any rounded answers. A category of LONG_VALUE (at least 50% longer than average), SHORT_VALUE (at least 50% shorter than average), or AVERAGE_VALUE.
sql: WITH cov_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), meta_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), AvgValueLen AS (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(metadata_value)) AS avg_value_len FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, av.avg_value_len AS benchmark, CASE WHEN LENGTH(ic.metadata_value) > av.avg_value_len * 1.5 THEN 'LONG_VALUE' WHEN LENGTH(ic.metadata_value) < av.avg_value_len * 0.5 THEN 'SHORT_VALUE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VALUE' END AS value_length_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgValueLen av ) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.coefficient_of_variation, c.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation, m.metadata_value, m.NETWORK_INFO, m.benchmark AS avg_metadata_value_length_benchmark, m.value_length_category FROM meta_inner_cte m JOIN cov_inner_cte c ON c.display_name = m.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH memory_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.total_memory_mb, a.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > a.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < a.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), root_gb_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS benchmark_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.avg_root_gb, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, b.benchmark_avg_root_gb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_root_gb > b.benchmark_avg_root_gb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROOT_GB' WHEN ic.avg_root_gb < b.benchmark_avg_root_gb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROOT_GB' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROOT_GB' END AS root_gb_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ) SELECT mbs.VM_STATE, mbs.total_memory_mb, mbs.benchmark AS memory_benchmark, mbs.memory_category, rgs.avg_root_gb, rgs.root_gb_range, rgs.root_gb_variance, rgs.benchmark AS root_gb_benchmark, rgs.root_gb_category FROM memory_by_state mbs JOIN root_gb_by_state rgs ON mbs.VM_STATE = rgs.vm_state ORDER BY mbs.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For host "blaze8-12", list (with subtotals per VM state and a grand total) the VM state, power state, and number of distinct non-deleted instances (using only non-deleted system metadata rows), and also show for each VM state the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_REMAINING for completed migrations and the count of completed migrations contributing to that statistic. sql: WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS ( SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' (considering only non-deleted instances), list each display name (suppressing repeats), the number of matching instance records, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name, and also show the overall average of the per-display-name MEMORY_MB ranges across all such display names (with a final TOTAL row). sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_records, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_records, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_ranges ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_records, q1.memory_mb_range, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q2.avg_memory_mb_range FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.display_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.display_name;

Do not return any rounded answers. Whose display name matches the pattern "prime".
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ism2.value) AS distinct_image_types FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), AverageVariance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageVariance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q1.distinct_image_types, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances hosted on blaze8-12 that have a system metadata entry with key image_image_type, show the instances whose average memory usage is more than 75% of the maximum memory observed among those instances, and for each such instance return the display name, average memory, memory variance, the maximum memory used for the comparison, plus the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, the row-number window column, and how the metadata value deviates from the average metadata value across all returned rows. sql: WITH mem_threshold AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), max_mem AS ( SELECT MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, mm.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN max_mem mm WHERE (ic.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mm.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC ), meta_network_deviation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_meta AS ( SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS REAL)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS REAL) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta am ) SELECT mt.display_name, mt.avg_memory_mb, mt.memory_mb_variance, mt.max_memory_mb, mnd.metadata_value, mnd.NETWORK_INFO, mnd.window_column, mnd.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM mem_threshold mt JOIN meta_network_deviation mnd ON mt.display_name = mnd.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY mt.avg_memory_mb DESC, mnd.window_column;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om ) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.instance_count AS image_image_type_instance_count, q2.instance_count AS high_vcpu_instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb AS high_vcpu_min_memory_mb, q2.min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.vm_state ORDER BY q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME;

sql: WITH MigrationMemoryWindow AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), InstanceMemoryVarianceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_variance - a.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stats a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.instance_display_name, mmw.instance_memory_mb, mmw.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mmw.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imvs.memory_mb_variance, imvs.memory_mb_stddev, imvs.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryWindow mmw JOIN InstanceMemoryVarianceStats imvs ON mmw.instance_display_name = imvs.display_name ORDER BY mmw.migration_id;

question: For each active migration status (excluding 'accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', and 'completed') for instances whose system metadata key is 'image_image_type', show the status, the total migration memory processed (only where the total is greater than 0), the overall average of those per-status totals as a benchmark, the status’s memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY relative to the benchmark), and the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for instances with that migration status. Do not return any rounded answers. Only include statuses where the total processed memory is greater than 0.
sql: WITH mem_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > 0 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_processed) AS avg_total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.total_memory_processed, a.avg_total_memory_processed AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_processed > a.avg_total_memory_processed * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_processed < a.avg_total_memory_processed * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), instance_mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status_name) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status_name) = status_name THEN NULL ELSE status_name END AS status, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status_name ) SELECT mbs.status, mbs.total_memory_processed, mbs.benchmark, mbs.memory_category, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_by_status mbs JOIN instance_mem_stats ims ON ims.status = mbs.status;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT instance_uuid AS entity_id, instance_display_name AS entity_name, metadata_key AS detail_key, metadata_value AS detail_value, network_info AS detail_blob, window_column AS metric_1, NULL AS metric_2, NULL AS metric_3, NULL AS metric_4, 'Image-type metadata rows with above-average windowed memory on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS entity_id, inner_cte2.display_name AS entity_name, NULL AS detail_key, NULL AS detail_value, NULL AS detail_blob, inner_cte2.memory_mb_range AS metric_1, inner_cte2.memory_mb_variance AS metric_2, inner_cte2.memory_mb_stddev AS metric_3, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range AS metric_4, 'Prime display names (not deleted) with memory spread stats' AS reason FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte2 ) AS avg_ranges ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, metric_1 DESC, entity_name, entity_id;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.INSTANCE_UUID, q1.instance_display_name, q1.max_running_avg_migration_id, q2.total_instances, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM (SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name ORDER BY max_running_avg_migration_id DESC) AS q1 JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) AS q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.max_running_avg_migration_id DESC;

sql: WITH FlareNetworkInfoOutliers AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), NetworkInfoAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) * 1.0) AS avg_network_info_len FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) > (SELECT avg_network_info_len FROM NetworkInfoAverages) ), PrimeMigrationVariability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ic.memory_total_stddev, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), PrimeInstancesInFlare3 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name FROM instances i WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT pif.display_name, pmv.memory_total_range, pmv.memory_total_variance, pmv.memory_total_stddev, pmv.benchmark, pmv.variability_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT fno.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Above_Average_Flare_NetworkInfo_Length FROM PrimeInstancesInFlare3 pif JOIN PrimeMigrationVariability pmv ON pif.display_name = pmv.display_name LEFT JOIN FlareNetworkInfoOutliers fno ON pif.instance_uuid = fno.instance_uuid GROUP BY pif.display_name, pmv.memory_total_range, pmv.memory_total_variance, pmv.memory_total_stddev, pmv.benchmark, pmv.variability_category ORDER BY pmv.memory_total_range DESC;

sql: WITH memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC ), host_max_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name, launched_at) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, max_memory_mb, launched_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, MAX(launched_at) AS launched_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, launched_at ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb, hmm.max_memory_mb, hmm.launched_at FROM memory_stats ms JOIN host_max_memory hmm ON ms.display_name = hmm.display_name ORDER BY ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC, hmm.launched_at;

sql: WITH sq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.FLAVOR, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.MEMORY_MB > 16384), sq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sq1.INSTANCE_UUID) AS blaze8_12_non_deleted_instances_over_16gb_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sq2.display_name) AS top10_prime_display_names_in_flare3_count FROM sq1 CROSS JOIN sq2;

For non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance extra flavor JSON, the system metadata key, and the dense rank (partitioned by the system metadata key and ordered by that key), and only keep rows where the instance has more than 16 GB of memory.

From the top 10 instance display names with the largest instance-memory range (in MB) among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, are in availability zone 'flare3', and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', show each display name, the memory range, variance, and standard deviation, along with the total vCPUs and total memory across those instances.
sub_sqls: SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.FLAVOR, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.MEMORY_MB > 16384;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state and instance display name that (a) has more than 8 VCPUs and is running on host "blaze8-12" and (b) also has completed migrations for a non-deleted instance whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', show the instance count, the minimum memory (MB) and its deviation from the overall minimum, along with the minimum migration ID, the average instance memory (MB), the benchmark average memory, and the benchmark-based memory category for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_migration_id, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb, b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min, q2.min_migration_id, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.benchmark, q2.memory_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME;

SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_migration_id, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb, b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b;

question: For instances on host 'blaze8-12' that have a completed migration, return only those whose migration destination compute appears more than once, and (among those) keep only instances whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of instances in the same availability zone on that host; show the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, the dense-rank-within-instance value, the destination compute, and the row number ordered by destination compute (with a 2-preceding/1-following window frame). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.STATUS, i.DEST_COMPUTE, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS dest_compute_cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) dc ON i.DEST_COMPUTE = dc.DEST_COMPUTE WHERE dc.dest_compute_cnt > 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneVcpuAverages AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i2.vcpus > (SELECT avg_vcpus FROM ZoneVcpuAverages WHERE ZoneVcpuAverages.availability_zone = i2.availability_zone) ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.availability_zone, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.migration_type, q2.uuid AS instance_uuid, q2.window_column AS dense_rank_within_instance, q1.dest_compute, q1.window_column AS row_number_by_dest_compute FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name AND q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY q2.availability_zone, q1.dest_compute, q2.display_name;

For each instance that has a completed migration and is running on host "blaze8-12", show the instance display name, its availability zone, the migration status, the migration type, and the instance UUID, along with a dense rank of migrations within each instance UUID ordered by that UUID.

For instances that have a migration with status equal to 'completed' and whose instance host is 'blaze8-12', list the instance display name, the migration status, and the migration destination compute host, and assign row numbers ordered by the destination compute with a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row; then return only those rows whose destination compute appears more than once among these results.

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.STATUS, i.DEST_COMPUTE, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS dest_compute_cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) dc ON i.DEST_COMPUTE = dc.DEST_COMPUTE WHERE dc.dest_compute_cnt > 1;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneVcpuAverages AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i2.vcpus > (SELECT avg_vcpus FROM ZoneVcpuAverages WHERE ZoneVcpuAverages.availability_zone = i2.availability_zone);

question: For each VM state that (1) has more than 50,000 MB of total instance memory in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12” and (2) also exceeds the non-deleted host-level benchmark on “blaze8-12”, list the VM state, the total memory and benchmark used for the “flare3”+host rollup (with its HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE memory category), and the total memory and benchmark used for the non-deleted host rollup (with its ABOVE_BENCHMARK/NOT_ABOVE_BENCHMARK category). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH az_host_memory_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.total_memory_mb, a.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > a.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < a.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), host_nondeleted_memory_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) AS benchmark_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.total_memory_mb, b.benchmark_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > b.benchmark_memory_mb THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'NOT_ABOVE_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ) SELECT a.VM_STATE, a.total_memory_mb AS az_host_total_memory_mb, a.benchmark AS az_host_avg_total_memory_benchmark_mb, a.memory_category AS az_host_memory_category, h.total_memory_mb AS host_nondeleted_total_memory_mb, h.benchmark AS host_nondeleted_benchmark_memory_mb, h.benchmark_category AS host_nondeleted_benchmark_category FROM az_host_memory_by_state a JOIN host_nondeleted_memory_by_state h ON a.VM_STATE = h.vm_state ORDER BY a.total_memory_mb DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000;

SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.total_memory_mb, a.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > a.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < a.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) AS benchmark_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.total_memory_mb, b.benchmark_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > b.benchmark_memory_mb THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'NOT_ABOVE_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, return the instance UUID, instance display name, metadata key and value, cached network info, and the windowed average instance memory (MB) over 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by metadata value and ordered by instance created-at), but only for rows where that windowed average is above the overall average of the same windowed average; additionally, only keep instances whose display name is among the top 10 (matching the regular expression prime) with the most image_image_type system metadata records (considering only non-deleted instances), and include each such display name’s metadata record count and its deviation from the top-10 average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, metadata_key, metadata_value, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY window_column DESC, instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.network_info, q1.window_column, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.window_column DESC, q2.metadata_records DESC, q1.instance_uuid;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT;

SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, metadata_key, metadata_value, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY window_column DESC, instance_uuid;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state (suppressing repeats when ordered by VM state then UUID), memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance extra ID, along with the instance extra flavor JSON and each system metadata key/value. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN ( SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS per_key ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid ) SELECT subq2.vm_state, subq2.instance_uuid, subq2.display_name, subq2.memory_mb, subq2.vcpus, subq2.instance_extra_id, subq2.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, subq1.flavor, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.metadata_value, subq1.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, subq1.total_rows_for_key, subq1.avg_rows_per_key FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq1.instance_uuid = subq2.instance_uuid ORDER BY subq2.vm_state, subq2.instance_uuid, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column;
