question: For host 'blaze8-12' in availability zone 'flare3', for each VM state that (a) has more than 50,000 MB of total instance memory and (b) has completed-migration memory_total_range greater than 10,000,000,000, list the VM state, the total instance memory (MB), the completed-migration memory_total_range and memory_total_variance, and compute the range-per-MB ratio (memory_total_range divided by total instance memory), ordered by memory_total_range descending.
sql: WITH mem_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_name, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ), migration_stats_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_total_range > 10000000000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT mbs.vm_state, mbs.total_memory_mb, msbs.memory_total_range, msbs.memory_total_variance, ROUND(msbs.memory_total_range / NULLIF(mbs.total_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS range_per_mb_of_instance_memory FROM mem_by_state AS mbs JOIN migration_stats_by_state AS msbs ON mbs.vm_state = msbs.VM_STATE WHERE mbs.vm_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY msbs.memory_total_range DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.POWER_STATE = 4 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON ic2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DELETED = 0 AND i2.POWER_STATE = 4 AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND i2.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME AND ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT IS NOT NULL AND ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_migration_context FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.has_migration_context, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.avg_memory_mb DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_counts.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.has_image_location_metadata, q2.VM_STATE, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb, q2.avg_instance_count FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.avg_memory_mb DESC, q2.instance_count DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME;

SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_counts.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts;

question: For host "blaze8-12", what are the VM-state/display-name NUMA rollups (including subtotals per VM state and a grand total) for instances with more than 8 VCPUs—showing NUMA status, instance count, and minimum memory (MB)—and, for each VM state, what is the maximum memory (MB) used by any instance in availability zone "flare3" on that same host? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH max_mem_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, MAX(inner_cte.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE ), numa_rollup_by_state_display AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), NumaStatus AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, CASE WHEN ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NOT NULL AND ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '' THEN 'Has NUMA' ELSE 'No NUMA' END AS numa_status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS total_instances, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE AND ic.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, numa_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DISPLAY_NAME END AS DISPLAY_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(numa_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE numa_status END AS numa_status, SUM(total_instances) AS instance_count, MIN(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb FROM NumaStatus GROUP BY VM_STATE, DISPLAY_NAME, numa_status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT n.VM_STATE, n.DISPLAY_NAME, n.numa_status, n.instance_count, n.min_memory_mb, m.max_memory_mb FROM numa_rollup_by_state_display n LEFT JOIN max_mem_by_state m ON n.VM_STATE = m.VM_STATE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), NumaStatus AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, CASE WHEN ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NOT NULL AND ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '' THEN 'Has NUMA' ELSE 'No NUMA' END AS numa_status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS total_instances, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE AND ic.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, numa_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DISPLAY_NAME END AS DISPLAY_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(numa_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE numa_status END AS numa_status, SUM(total_instances) AS instance_count, MIN(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb FROM NumaStatus GROUP BY VM_STATE, DISPLAY_NAME, numa_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12” that are also among the 10 instances on host “blaze8-12” with the highest number of system metadata rows, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (by instance ID). Also include the overall average memory (MB) across these instances and a memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY), along with each instance’s system metadata key/value, the dense rank within the instance UUID, and the total system metadata row count. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH meta_top10 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.value, inner_cte.window_column, meta_counts.total_metadata_rows FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.uuid, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid ORDER BY total_metadata_rows DESC LIMIT 10 ) AS meta_counts ON inner_cte.uuid = meta_counts.uuid ORDER BY meta_counts.total_metadata_rows DESC, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.key ), instance_memory_benchmark AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.max_instance_id_next_2, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ) SELECT imb.instance_uuid, imb.display_name, imb.vm_state, imb.power_state, imb.memory_mb, imb.vcpus, imb.instance_extra_id, imb.max_instance_id_next_2, imb.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, imb.memory_category, mt.total_metadata_rows, mt.key AS system_metadata_key, mt.value AS system_metadata_value, mt.window_column AS metadata_dense_rank_within_instance FROM instance_memory_benchmark AS imb JOIN meta_top10 AS mt ON mt.uuid = imb.instance_uuid ORDER BY mt.total_metadata_rows DESC, imb.instance_uuid, mt.key;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For host 'blaze8-12' in availability zone 'flare3', among the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations, show each display name’s completed migration count, total vCPUs, total memory (MB), whether any instance under that display name has an active (non-completed) migration, and for the matching instances list the instance UUID, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance extra record ID, the row number within each VM state ordered by UUID, the benchmark average vCPUs, and the vCPU category (HIGH_VCPU/LOW_VCPU/AVERAGE_VCPU). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_VCPU' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VCPU' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VCPU'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.migrations AS completed_migrations, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.migrations ORDER BY ic.migrations DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), avg_vcpu AS ( SELECT AVG(vcpus) AS avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, av.avg_vcpus AS benchmark_avg_vcpus, CASE WHEN ic.vcpus > av.avg_vcpus * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VCPU' WHEN ic.vcpus < av.avg_vcpus * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VCPU' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VCPU' END AS vcpu_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_vcpu av ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.completed_migrations, q1.total_vcpus AS total_vcpus_for_display_name, q1.total_memory_mb AS total_memory_mb_for_display_name, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.instance_uuid, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.window_column, q2.benchmark_avg_vcpus, q2.vcpu_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.completed_migrations DESC, q1.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.window_column, q2.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_rollup AS ( SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, sql: WITH flare_networkinfo_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), NetworkInfoAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) * 1.0) AS avg_network_info_len FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) > (SELECT avg_network_info_len FROM NetworkInfoAverages) ), prime_migration_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ic.memory_total_stddev, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare_networkinfo_above_avg) AS flare_instances_above_avg_network_info_len_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prime_migration_variability WHERE variability_category = 'HIGH_VARIABILITY') AS prime_high_variability_instance_count;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_range_mb, q2.memory_variance_mb, q2.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC, q1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH GeomMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ), SystemMetaStatsByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances, MAX(inner_cte.meta_count_range) AS meta_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.meta_count_variance) AS meta_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.meta_count_stddev) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ) SELECT g.display_name, g.total_instances AS instances_with_nonempty_cached_network_info, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, s.meta_count_range, s.meta_count_variance, s.meta_count_stddev FROM GeomMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS g JOIN SystemMetaStatsByDisplayName AS s ON g.display_name = s.display_name WHERE g.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

sql: WITH MetaPrimeMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), CompletedMigrationPrimeMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT cm.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, cm.avg_memory_mb AS completed_migration_avg_memory_mb, cm.memory_mb_variance AS completed_migration_memory_mb_variance, mp.avg_memory_mb AS metadata_avg_memory_mb, mp.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationPrimeMemoryStats cm JOIN MetaPrimeMemoryStats mp ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = mp.display_name ORDER BY cm.memory_mb_variance DESC, mp.memory_mb_variance DESC, display_name;

sql: WITH migration_stats_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_total_range > 10000000000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_range DESC ), geomean_memory_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance, gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, gm.instance_count FROM migration_stats_by_vm_state AS ms JOIN geomean_memory_by_vm_state AS gm ON gm.vm_state = ms.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.STATUS, i.DEST_COMPUTE, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS dest_compute_cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) dc ON i.DEST_COMPUTE = dc.DEST_COMPUTE WHERE dc.dest_compute_cnt > 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneVcpuAverages AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i2.vcpus > (SELECT avg_vcpus FROM ZoneVcpuAverages WHERE ZoneVcpuAverages.availability_zone = i2.availability_zone) ) SELECT q2.availability_zone, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.uuid) AS Instance_Count FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name AND q1.status = q2.status WHERE q2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY q2.availability_zone HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY Instance_Count DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, avg_stddevs.avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_stddevs ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ), instance_counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.display_name) AS instances_with_high_stddev_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.display_name) AS instances_with_high_max_memory_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ) SELECT instance_counts.instances_with_high_stddev_count, instance_counts.instances_with_high_max_memory_count FROM instance_counts;

question: List the instance display name for completed migrations where the instance display name matches the regular expression 'prime', returning a combined report that includes (1) each display name’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) along with the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and (2) each (display name, status) whose maximum migration total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 0 and also greater than the overall average of these per-(display name, status) maxima; include a “reason” column indicating whether the row comes from the CoV metric or the above-average max total memory metric. sql: WITH cov_results AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), max_mem_results AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ), CombinedInstanceMetrics AS ( SELECT cr.display_name, NULL AS status, cr.coefficient_of_variation, cr.avg_coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS max_memory_total, 'High Memory Remaining Variability (CoV)' AS reason FROM cov_results cr UNION ALL SELECT mmr.display_name, mmr.status, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, mmr.max_memory_total, 'Above-Average Max Total Memory' AS reason FROM max_mem_results mmr ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceMetrics ORDER BY display_name, reason;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list each VM state (including a grand total) with the total number of instances, total memory (MB), total vCPUs, the number of completed migrations for that VM state on "blaze8-12", the overall average completed-migration count per VM state, the completed-migrations count for shelved_offloaded instances, and the completed-migrations-per-instance ratio (completed migrations for the state divided by total instances for the state).
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_state, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ON 1 = 1 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_state FROM ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS state_migration_count FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i2.VM_STATE ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances ) SELECT q1.vm_state, q1.total_instances, q1.total_memory_mb, q1.total_vcpus, q2.completed_migrations_for_state, q2.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, q2.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances, ROUND(q2.completed_migrations_for_state / NULLIF(q1.total_instances, 0), 4) AS completed_migrations_per_instance_ratio FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.vm_state;

question: For instances with a system metadata entry where KEY = 'image_image_type' that are running on host 'prime-35' and have a maximum memory greater than 16000 MB, list each instance display name (with repeated display names suppressed as in the subtotal output), its maximum memory (MB), and launched time, and also include (when available for that same display name among display names matching the pattern 'prime') the memory range and variance of MEMORY_MB across instances plus how far that memory range deviates from the average memory range across all such 'prime' display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name, launched_at) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, max_memory_mb, launched_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, MAX(launched_at) AS launched_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, launched_at ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.max_memory_mb, q2.launched_at, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name WHERE q2.max_memory_mb > 16000 ORDER BY q2.display_name, q2.launched_at;

question: For instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', show (for the top 10 display names by system-metadata record count among non-deleted instances) each display name’s metadata record count, its deviation from the average metadata record count across those top 10, and—only when that display name’s average memory exceeds the overall average of per-display-name average memory—the display name’s average memory (MB) and memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MB). sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_records, q1.deviation_from_avg, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.metadata_records DESC;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' (and having a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), show each display name and migration status (including subtotals per display name and a grand total) along with the variance of instance memory (MB) across migrations, and also show the average and variance of MEMORY_TOTAL across completed migrations plus the overall benchmark average and the resulting memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), DisplayNameStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 WHERE m2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_status, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM DisplayNameStatus GROUP BY display_name, migration_status WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_total) AS benchmark_avg_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_total, ic.memory_total_variance, b.benchmark_avg_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_total > b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_total < b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.memory_mb_variance, q2.avg_memory_total, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.benchmark, q2.memory_category FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.display_name = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN q1.migration_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.display_name, q1.migration_status;

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12", for each VM state and display name where the instances have more than 8 VCPUs and the group’s minimum memory is at least 75% of the maximum minimum-memory value across all such groups, return the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), the minimum-memory-to-max ratio, and the maximum geometric mean instance memory (MB) for that display name computed from instances with non-empty cached network information. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeomMeanByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name ORDER BY max_geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), MinMemoryGroups AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) >= 0.75) SELECT mmg.VM_STATE, mmg.DISPLAY_NAME, mmg.instance_count, mmg.min_memory_mb, mmg.min_memory_vs_max_ratio, gmbdn.max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM MinMemoryGroups AS mmg JOIN GeomMeanByDisplayName AS gmbdn ON mmg.DISPLAY_NAME = gmbdn.display_name ORDER BY mmg.min_memory_vs_max_ratio DESC, gmbdn.max_geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, mmg.instance_count DESC;

AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ), vmstate_migration_activity_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VmStateMigrationActivity AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 WHERE m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID AND m2.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity, AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES i JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, migration_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity END AS migration_activity, AVG(avg_memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM VmStateMigrationActivity GROUP BY VM_STATE, migration_activity WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT isr.vm_state, isr.total_instances, isr.total_memory_mb, isr.total_vcpus, vmar.migration_activity, vmar.avg_memory_total_variance FROM instance_state_rollup AS isr LEFT JOIN vmstate_migration_activity_rollup AS vmar ON vmar.VM_STATE = isr.vm_state ORDER BY isr.vm_state, vmar.migration_activity;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance display name, show the total root disk size (in GB) across instances that have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type' (only keeping display names where this total exceeds 50 GB), along with the overall average of these per-display-name totals and the deviation of each display name’s total from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), avg_totals AS ( SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals at;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, calculate the total root disk size (in GB) across instances that have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type', and only include display names where the summed root disk size is greater than 50 GB.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", find each system metadata key and the maximum vCPUs among instances that have that key, using the per-instance metadata listing (with row numbers per key ordered by instance UUID) as an inner CTE. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT metadata_key, MAX(vcpus) AS max_vcpus_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key;
sub_questions: For instances in availability zone "flare3", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the associated system metadata key and value, and assign row numbers within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3';

question: For each security group name whose total number of ports covered across its TCP rules is greater than 100, list the security group name and total ports covered, but only include those security groups whose total ports covered is greater than the average total ports covered across all such security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100 ) SELECT security_group_name, total_ports_covered FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ports_covered > (SELECT AVG(total_ports_covered) FROM inner_cte);
sub_questions: For each security group name, calculate the total number of ports covered (sum of TO_PORT minus FROM_PORT plus 1) across its TCP rules.
sub_sqls: SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100;

question: For instances whose total memory (summed across their records) is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), list the instance UUID, the total memory (in MB), and the instance hostname. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, i.hostname FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid;
sub_questions: For each instance, return the instance UUID and the total amount of memory (in MB) across its records, considering only instances whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (computed over all instances).
sub_sqls: SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances );

question: For each instance VM state and display name (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB), along with the deviation of that minimum memory from the overall average of these per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state and display name, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB).
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each instance display name and system-metadata key, show the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were created in 2014 and have a maximum memory greater than 16000; also include the overall average of these per-(display name, key) maximums as a benchmark and label each group as 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' if its maximum is at least 20% higher than the benchmark, 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' if it is at least 20% lower, or 'NEAR_BENCHMARK' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb) AS avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.key, ic.max_memory_mb, b.avg_of_group_max_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.max_memory_mb >= b.avg_of_group_max_memory_mb * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' WHEN ic.max_memory_mb <= b.avg_of_group_max_memory_mb * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'NEAR_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b;
sub_questions: For each instance display name and system-metadata key, show the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were created in 2014, and only keep groups where that maximum memory is greater than 16000.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table, along with the overall average of the per-VM-state average memory across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For security group rules whose parent security group has the name "aurum-xenon", list the rule protocol and a rule activity status ("Active" if the rule is not deleted and "Inactive" otherwise), along with the number of rules in each category. Include subtotals for each protocol and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL AS rule_protocol, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY sgr.CIDR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), RuleStatusCounts AS ( SELECT ic.rule_protocol, CASE WHEN sgr2.DELETED = 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS rule_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr2 ON sgr2.CIDR = ic.rule_cidr AND sgr2.PROTOCOL = ic.rule_protocol GROUP BY ic.rule_protocol, rule_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rule_protocol END AS rule_protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rule_status END AS rule_status, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleStatusCounts GROUP BY rule_protocol, rule_status WITH ROLLUP;
sub_questions: For security group rules whose parent security group has the name "aurum-xenon", list the security group name, the rule protocol, and the rule CIDR, and assign row numbers ordered by CIDR using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row.
sub_sqls: SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL AS rule_protocol, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY sgr.CIDR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon';

question: For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and have a migration with status “completed”, what are the minimum instance memory (in MB) and the total migration memory remaining, and only return the result if the total migration memory remaining is greater than the average migration memory remaining across those same instances? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS total_migration_memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT min_instance_memory_mb, total_migration_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte WHERE total_migration_memory_remaining > (SELECT AVG(m2.MEMORY_REMAINING) FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m2.STATUS = 'completed');
sub_questions: For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and have a migration with status “completed”, what is the minimum instance memory (in MB) and the total migration memory remaining?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS total_migration_memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed';

question: For each instance display name, show the cache-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of network-info cache records per instance (only for instances that are not deleted), include the overall average cache-count range across all display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC), AverageRange AS (SELECT AVG(cache_count_range) AS avg_cache_count_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, ar.avg_cache_count_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_count_range > ar.avg_cache_count_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.cache_count_range < ar.avg_cache_count_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of network-info cache records per instance, considering only instances that are not deleted.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state (only including migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs), return the number of migrations and the earliest migration creation time, but only for groups where the earliest migration creation time is after 2015-01-01. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.earliest_migration_created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.earliest_migration_created_at > '2015-01-01T00:00:00';
sub_questions: For each migration status and instance VM state, considering only migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs, return the number of migrations and the earliest migration creation time.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory in MB, instance extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id, but only include rows where the instance memory is greater than the average instance memory across all completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.instance_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte );
sub_questions: For migrations whose status is "completed", show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, the instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance memory in MB, the instance extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed';

question: For each instance VM state, return the VM state, the geometric mean of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a completed migration, and the deviation of that geometric mean from the overall geometric mean across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), overall_cte AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean, (ic.geometric_mean - oc.overall_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_cte oc ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, return the VM state and the geometric mean of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a completed migration.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each instance display name, list the average and variance of the total memory to be migrated (MEMORY_TOTAL) across its completed migrations, along with the instance’s average configured memory (MEMORY_MB). Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row across all instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, avg_memory_total, memory_total_variance, avg_instance_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_total, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_total, inner_cte.memory_total_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, what are the average and variance of the total memory to be migrated (MEMORY_TOTAL) across its migrations, considering only migrations with status = 'completed'?
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON. Then, for each migration status, include the total number of completed migrations and the number of distinct instances involved, along with a dense rank partitioned by the migration status and ordered by the migration status. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), status_summary AS ( SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status ) SELECT i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.display_name, i.flavor, i.window_column, s.total_completed_migrations, s.distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_summary AS s ON i.status = s.status;
sub_questions: For migrations with status = 'completed', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON, along with a dense rank partitioned by the migration status and ordered by the migration status.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed';

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and where the memory is greater than 0, display each display name, the geometric mean memory, and the number of distinct instances contributing to that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS contributing_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the display name and the geometric mean of the instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and where the memory is greater than 0.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each quota resource type, list the resource name along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, and only include resources where the average reservation delta is greater than 10% of the quota’s in-use amount. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS reservation_delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY reservation_delta_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev, AVG(qu.IN_USE) AS avg_in_use FROM inner_cte JOIN QUOTA_USAGES AS qu ON qu.RESOURCE = inner_cte.resource AND qu.DELETED = 0 WHERE inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta > 0.10 * qu.IN_USE GROUP BY inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta DESC;
sub_questions: For each quota resource type, show the resource name and compute the average and standard deviation of the reservation delta values for reservations linked to that quota usage.
sub_sqls: SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS reservation_delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY reservation_delta_stddev DESC;

question: For each VM state and display name among instances in the availability zone “flare3”, list the VM state, display name, the number of distinct instances, the total number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, and the total memory (in MB) summed across those matching records. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state ), StateNameAgg AS ( SELECT vm_state, display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(extra_record_count) AS total_extra_records, SUM(extra_id_sum) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, display_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances, SUM(total_extra_records) AS total_extra_records, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateNameAgg GROUP BY vm_state, display_name WITH ROLLUP;
sub_questions: For each instance in the availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID, its display name, its VM state, the number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, and the total memory (in MB) across those matching records.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state;

question: For each instance display name, list the display name, average memory remaining (in bytes), and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (in bytes) across its completed migrations. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a final grand total row across all instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
