question: For each instance display name whose system-metadata-entry count range is greater than the average range across all instance display names, list the display name along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system metadata entries per instance (counting only instances that are not deleted and only metadata rows that are not deleted). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT display_name, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE meta_count_range > (SELECT AVG(meta_count_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, compute the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of system metadata entries per instance (counting only instances that are not deleted and only metadata rows that are not deleted).
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC;

question: Among the VM state and availability zone groups that have at least one instance with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type', list the top 10 (by instance count) VM state/availability zone combinations, showing the instance count and the minimum memory (in MB) in each group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB) among those instances.
sub_sqls: SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE;

question: For confirmed migrations where the destination compute is 'glint-94', show the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration status, instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, system metadata key and value, and the row number within each migration status (ordered by migration id). Also include, for each migration status, the total number of rows returned and the average migration id as a benchmark, and categorize each row as 'ABOVE_AVG_ID', 'BELOW_AVG_ID', or 'AT_AVG_ID' based on whether its migration id is above, below, or equal to that status benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.STATUS AS migration_status, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.DEST_COMPUTE = 'glint-94' ), StatusBenchmarks AS ( SELECT migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_in_status, AVG(migration_id) AS avg_migration_id_in_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_status ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, sb.total_rows_in_status, sb.avg_migration_id_in_status AS benchmark_avg_migration_id, CASE WHEN ic.migration_id > sb.avg_migration_id_in_status THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ID' WHEN ic.migration_id < sb.avg_migration_id_in_status THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ID' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ID' END AS id_vs_benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN StatusBenchmarks sb ON ic.migration_status = sb.migration_status;
sub_questions: For confirmed migrations where the destination compute is 'glint-94', list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration status, the instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance VM state, the system metadata key and value, and assign row numbers within each migration status group ordered by migration id.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.STATUS AS migration_status, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.DEST_COMPUTE = 'glint-94';

question: For each migration status, show the status, the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB), and the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ vCPU count for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, EXP(AVG(LN(i.vcpus))) AS geometric_mean_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.vcpus > 0 GROUP BY m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;
sub_questions: For each migration status, show the status and the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance of the instance memory size in MB (considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), along with the overall average of these per-display-name variances and each display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the variance of the instance memory size in MB, considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and its average, range, and variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and have a non-empty network_info cache entry, and then list only the VM states whose average memory is greater than the overall average of these per-state averages. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance virtual machine state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and that have a non-empty network_info cache entry.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each instance display name, find the memory range and variance (in MB) for non-deleted instances, and then report the maximum memory range observed across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT MAX(inner_cte.memory_range_mb) AS max_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, calculate the range and variance of the instance memory size (in MB) for instances that are not deleted.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are in the availability zone “flare3”, group the results by system metadata key and a memory bucket (“HighMem” if memory_mb ≥ 32768 and “LowMem” otherwise). For each group, list the system metadata key, the memory bucket, the number of distinct instances, and the average of the per-row windowed average instance memory (MB) (computed over 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the system metadata key and ordered by instance memory). Include subtotals for each system metadata key and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), Bucketed AS ( SELECT metadata_key, CASE WHEN memory_mb >= 32768 THEN 'HighMem' ELSE 'LowMem' END AS memory_bucket, instance_uuid, window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(memory_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE memory_bucket END AS memory_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, AVG(window_column) AS avg_windowed_memory_mb FROM Bucketed GROUP BY metadata_key, memory_bucket WITH ROLLUP;
sub_questions: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are in the availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, the extra record’s flavor JSON, a system metadata key and value, and the average instance memory (MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the system metadata key and ordered by instance memory.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'

question: For each migration source compute, considering only migrations with status equal to 'completed', show the source compute and the maximum value of the 3-preceding-and-1-following-row minimum instance memory (in MB) when ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.source_compute, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.source_compute;
sub_questions: For migrations with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, the instance display name, the migration source compute, destination compute, migration status, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed';

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table, and also compute how far each VM state's average memory deviates from the overall average memory across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]') SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_range, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallAvg oa;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each quota usage resource, show its average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta amounts, include the overall average delta across all quota usage resources as a benchmark, and categorize each resource as 'HIGH_DELTA' (at least 50% above the overall average), 'LOW_DELTA' (at least 50% below the overall average), or 'AVERAGE_DELTA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS quota_resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_delta, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_delta) AS overall_avg_delta FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.quota_resource, ic.avg_delta, ic.delta_variance, ic.delta_stddev, oa.overall_avg_delta AS benchmark_avg_delta, CASE WHEN ic.avg_delta > oa.overall_avg_delta * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DELTA' WHEN ic.avg_delta < oa.overall_avg_delta * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DELTA' END AS delta_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa;
sub_questions: For each quota usage resource, show the average, variance, and standard deviation of the reservation delta amounts for reservations linked to that quota usage.
sub_sqls: SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS quota_resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_delta, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC;

question: For availability zone "flare3", how many non-deleted instances have a non-deleted network info cache entry, and is this count greater than the average number of such instances per availability zone? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0 ), ZoneCounts AS ( SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(*) AS instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), ZoneAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(instances_with_network_cache * 1.0) AS avg_instances_with_network_cache FROM ZoneCounts ) SELECT inner_cte.flare3_instances_with_network_cache, CASE WHEN inner_cte.flare3_instances_with_network_cache > (SELECT avg_instances_with_network_cache FROM ZoneAverages) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flare3_above_zone_average FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: How many non-deleted instances are in the availability zone "flare3" and have a non-deleted network info cache entry (i.e., a matching row in INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES)?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', show the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), the system metadata key and value, and the average memory (MB) within each display-name group ordered by memory; then return only those rows where the instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average memory (MB) across all returned rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb;
sub_questions: For instances whose display name is 'forge', show the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), the system metadata key and value, and the average memory (MB) within each display-name group ordered by memory.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records in availability zone 'flare3', return the instance display name, its cache record count, the overall average cache record count across these top-10 display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_CACHE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_CACHE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_CACHE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), AverageCache AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_records > ac.avg_cache_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE' WHEN ic.cache_records < ac.avg_cache_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE' END AS cache_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageCache ac;
sub_questions: List the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of network info cache records, considering only instances in the availability zone 'flare3'. Return each instance display name and the count of matching cache rows.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance VM state, among non-hidden and active migrations (i.e., migration status not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')), return the VM state and the maximum (across migration statuses) of the per-status minimum total migration memory, considering only VM states that have at least 2 instances involved in such migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ) SELECT vm_state, MAX(min_memory_total) AS max_of_min_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_count >= 2 GROUP BY vm_state;
domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
sub_questions: For each instance VM state and migration status, considering only migrations that are not hidden and only **active** migrations (i.e., migration status not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')), return the number of instances involved and the minimum total memory recorded for the migration.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS;

question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are on host "blaze8-12", show each instance UUID and its dense rank when ordering by the instance’s memory in MB (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). Also display the instance’s hostname and whether it has any non-deleted instance info cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, inner_cte.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, i.hostname AS instance_hostname, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic2 WHERE iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_instance_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid;
sub_questions: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are on host "blaze8-12", show each instance UUID and its dense rank when ordering by the instance’s memory in MB, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance display name, list the display name, total number of matching instances, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_days_to_launch, days_to_launch_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.uuid) AS total_instances, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, what are the average and standard deviation of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'?
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC;

question: For each quota usage record, return the quota usage ID, its resource type, and the total reserved delta from its linked reservations, considering only reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59 and only non-deleted quota usages; include only those quota usages where the total reserved delta is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean reservation delta across all (filtered) reservations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.ID AS usage_id, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.ID HAVING SUM(r.DELTA) > ( SELECT AVG(DELTA) + STDDEV(DELTA) FROM RESERVATIONS WHERE expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' )) SELECT inner_cte.usage_id, qu.RESOURCE AS usage_resource, inner_cte.total_reserved_delta FROM inner_cte JOIN QUOTA_USAGES AS qu ON qu.ID = inner_cte.usage_id WHERE qu.DELETED = 0;
sub_questions: For each quota usage record, return the quota usage ID and the total reserved delta from its linked reservations, considering only reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59, and only quota usages where the total reserved delta is more than one standard deviation above the mean reservation delta across all (filtered) reservations.

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the largest instance-memory range (in MB) among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, are in availability zone 'flare3', and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', show each display name, the memory range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), along with the total vCPUs and total memory across those instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the range, variance, and standard deviation of the instance memory (in MB) across that display name, considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, are in availability zone 'flare3', and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' and where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the instance system metadata key and value, and the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.STATUS) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id) = m.STATUS THEN NULL ELSE m.STATUS END AS migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id;

question: For each availability zone, find the availability zone name and the highest total memory (in MB) among VM states for instances hosted on 'blaze8-12' in availability zone 'flare3', considering only VM states whose total memory is greater than 50000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT 'flare3' AS availability_zone, MAX(inner_cte.total_memory_mb) AS max_total_memory_mb_across_vm_states FROM inner_cte;

question: For each instance VM state, return the VM state, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_REMAINING divided by the average MEMORY_REMAINING) for completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", and the count of completed migrations contributing to that statistic. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, return the VM state and the coefficient of variation of migration memory remaining (standard deviation of MEMORY_REMAINING divided by the average MEMORY_REMAINING) for completed migrations, restricted to instances on host "blaze8-12".

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i2.MEMORY_MB > ( SELECT AVG(i3.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) FROM INSTANCES AS i3 WHERE i3.DELETED = 0 AND i3.HOST = 'blaze8-12' );

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted and that are running on host "prime-35", show the availability zone, VM state, the number of instances, and the earliest instance creation time. Also include subtotals for each availability zone and a grand total, using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE AVAILABILITY_ZONE END AS AVAILABILITY_ZONE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 AND GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(earliest_created_at) AS earliest_created_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE, VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance on host 'blaze8-12' that has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the instance UUID, the instance display name, the migration status, the number of migrations recorded for that instance, and the total memory processed across those migrations; additionally, only include rows where the total memory processed is greater than 75% of the total memory for those migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m2.status = inner_cte.migration_status GROUP BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed HAVING (inner_cte.total_memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(m2.memory_total), 0)) > 0.75;

question: For each **active** migration status, list the status along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) for instances that have a matching migration record, and only keep statuses whose memory variance is greater than the average memory variance across all active migration statuses. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB IS NOT NULL AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.STATUS ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_variance FROM VarianceAverages) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each VM state on host `blaze8-12`, list the VM state, the total number of non-deleted instances that have a system metadata entry with key `image_image_type` and also have a non-deleted network info cache record, and the average memory (MB) of those instances. Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_instances, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, COUNT(i.ID) AS total_instances, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.IN_USE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM QUOTA_USAGES t0 JOIN RESERVATIONS t1 ON t0.ID = t1.USAGE_ID WHERE t1.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND t1.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' ) SELECT r.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta, MAX(i.window_column) AS max_dense_rank_in_project, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATIONS r2 JOIN QUOTA_USAGES q2 ON q2.ID = r2.USAGE_ID WHERE r2.PROJECT_ID = r.PROJECT_ID AND r2.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND r2.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' AND q2.RESERVED > 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_positive_reserved_quota FROM inner_cte i JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON r.UUID = i.UUID JOIN QUOTA_USAGES q ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' GROUP BY r.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY total_reserved_delta DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id, CASE WHEN i.project_id IS NOT NULL AND i.project_id <> '' THEN 'HAS_PROJECT' ELSE 'NO_PROJECT' END AS project_presence_category FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name;

question: For each instance VM state (restricted to instances running on host 'blaze8-12' and migrations with status 'completed'), show the VM state, the range and variance of total memory moved during its migrations, the overall average memory-moved range across VM states as a benchmark, and categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ORDER BY ic.memory_total_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most matching instance-extra records among instances in the “flare3” availability zone hosted on “blaze8-12”, show each display name, the number of extra records, and the percentage of those extra records out of the total instance-extra records for that same zone and host. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY extra_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), totals AS ( SELECT COUNT(ie.id) AS total_extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.extra_records, (ic.extra_records * 1.0 / t.total_extra_records) AS pct_of_total_extra_records FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY ic.extra_records DESC;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state, list the migration status, the instance VM state, and the total memory processed across **active** migrations that are linked to instances which have at least one system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Keep only those (status, vm_state) groups whose total processed memory is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean processed memory across all migrations. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations ) ) SELECT inner_cte.status, i.vm_state, SUM(inner_cte.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY inner_cte.status, i.vm_state;

question: For the host blaze8-12, for each qualifying instance return the instance UUID, its total memory (in MB) across its records, the global benchmark (overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed over all instances), and label each instance as ABOVE_BENCHMARK or BELOW_OR_EQUAL_BENCHMARK. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) AS benchmark_memory_mb FROM instances ) SELECT c.uuid, c.total_memory_mb, b.benchmark_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_memory_mb > b.benchmark_memory_mb THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'BELOW_OR_EQUAL_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN Benchmark b;

question: For each instance VM state and display name, considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs that are running on host "blaze8-12", list the VM state, display name, whether the instance has NUMA topology information in INSTANCE_EXTRA ("Has NUMA" vs "No NUMA"), and the number of instances and minimum memory (in MB). question: For each migration status, show the status, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that were migrated (considering only migrations that are not deleted and only active migrations), and also include the overall average instance memory (in MB) across all such active, non-deleted migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_stddev, overall_avg.overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb) AS overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC;
domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
sub_questions: For each migration status, show the status and compute the average and standard deviation of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that were migrated, considering only migrations that are not deleted and only **active migrations**.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For migrations that have status = 'completed' and where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance vm state, instance memory (MB), instance vcpus, and the instance extra record id; also show the minimum total memory value within each migration type (windowed by migration type and ordered by migration type). Additionally, for each migration type, show the average of the per-row windowed minimum total memory across that migration type and the difference between the row’s total memory and that migration-type average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), avg_by_type AS ( SELECT MIGRATION_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MIGRATION_TYPE ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.MIGRATION_TYPE, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.VM_STATE, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.VCPUS, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.MEMORY_TOTAL, ic.window_column, abt.avg_window_min_memory_total, (ic.MEMORY_TOTAL - abt.avg_window_min_memory_total) AS deviation_from_type_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte ic JOIN avg_by_type abt ON ic.MIGRATION_TYPE = abt.MIGRATION_TYPE;
sub_questions: For migrations that have status = 'completed' and where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance vm state, instance memory (MB), instance vcpus, and the instance extra record id; also show the minimum total memory value within each migration type (windowed by migration type and ordered by migration type).
sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each VM state and availability zone among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'prime-35', return only those (VM state, availability zone) groups whose instance count is greater than the average instance count across all such groups, and list the VM state, availability zone, instance count, and minimum memory (in MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.instance_count * 1.0) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.instance_count > (SELECT avg_instance_count FROM avg_cte);
sub_questions: For each instance VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and that are running on host 'prime-35', return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB) among those instances.
sub_sqls: SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE;

question: For each active migration status, list the status, the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for instances with a matching migration record, and include a subtotal row across all active migration statuses. Do not repeat the status label if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status_name) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status_name) = status_name THEN NULL ELSE status_name END AS status, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status_name;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance system metadata key, along with a dense rank over each instance UUID ordered by the instance UUID; additionally, for each destination compute, include the total number of such migrations and the average number of such migrations across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_migrations_for_dest_compute, avg_migrations.avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM ( SELECT dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dest_compute ) AS sub ) AS avg_migrations ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.window_column, avg_migrations.avg_migration_count;
sub_questions: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance system metadata key, along with a dense rank over each instance UUID ordered by the instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance VM state, return the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and are on host "blaze8-12" (joining via instance UUID to the instance network info cache), and the deviation of that geometric mean from the overall geometric mean memory across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), overall_cte AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS overall_geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean, (ic.geometric_mean - oc.overall_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_cte oc ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, return the VM state and the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and are on host "blaze8-12", using the instance UUID to join to the instance network info cache.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each instance display name, report the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system-metadata rows per completed migration for that instance (restricted to instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'), but only include those instance display names whose metadata-count range is greater than the overall average metadata-count range across all such 'prime' instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.metadata_count_range > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.metadata_count_range) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, report the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of system-metadata rows per migration for that instance, considering only migrations with status = 'completed' and only instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For each qualifying instance on host blaze8-12, list the instance UUID and its total memory (in MB) across records, and do not repeat the UUID if it is the same as the previous row. Also include a final TOTAL row that shows the grand total memory across all qualifying instances. Only include instances whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (computed over all instances). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(uuid) OVER (ORDER BY uuid_sort, uuid) = uuid THEN NULL ELSE uuid END AS uuid, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.uuid) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.uuid END AS uuid_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.uuid) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.uuid END AS uuid, SUM(inner_cte.total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.uuid WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY uuid_sort, uuid;
sub_questions: For each instance on host blaze8-12, return the instance UUID and the total amount of memory (in MB) across its records, considering only instances whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (computed over all instances).
sub_sqls: SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances );

question: For each migration status where the instance memory variance is greater than 0, show the status along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for instances on host 'blaze8-12' that have at least one system metadata entry with the key 'image_image_type', ordering by the memory variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC;
