question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, key name, and the related instance_extra record ID, but only include those instances whose memory_mb is greater than the average memory_mb of all instances with the same vCPU count in that same availability zone and host. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), VcpuAverages AS ( SELECT i2.VCPUS, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i2.VCPUS ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.KEY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > ( SELECT VcpuAverages.avg_memory_mb FROM VcpuAverages WHERE VcpuAverages.VCPUS = inner_cte.VCPUS );

sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', restricted to instances running on host 'blaze8-12', and also include the deviation of each display name’s memory variance from the overall average memory variance across all such display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_variance - a.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stats a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', restricted to instances running on host 'blaze8-12'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each VM state, show the number of completed instance migrations for instances hosted on 'blaze8-12', and also include the overall average of these per-VM-state completed-migration counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_state, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ON 1 = 1 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_state FROM ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS state_migration_count FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i2.VM_STATE ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances;
sub_questions: How many instance migrations have status 'completed' for instances that are in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state and are hosted on 'blaze8-12'?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each VM state, show the VM state and the maximum (across projects) of the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', where the instance memory is greater than 0, and only for instances running on host 'blaze8-12'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), ProjectVmStateGeoMean AS ( SELECT i.project_id, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.project_id, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ) SELECT vm_state, MAX(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS max_geometric_mean_memory_mb_across_projects FROM ProjectVmStateGeoMean GROUP BY vm_state ORDER BY max_geometric_mean_memory_mb_across_projects DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', where the instance memory is greater than 0, and only for instances running on host 'blaze8-12'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are running on host 'blaze8-12', compute the average dense rank (based on ordering by the instance's memory in MB, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) across all such instances that have a system metadata key equal to 'image_image_type'. Also classify the host as 'HIGH_RANK' if this average dense rank is at least 1.5, 'LOW_RANK' if it is at most 0.5, otherwise 'AVERAGE_RANK'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ar.avg_dense_rank, CASE WHEN ar.avg_dense_rank >= 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RANK' WHEN ar.avg_dense_rank <= 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RANK' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RANK' END AS rank_category FROM avg_rank ar;
sub_questions: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are running on host 'blaze8-12', list each instance UUID and the dense rank of that instance when ordering by the instance's memory (in MB), using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Only include instances that have a system metadata key equal to 'image_image_type', and show that metadata value as well.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type';

question: For each instance display name and migration status, show the maximum total memory recorded for its completed migrations where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime' and the maximum total memory is greater than 0; additionally, return only those results where this maximum total memory is greater than the overall average of these per-(display name, status) maximum total memory values. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) FROM inner_cte);
sub_questions: For each instance display name and migration status, show the maximum total memory recorded for its migrations, considering only migrations with status = 'completed' **and only instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'**, and return only groups where the maximum total memory is greater than 0.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0;

question: For migrations with status equal to "completed" and where the instance is on host "ether-18", show the same migration/instance/metadata details as before, but format the output so the destination compute value is not repeated when it is the same as the previous row (ordered by destination compute). Also include, for each destination compute, the total number of rows returned and the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key;
sub_questions: For migrations with status equal to "completed" and where the instance is on host "ether-18", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration instance UUID, the instance display name, instance vm state, instance memory (MB), instance vcpus, the system metadata key and value for that instance, and the minimum migration memory remaining within each destination compute group (ordered by destination compute).
sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18';

question: For migrations whose status is "completed" and whose instance is hosted on "blaze8-12", list the migration ID, the instance display name, and the instance info cache ID, along with the running sum of migration IDs within each instance type (partitioned by the instance’s INSTANCE_TYPE_ID) ordered by migration ID, but only include rows where this running sum is greater than the average running-sum value across all such rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_info_cache_id, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte);

sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance (by instance UUID) running on host "blaze8-12" that has cached network info, return its total processed memory across completed migrations, along with the overall average processed memory per completed migration and the instance’s deviation from that average; only keep instances whose total processed memory is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean processed memory per completed migration. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed' )), OverallStats AS (SELECT AVG(memory_processed) AS avg_memory_processed, STDDEV(memory_processed) AS stddev_memory_processed FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed') SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.total_memory_processed, os.avg_memory_processed, (c.total_memory_processed - os.avg_memory_processed) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN OverallStats os;

question: For each migration status, show the status, the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero (considering only active migrations by excluding statuses accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed), the overall geometric-mean memory across all such active migrations as a benchmark, and categorize each status as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) SELECT ic.status, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b;
domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
sub_questions: For each migration status, show the status and the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero, considering only active migrations (i.e., excluding statuses accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed).
sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance of the instance memory (in MB) across migrations for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', but only include those instances whose memory variance is greater than the average memory variance across all such matching instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the variance of the instance memory (in MB) across migrations for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12', list each display name, its completed migration count, and the average completed migration count per instance across all instances on 'blaze8-12'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations, avg_migrations.avg_migrations_per_instance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migrations_per_instance FROM ( SELECT i.uuid, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid ) AS per_instance ) AS avg_migrations ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of migrations, counting migrations per instance, considering only migrations whose status is 'completed' and only instances hosted on 'blaze8-12'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state, the variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances on host "blaze8-12" that have a corresponding network info cache record, the overall average of these per-state variances as a benchmark, and categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), AverageVariance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageVariance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances on host "blaze8-12" that have a corresponding network info cache record.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name and system-metadata key, show the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were created in 2014 and whose display name matches the pattern "prime", and only keep groups where that maximum memory is greater than 16000; additionally, only return those groups where the maximum memory is more than 75% of the average memory across all such qualifying groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb) AS avg_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) stats WHERE (inner_cte.max_memory_mb * 1.0 / stats.avg_max_memory_mb) > 0.75;
sub_questions: For each instance display name and system-metadata key, show the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were created in 2014 and whose display name matches the pattern "prime", and only keep groups where that maximum memory is greater than 16000.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) across instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type', restricting results to instances running on host 'prime-35', and only include display names where the average memory is greater than 8192 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT i.display_name, i.memory_mb_variance, i.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(inst.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte i JOIN instances inst ON inst.display_name = i.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON inst.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND inst.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.memory_mb_variance, i.memory_mb_stddev HAVING AVG(inst.memory_mb) > 8192 ORDER BY i.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation of the instance memory (in MB) across instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type', restricting results to instances running on host 'prime-35'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name, list the display name, the maximum memory (in MB), and the launched time for instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'prime-35'. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row as a subtotal across all returned groups. Only keep rows where the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name, launched_at) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, max_memory_mb, launched_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, MAX(launched_at) AS launched_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, launched_at;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the maximum memory (in MB) among its instances and the instance launched time, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', restricting to instances running on host 'prime-35', and only keep groups where the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and are running on host blaze8-12, and also include how far each display name’s memory variance deviates from the overall average memory variance across all such display names (using the instance extra table to ensure the instance has extra metadata). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_variance - a.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stats a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and are running on host blaze8-12, using the instance extra table to ensure the instance has extra metadata.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: How many non-deleted instances are in the availability zone "flare3", are on host "blaze8-12", and have a non-deleted network info cache entry (i.e., a matching row in INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For non-deleted instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, show the instance UUID and the dense rank of each instance when ordering by the instance memory (in MB), using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each migration status, show the status and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance memory size in MB for instances on host "blaze8-12" that have a non-deleted instance info cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are running on host "blaze8-12", show the instance UUID, its display name, the system metadata key, and the running sum of the instance IDs within each metadata key group ordered by instance ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance display name, calculate the range and variance of the instance memory size (in MB) across instances that have a corresponding network info cache record, restricting results to instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'. Do not return any rounded answers.

question: For migrations with status equal to 'completed' and where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', list the instance UUID, the instance display name, the migration status, the source compute host, the destination compute host, the migration memory total, and the average migration memory total in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the instance availability zone and ordered by memory total. sql: SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance root disk size (ROOT_GB) considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and that are running on host 'blaze8-12'. domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"

question: For each quota resource type, show the resource name and compute the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the reservation delta values for reservations linked to that quota usage, considering only reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS reservation_delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY reservation_delta_stddev DESC;

question: For migrations that are marked as completed and whose instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', list the migration status, the instance display name, and the cached network info for the instance, and assign row numbers ordered by the instance display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime';

question: For migrations with status equal to 'completed' and where the instance host is 'blaze8-12', list the instance UUID, instance display name, instance hostname, migration source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration type, memory total, memory processed, memory remaining, and the minimum memory remaining within each instance UUID (partitioned and ordered by instance UUID). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance in availability zone 'flare3' that is running on host 'blaze8-12', show the instance UUID, display name, key name, the number of system metadata entries it has, and the total number of vCPUs across those metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name;

question: For each instance display name, what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system-metadata entries per instance (counting only non-deleted metadata rows) for instances that have a non-deleted network info cache, restricted to instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For each instance on host blaze8-12, show the instance UUID and the total amount of migration memory processed (sum of MEMORY_PROCESSED) across its migrations, considering only instances whose total processed migration memory is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean MEMORY_PROCESSED across all migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations );

question: For completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", list each migration ID and the dense rank of that migration when ordering by the instance’s memory (in MB), using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For each instance power state, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty network_info entry in the instance info cache, restricted to instances running on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.power_state, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info IS NOT NULL AND iic.network_info <> '' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.power_state ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are running on host 'blaze8-12', list each instance UUID and the dense rank of that instance when ordering by the instance's memory (in MB), using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Only include instances that have a system metadata key equal to 'image_image_type', and show that metadata value as well. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type';

question: For each instance display name, calculate the range and variance of the instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a non-empty key name, are not deleted, and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) recorded for its completed migrations, considering only instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and that have more than 5 such migration records. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC;

question: For each migration status, show the status and compute the average, range, and variance of the migrated instance memory size in MB (from the INSTANCES table) for migrations of type 'resize', considering only active migrations (i.e., excluding statuses accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each instance display name, return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance’s migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) across its migrations, considering only migrations with STATUS = 'completed' and only instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry, considering only instances in the availability zone 'flare3' and whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. question: For each instance, show its display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window that includes the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, considering only instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', where the instance memory is greater than 0, and only for instances running on host 'blaze8-12'. question: For each instance display name, list the instance display name, the variance of instance memory (MB) among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) among instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Also include the count of distinct instances contributing to each metric, and only return display names where the variance is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceExtraMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), ImageTypeMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT iemv.display_name, iemv.memory_mb_variance, itms.avg_memory_mb, itms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceExtraMemoryVariance iemv JOIN ImageTypeMemoryStats itms ON iemv.display_name = itms.display_name ORDER BY iemv.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT i1.uuid) AS instance_extra_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i2.uuid) AS image_type_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i1 ON i1.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i1.uuid JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 display names by number of completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID and only for instances with a non-empty key name), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, the completed migrations count, the completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio rounded, and keep only those rows whose completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio is greater than the overall average completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio across the same result set.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), TopCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC ), OverallAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > (SELECT avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For instance display names that are among the top 10 by number of completed migrations (counting only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the total memory (in MB) for those display names whose instances are in the `shelved_offloaded` VM state and have total memory greater than 50000 MB. Also include a subtotal row and a grand total row for the total memory and completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.migrations AS completed_migrations, sohm.total_memory_mb FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory sohm ON tcm.display_name = sohm.display_name ORDER BY tcm.migrations DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN SUM(inner_cte.completed_migrations) ELSE SUM(inner_cte.completed_migrations) END AS completed_migrations, SUM(inner_cte.total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMetadataSummary AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), InstanceNetworkWindow AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT ims.instance_uuid, ims.display_name, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus, inw.NETWORK_INFO, inw.window_column FROM InstanceMetadataSummary ims JOIN InstanceNetworkWindow inw ON ims.instance_uuid = inw.instance_uuid ORDER BY ims.display_name, ims.instance_uuid) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name;

question: For instances that have completed migrations, list each instance display name, instance UUID, migration destination host, instance memory (MB), the windowed average instance memory (MB) within each instance UUID group ordered by destination host, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (bytes) across completed migrations for that display name, compute the average-memory-remaining to instance-memory ratio (avg memory remaining bytes divided by instance memory bytes), and also show the deviation of that ratio from the overall average ratio across all completed-migration instances, ordered by this deviation descending.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), CompletedMigrationInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST ) SELECT cmd.DISPLAY_NAME, cmd.UUID AS instance_uuid, cmd.DEST_HOST, cmd.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, cmd.window_column AS avg_instance_memory_mb_within_uuid_by_dest_host, ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes / NULLIF(cmd.MEMORY_MB * 1024 * 1024, 0), 6) AS avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationInstanceDetails AS cmd JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON cmd.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio DESC ), AverageRatio AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_uuid, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb_within_uuid_by_dest_host, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ic.avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio - ar.overall_avg_ratio) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_ratio FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRatio ar ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg_ratio DESC;

question: For display name 'forge', return only the per-instance metadata rows (instance UUID, hostname, metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group ordered by instance ID) where the running sum is greater than the average running sum for the same metadata key among 'forge' instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record; include a “reason” column indicating why each row is included. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.hostname, fim.metadata_key, fim.window_column, NULL AS migration_count_range, NULL AS migration_count_variance, NULL AS migration_count_stddev, 'Forge Instance Metadata' AS reason FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS hostname, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS window_column, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, 'Migration Stats By Display Name' AS reason FROM MigrationStatsByDisplayName ms WHERE ms.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_uuid, hostname, metadata_key) SELECT icr.instance_uuid, icr.hostname, icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, 'Above-key average running-sum (non-deleted cache only)' AS reason FROM inner_cte icr JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = icr.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE icr.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic.deleted = 0 AND icr.window_column > ( SELECT AVG(icr2.window_column * 1.0) FROM inner_cte icr2 JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = icr2.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE icr2.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND icr2.metadata_key = icr.metadata_key ) ORDER BY icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, icr.instance_uuid;

SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC;

WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.hostname, fim.metadata_key, fim.window_column, NULL AS migration_count_range, NULL AS migration_count_variance, NULL AS migration_count_stddev, 'Forge Instance Metadata' AS reason FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS hostname, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS window_column, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, 'Migration Stats By Display Name' AS reason FROM MigrationStatsByDisplayName ms WHERE ms.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_uuid, hostname, metadata_key;

question: For each VM state and completed-migration status category (label as 'HasCompletedMigration' if any completed migrations exist for that VM state among instances with display name 'forge', otherwise 'NoCompletedMigration'), list the VM state, the category label, and the number of distinct forge instances. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Use the forge instances that also have completed migrations, and keep the per-instance window outputs (running sum of instance memory within VM state ordered by memory, and the 3-preceding/1-following minimum memory window over completed migrations ordered by migration ID) as the inner CTE. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeInstanceWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column AS forge_running_memory_sum_mb_by_vm_state, cm.display_name, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS completed_migration_min_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceWindow AS f JOIN CompletedMigrationWindow AS cm ON cm.uuid = f.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_uuid, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute ), ForgeVmStateMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m WHERE m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed' AND m.deleted = 0 ) THEN 'HasCompletedMigration' ELSE 'NoCompletedMigration' END AS completed_migration_category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.vm_state, completed_migration_category ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(completed_migration_category) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE completed_migration_category END AS completed_migration_category, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM ForgeVmStateMigrationStatus GROUP BY vm_state, completed_migration_category WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances that are both (1) non-deleted and in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' with system metadata, and (2) have display name 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, display name, project ID, power state, system metadata key/value, VM state, memory (MB), cached network info JSON, the max instance memory (MB) over the current row and next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, the min memory (MB) over a 2-preceding/2-following window ordered by instance ID, the instance’s vCPU count, and the deviation of that vCPU count from the average vCPU count across all matching instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.UUID AS instance_uuid, f.HOSTNAME AS hostname, s.display_name, s.project_id, s.power_state, s.metadata_key, s.metadata_value, f.VM_STATE AS vm_state, f.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, f.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, s.max_memory_mb_next_2, f.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS s ON s.instance_uuid = f.UUID ORDER BY f.UUID, s.metadata_key ), InstanceVcpu AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.VCPUS AS vcpus FROM INSTANCES i ), AverageVcpu AS ( SELECT AVG(v.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus FROM InstanceVcpu v JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.display_name, ic.project_id, ic.power_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.max_memory_mb_next_2, ic.min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, v.vcpus, (v.vcpus - av.avg_vcpus) AS deviation_from_avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte ic JOIN InstanceVcpu v ON v.instance_uuid = ic.instance_uuid CROSS JOIN AverageVcpu av ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key;

Additionally, for each migration status, include the total number of completed migrations (as a subtotal per status) and a grand total across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT cmd.status, cmd.source_compute, cmd.dest_compute, cmd.display_name, cmd.flavor, cmd.window_column, msmv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationDetails AS cmd JOIN MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv ON cmd.status = msmv.status ORDER BY msmv.memory_mb_variance DESC, cmd.status, cmd.window_column ), StatusCounts AS ( SELECT m.status, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.source_compute) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.source_compute END AS source_compute, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.dest_compute) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.dest_compute END AS dest_compute, MAX(i.display_name) AS display_name, MAX(i.flavor) AS flavor, MAX(i.window_column) AS window_column, MAX(i.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, SUM(COALESCE(sc.completed_migrations, 0)) AS completed_migrations FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN StatusCounts sc ON i.status = sc.status GROUP BY i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH top_metadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), completed_migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, tm.metadata_entries FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN top_metadata tm ON tm.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY tm.metadata_entries DESC, cm.migration_id ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_availability_zone, migration_status, window_column, metadata_entries FROM inner_cte WHERE metadata_entries > (SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC, migration_id;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, min(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq2.completed_migrations, sq1.uuid, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.key_name, sq1.instance_extra_id, sq1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.completed_migrations DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC;

question: Using only migrations with status = 'completed', produce a rollup summary by availability zone and section label (Migration Details vs Migration Memory Window) showing the number of rows in each section, plus subtotals per availability zone and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationMemoryWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, AVG(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL ), CombinedCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT cmd.migration_id, cmd.status AS migration_status, cmd.source_compute, cmd.dest_compute, cmd.dest_host, cmd.display_name AS instance_display_name, cmd.vm_state, cmd.max_memory_mb_next_2, NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS memory_total, NULL AS avg_memory_total_window, 'Migration Details (Max Instance Memory Next 2)' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationDetails cmd UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS migration_id, cmmw.migration_status, cmmw.source_compute, cmmw.dest_compute, NULL AS dest_host, cmmw.instance_display_name, NULL AS vm_state, NULL AS max_memory_mb_next_2, cmmw.instance_uuid, cmmw.memory_total, cmmw.window_column AS avg_memory_total_window, 'Migration Memory Window (Avg Memory Total ±2 in AZ)' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationMemoryWindow cmmw ) SELECT migration_id, migration_status, source_compute, dest_compute, dest_host, instance_uuid, instance_display_name, vm_state, max_memory_mb_next_2, memory_total, avg_memory_total_window, reason FROM CombinedCompletedMigrations ORDER BY reason, migration_id, instance_uuid ), LabeledRows AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, inner_cte.reason, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = COALESCE(inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_uuid) GROUP BY i.availability_zone, inner_cte.reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(row_count) AS total_rows FROM LabeledRows GROUP BY availability_zone, reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the top 10 VM states with the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among non-deleted instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, display each VM state’s average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory, along with (for comparison) each migration status’s average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) considering only non-deleted migrations (and only instances that also have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA). sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH vm_state_stats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), migration_status_stats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_vm_state_by_variance AS ( SELECT VM_STATE, memory_mb_variance FROM vm_state_stats LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tvs.VM_STATE, vss.avg_memory_mb AS vm_state_avg_memory_mb, vss.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, vss.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, mss.status AS migration_status, mss.avg_memory_mb AS migration_status_avg_memory_mb, mss.memory_mb_variance AS migration_status_memory_mb_variance, mss.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_status_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_vm_state_by_variance tvs JOIN vm_state_stats vss ON tvs.VM_STATE = vss.VM_STATE CROSS JOIN migration_status_stats mss ORDER BY tvs.memory_mb_variance DESC, mss.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_status_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS vm_state_total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.vm_state = ic.vm_state AND i2.deleted = 0 AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = ic.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_status_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT subq1.instance_uuid, subq1.hostname, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column, subq2.total_memory_mb FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.instance_uuid = subq2.uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_mb DESC, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column ) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.hostname, c.metadata_key, c.window_column, c.total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.instance_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_info_cache FROM inner_cte c LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.total_memory_mb DESC, c.metadata_key, c.window_column;
