question: From the top 10 projects with the highest total “max-memory-per-rank” ratio across their completed migrations (consider only instances whose maximum recorded completed-migration total memory is greater than 0, and only non-deleted instance info cache rows), show each project’s ID, the project’s total of those ratios, the number of distinct instances contributing, and whether the project has any active (non-completed/failed/error) migrations.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), CompletedMigrationsRanked AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmr.DEST_COMPUTE, cmr.instance_display_name, mm.max_memory_total, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status, ROUND(mm.max_memory_total / NULLIF(cmr.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationsRanked cmr JOIN MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus mm ON cmr.instance_display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, cmr.migration_id ), project_rollup AS ( SELECT i.project_id, SUM(inner_cte.max_memory_per_rank_ratio) AS total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS distinct_instances_contributing FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.instance_display_name AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ), ranked_projects AS ( SELECT pr.project_id, pr.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio, pr.distinct_instances_contributing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC) AS project_rank FROM project_rollup pr ) SELECT rp.project_id, rp.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio, rp.distinct_instances_contributing, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = rp.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM ranked_projects rp WHERE rp.project_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rp.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, rp.project_id;

question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc' and for completed migrations on that same instance, list the instance details and each system metadata key/value along with the migration ID, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group, the minimum system metadata ID within each metadata key group, the ratio (running sum of migration IDs divided by the minimum metadata ID) rounded to 2 decimals, and categorize each row as 'HIGH_RATIO' (at least 50% above the overall average ratio), 'LOW_RATIO' (at least 50% below the overall average ratio), or 'AVERAGE_RATIO'.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT imd.instance_id, imd.display_name, imd.user_id, imd.project_id, imd.vm_state, imd.power_state, imd.memory_mb, imd.vcpus, imd.availability_zone, imd.metadata_key, imd.metadata_value, imd.metadata_id, imd.window_column AS min_metadata_id_in_key_group, mm.migration_id, mm.instance_display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, mm.window_column AS running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ROUND(mm.window_column / NULLIF(imd.window_column, 0), 2) AS running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio FROM InstanceMetadataDetails imd JOIN MigrationMetadata mm ON mm.metadata_key = imd.metadata_key AND mm.instance_display_name = imd.display_name ORDER BY running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, mm.migration_id), AverageRatio AS ( SELECT AVG(running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.display_name, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.metadata_id, ic.min_metadata_id_in_key_group, ic.migration_id, ic.migration_instance_display_name, ic.running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio, ar.avg_ratio AS benchmark_avg_ratio, CASE WHEN ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio > ar.avg_ratio * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RATIO' WHEN ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio < ar.avg_ratio * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RATIO' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RATIO' END AS ratio_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRatio ar ORDER BY ratio_category, ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, ic.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for the 'forge' display name computed over instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fimw.instance_uuid, fimw.hostname, fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow fimw JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column), ProjectUsage AS ( SELECT i.project_id, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_project_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_project_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, i.project_id, pu.total_project_vcpus, pu.total_project_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid JOIN ProjectUsage pu ON pu.project_id = i.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For availability zone "flare3", among instances with non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO whose VM_STATE appears in the per-VM-state geometric mean of migrated MEMORY_TOTAL (computed only from migrations with MEMORY_TOTAL > 0 and non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO), list the top 10 projects (by total vCPUs of those matching instances) showing each project's ID, total vCPUs, total memory, whether the project has any active migrations, and the average of the geometric-mean migrated-memory values across the matching VM states for that project. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fir.UUID) AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, AVG(vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states FROM flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS fir JOIN vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS vsgmmm ON fir.VM_STATE = vsgmmm.vm_state WHERE fir.NETWORK_INFO <> ''), flare3_matching_instances AS (SELECT i.project_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.vcpus, i.memory_mb, i.vm_state, vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total FROM instances i JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN (SELECT i2.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations m JOIN instances i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches c2 ON i2.uuid = c2.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c2.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i2.vm_state) vsgmmm ON vsgmmm.vm_state = i.vm_state WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND c.network_info <> '' AND i.deleted = 0) SELECT fmi.project_id, SUM(fmi.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(fmi.memory_mb) AS total_memory, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM migrations m JOIN instances i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = fmi.project_id AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations, AVG(fmi.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geom_mean_migrated_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states, inner_cte.flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem_overall, inner_cte.avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states_overall FROM flare3_matching_instances fmi CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY fmi.project_id, inner_cte.flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, inner_cte.avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states ORDER BY total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only migrations with status = 'completed', return the VM state, availability zone, total instance count, minimum instance memory (MB), and completed migration count for those instances, but only for state/zone groups where completed migrations account for more than 75% of the instances; also include the overall average completed-migration ratio across all VM state/availability zone groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, cmc.completed_migration_count FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ cmc ON isaz.VM_STATE = cmc.VM_STATE AND isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmc.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE (cmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / isaz.instance_count) > 0.75 ), avg_ratio AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(instance_count, 0)) AS avg_completed_migration_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, inner_cte.completed_migration_count, avg_ratio.avg_completed_migration_ratio FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN avg_ratio;

WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, cmc.completed_migration_count FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ cmc ON isaz.VM_STATE = cmc.VM_STATE AND isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmc.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE (cmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / isaz.instance_count) > 0.75;

question: For each VM state and “Reason” category produced by the existing memory-metrics logic, show the VM state, the reason, the corresponding memory summary metrics, and the number of distinct VMs contributing to that row. Include subtotals per VM state and a grand total across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), GeometricMeanMemoryByVMState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), CombinedVMStateMemoryMetrics AS ( SELECT ms.VM_STATE AS vm_state, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, NULL AS geometric_mean, 'Has image_image_type system metadata' AS Reason FROM MemoryStatsByVMState ms UNION ALL SELECT gm.vm_state AS vm_state, NULL AS avg_memory_mb, NULL AS memory_mb_range, NULL AS memory_mb_variance, gm.geometric_mean, 'Not deleted and has network info cache' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMemoryByVMState gm ) SELECT vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance, geometric_mean, Reason FROM CombinedVMStateMemoryMetrics ORDER BY vm_state, Reason) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.Reason) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.Reason END AS Reason, SUM(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, SUM(inner_cte.memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, SUM(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, SUM(inner_cte.geometric_mean) AS geometric_mean, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS contributing_vms FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE ( inner_cte.Reason = 'Has image_image_type system metadata' AND ism.instance_uuid IS NOT NULL ) OR ( inner_cte.Reason = 'Not deleted and has network info cache' AND i.deleted = 0 AND c.instance_uuid IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.Reason WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t2.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.extra_created_at, f.window_column, p.metadata_count_range, p.metadata_count_variance, p.metadata_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS f JOIN PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS p ON p.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.window_column, f.metadata_key ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.extra_created_at, ic.window_column, i.vcpus AS instance_vcpus, i.memory_mb AS instance_memory_mb, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid ORDER BY ic.window_column, ic.metadata_key;

question: For migrations that are not deleted, list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, system metadata key/value, the maximum instance memory (MB) over a window ordered by migration ID (current row through the next 2 rows), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for that same instance display name among “shelved_offloaded” instances that have extra metadata (only including display names with more than 5 records). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.key, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY project_usage AS ( SELECT i.project_id, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ), project_active_migrations AS ( SELECT i.project_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') GROUP BY i.project_id ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.dest_host, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.value, inner_cte.max_memory_mb_next2, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, i.project_id, pu.total_vcpus, pu.total_memory_mb, COALESCE(pam.has_active_migrations, 'No') AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN project_usage pu ON i.project_id = pu.project_id LEFT JOIN project_active_migrations pam ON i.project_id = pam.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopMetadataInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), CombinedDisplayNames AS (SELECT display_name, metadata_entries, NULL AS memory_range_mb, NULL AS memory_variance_mb, 'Top System Metadata Entries (flare3)' AS reason FROM TopMetadataInstances UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS metadata_entries, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb, 'Memory Range/Variance (non-empty key, not deleted)' AS reason FROM MemoryStatsByDisplayName) SELECT * FROM CombinedDisplayNames ORDER BY display_name, reason) SELECT display_name, MAX(COALESCE(metadata_entries, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb)) AS max_metric_value, COUNT(DISTINCT reason) AS reason_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ORDER BY display_name;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH completed_migrations_ranked AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.instance_display_name, cmr.instance_availability_zone, cmr.migration_status, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status_by_id, svms.instance_vm_state, svms.migration_count, svms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_ranked AS cmr JOIN status_vmstate_migration_stats AS svms ON cmr.migration_status = svms.migration_status ORDER BY cmr.migration_id, svms.instance_vm_state), rollup_stats AS ( SELECT migration_status, instance_vm_state, COUNT(DISTINCT migration_id) AS completed_migration_rows, MIN(min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb_across_rows, SUM(migration_count) AS summed_migration_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_status, instance_vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_vm_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_vm_state END AS instance_vm_state, SUM(completed_migration_rows) AS completed_migration_rows, MIN(min_instance_memory_mb_across_rows) AS min_instance_memory_mb_across_rows, SUM(summed_migration_count) AS summed_migration_count FROM rollup_stats GROUP BY migration_status, instance_vm_state WITH ROLLUP;

sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed';

WITH completed_migrations_ranked AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), status_vmstate_migration_stats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.instance_display_name, cmr.instance_availability_zone, cmr.migration_status, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status_by_id, svms.instance_vm_state, svms.migration_count, svms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_ranked AS cmr JOIN status_vmstate_migration_stats AS svms ON cmr.migration_status = svms.migration_status ORDER BY cmr.migration_id, svms.instance_vm_state;

question: For VM states and display names (considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs), for display names that also have a non-deleted network info cache and non-deleted system-metadata rows, return the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), and the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of per-instance system-metadata entry counts, but only for groups where the instance count is greater than 1; additionally, only keep results where the minimum memory is more than 75% of the maximum memory within the same VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceStateNameStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), DisplayNameMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT isns.VM_STATE, isns.DISPLAY_NAME, isns.instance_count, isns.min_memory_mb, dnms.metadata_count_range, dnms.metadata_count_variance, dnms.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceStateNameStats AS isns JOIN DisplayNameMetadataStats AS dnms ON isns.DISPLAY_NAME = dnms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE isns.instance_count > 1 ORDER BY isns.instance_count DESC, dnms.metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) AS state_memory ON state_memory.VM_STATE = inner_cte.VM_STATE WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / state_memory.max_memory_mb_in_state) > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_count DESC, inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0), find the instances whose completed migrations have a total memory_processed that is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean memory_processed per completed migration (and only for instances with cached network info). For each returned instance, also show how far its total processed memory deviates from the average total processed memory across the qualifying high-processed instances. Return the instance UUID, display name, memory in MB, vCPU count, the instance flavor JSON, the dense-rank window column, the total processed memory across migrations, and the deviation from the average total processed memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceWithFlavor AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), HighProcessedMemoryInstances AS (SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed' )) SELECT iwf.uuid, iwf.display_name, iwf.memory_mb, iwf.vcpus, iwf.flavor, iwf.window_column, hpmi.total_memory_processed FROM InstanceWithFlavor AS iwf JOIN HighProcessedMemoryInstances AS hpmi ON iwf.uuid = hpmi.instance_uuid ORDER BY iwf.uuid ), AverageHighProcessed AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_processed) AS avg_total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ic.total_memory_processed, (ic.total_memory_processed - ahp.avg_total_memory_processed) AS deviation_from_avg_total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageHighProcessed ahp ORDER BY ic.uuid;

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0), group the results by display name and report the root disk size coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) bucket (High if STDDEV(root_gb)/AVG(root_gb) > 0.5, otherwise Low) computed only for instances that have system metadata key = 'image_image_type' and non-deleted instance info cache rows (instance_info_caches.deleted = 0). For each display name and variation bucket, list the variation bucket label, the number of distinct instances, and include subtotals per display name and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT imw.uuid, imw.display_name, imw.key, imw.value, imw.window_column, rgv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw JOIN RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS rgv ON imw.display_name = rgv.display_name ORDER BY rgv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.uuid, imw.window_column) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(variation_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE variation_bucket END AS variation_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS total_instances FROM ( SELECT uuid, display_name, CASE WHEN coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS variation_bucket FROM inner_cte ) AS bucketed GROUP BY display_name, variation_bucket WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", for each system metadata key show the metadata key, the total number of distinct instances in flare3 that have that key, the average (across those instances) of the instance’s average memory remaining (in bytes) over completed migrations, the maximum memory-remaining standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (in bytes) observed among those instances, and the deviation of that key’s average-of-instance-average memory remaining from the overall average-of-instance-average memory remaining across all flare3 metadata keys. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), Flare3InstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT fim.metadata_key, COUNT(DISTINCT fim.instance_uuid) AS total_instances_in_flare3_with_key, AVG(ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes, MAX(ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes) AS max_memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM Flare3InstanceMetadata fim JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON ms.display_name = fim.display_name GROUP BY fim.metadata_key ORDER BY total_instances_in_flare3_with_key DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS overall_avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.metadata_key, ic.total_instances_in_flare3_with_key, ic.avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.max_memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, (ic.avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes - oa.overall_avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_of_instance_avg_memory_remaining_bytes FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.total_instances_in_flare3_with_key DESC;

question: For completed migrations (only where the instance has a maximum recorded migration total memory greater than 0), list each migration’s ID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the instance’s maximum total memory across its completed migrations, the migration’s rank within the completed status group (ordered by migration ID), the ratio of that maximum total memory divided by the migration rank (rounded to 2 decimals), and filter to only those rows where this ratio is greater than 0.75.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), CompletedMigrationsRanked AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmr.DEST_COMPUTE, cmr.instance_display_name, mm.max_memory_total, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status, ROUND(mm.max_memory_total / NULLIF(cmr.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationsRanked cmr JOIN MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus mm ON cmr.instance_display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, cmr.migration_id) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.migration_rank_within_completed_status, inner_cte.max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.max_memory_per_rank_ratio * 1.0) > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, inner_cte.migration_id;

SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0;

WITH MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), CompletedMigrationsRanked AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmr.DEST_COMPUTE, cmr.instance_display_name, mm.max_memory_total, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status, ROUND(mm.max_memory_total / NULLIF(cmr.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationsRanked cmr JOIN MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus mm ON cmr.instance_display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, cmr.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge" and that are not deleted, list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, system metadata key and value, network info, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by instance ID, and the variance of instance memory (in MB) for the "forge" display name (considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), but only keep rows where the instance’s memory (in MB) is greater than the average memory (in MB) of non-deleted "forge" instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' AND i.DELETED = 0), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fid.instance_uuid, fid.hostname, fid.vm_state, fid.metadata_key, fid.metadata_value, fid.network_info, fid.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS fid JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS mv ON mv.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fid.instance_uuid, fid.metadata_key), ForgeExtraMemoryAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_forge_memory_mb_with_extra FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' AND i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following, ic.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name = 'forge' AND i.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_forge_memory_mb_with_extra FROM ForgeExtraMemoryAvg) ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key;

question: For instances that have display name 'forge' and are in availability zone 'flare3', list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), along with the instance display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance extra record ID, and the row number within each VM state (ordered by instance UUID). sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), Flare3InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.hostname, fim.metadata_key, fim.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_by_metadata_key, fid.display_name, fid.vm_state, fid.memory_mb, fid.vcpus, fid.instance_extra_id, fid.window_column AS row_number_within_vm_state FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim JOIN Flare3InstanceDetails fid ON fim.instance_uuid = fid.instance_uuid ORDER BY fim.metadata_key, fim.instance_uuid) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.running_sum_instance_ids_by_metadata_key, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.row_number_within_vm_state, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.metadata_key) AS total_instances_for_metadata_key, avg_keys.avg_instance_count AS avg_instances_per_metadata_key FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS sub ) AS avg_keys ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For each migration status and VM state combination, list the migration-status-level memory statistics (average, range, and variance of instance memory in MB for instances with a non-deleted instance info cache record) together with the VM-state-level memory statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory in MB for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type'), and also include the deviation of each migration-status average memory from the overall average migration-status average memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), VMStateMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mms.migration_status, mms.avg_memory_mb AS migration_avg_memory_mb, mms.memory_mb_range AS migration_memory_mb_range, mms.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance, vms.VM_STATE, vms.avg_memory_mb AS vm_state_avg_memory_mb, vms.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, vms.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationMemoryStats mms CROSS JOIN VMStateMemoryStats vms ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_avg_memory_mb) AS overall_migration_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.migration_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_memory_mb_range, ic.migration_memory_mb_variance, ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, (ic.migration_avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_migration_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_migration_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa;

question: For each instance display name that already satisfies the “more than 75% of non-deleted instances have network info cache” and “more than 75% have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'” conditions, list only those display names whose total instance count is greater than the average total instance count across all such qualifying display names; return the display name, total instance count, counts with network info and with that metadata key, plus the memory range/variance (for instances with network info) and the average/variance (for instances with KEY = 'image_image_type'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH NetworkInfoMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), ImageTypeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), DisplayNameTotals AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.instance_uuid) AS instances_with_network_info, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ism.key = 'image_image_type' THEN ism.instance_uuid END) AS instances_with_image_image_type FROM instances i LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT dnt.display_name, dnt.total_instances, dnt.instances_with_network_info, dnt.instances_with_image_image_type, nims.memory_range_mb, nims.memory_variance_mb, itms.avg_memory_mb, itms.memory_mb_variance FROM DisplayNameTotals dnt JOIN NetworkInfoMemoryStats nims ON dnt.display_name = nims.display_name JOIN ImageTypeMemoryStats itms ON dnt.display_name = itms.display_name WHERE (dnt.instances_with_network_info * 1.0 / dnt.total_instances) > 0.75 AND (dnt.instances_with_image_image_type * 1.0 / dnt.total_instances) > 0.75 ) SELECT display_name, total_instances, instances_with_network_info, instances_with_image_image_type, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE total_instances > (SELECT AVG(total_instances) FROM inner_cte);

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is 'ether-60', list each migration status along with the total number of confirmed ether-60 migrations, the average, range, and variance of instance memory (MB) for instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, and include a subtotal row for all statuses combined. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ConfirmedEther60Migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ), MemoryStatsByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that have at least 1 completed migration, list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, along with the completed migration status, the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, the row number over instance display name (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following row), the total count of completed migrations for that instance, and the percentage of memory remaining during completed migrations (memory_remaining divided by memory_total) for that instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationsWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' ), ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column AS forge_min_memory_mb_window, cmw.migration_status, cmw.instance_flavor_json, cmw.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, fcmc.completed_migration_count FROM ForgeInstancesWindow fiw JOIN ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts fcmc ON fcmc.instance_uuid = fiw.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsWindow cmw ON cmw.instance_display_name = 'forge' WHERE fcmc.completed_migration_count >= 1 ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.forge_min_memory_mb_window, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_flavor_json, inner_cte.completed_migrations_row_number_window, inner_cte.completed_migration_count, AVG( CASE WHEN m.memory_total IS NOT NULL AND m.memory_total <> 0 THEN (m.memory_remaining * 1.0 / m.memory_total) ELSE NULL END ) AS completed_migrations_memory_remaining_pct FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m.status = 'completed' JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid AND i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.forge_min_memory_mb_window, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_flavor_json, inner_cte.completed_migrations_row_number_window, inner_cte.completed_migration_count ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_extra_id;

question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3", return the VM state and the maximum (across display names in that VM state) of the total vCPUs summed per display name, considering only those instances whose display name’s memory_mb variance is greater than 75% of the maximum memory_mb variance among the "flare3" display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, min(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), MemoryVarianceByName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryVarianceByNameFlare3 AS ( SELECT mvbn.display_name, mvbn.memory_mb_variance FROM MemoryVarianceByName mvbn WHERE mvbn.display_name IN ( SELECT DISTINCT idt.display_name FROM InstanceDetails idt ) ) SELECT idt.UUID, idt.DISPLAY_NAME, idt.VM_STATE, idt.MEMORY_MB, idt.VCPUS, idt.KEY_NAME, idt.instance_extra_id, idt.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, mvbnf3.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceDetails idt JOIN MemoryVarianceByNameFlare3 mvbnf3 ON idt.DISPLAY_NAME = mvbnf3.display_name WHERE mvbnf3.memory_mb_variance > ( SELECT 0.75 * MAX(memory_mb_variance) FROM MemoryVarianceByNameFlare3 ) ORDER BY mvbnf3.memory_mb_variance DESC, idt.VCPUS, idt.MEMORY_MB ), StateNameVcpuTotals AS ( SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(ic.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus_per_display_name FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT VM_STATE, MAX(total_vcpus_per_display_name) AS max_total_vcpus_per_display_name_in_state FROM StateNameVcpuTotals GROUP BY VM_STATE ORDER BY max_total_vcpus_per_display_name_in_state DESC, VM_STATE;

question: For each reason category (either “Shelved Offloaded VM State” or “Availability Zone flare3”), list the reason, the number of distinct instance display names returned by that category, and include a subtotal per reason plus a grand total. Use the same underlying selection logic that requires a matching INSTANCE_EXTRA row and computes the memory statistics for each display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Flare3MemoryDispersionStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), CombinedDisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, NULL AS memory_mb_range, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'Shelved Offloaded VM State' AS reason FROM ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStats UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_stddev, 'Availability Zone flare3' AS reason FROM Flare3MemoryDispersionStats ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDisplayNameMemoryStats ORDER BY display_name, reason ), ReasonCounts AS ( SELECT reason, COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS total_display_names FROM inner_cte GROUP BY reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(total_display_names) AS total_display_names FROM ReasonCounts GROUP BY reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each inclusion reason (either “Forge Window Rank” or “High Root Disk”), list the reason label, the number of included instances, and the number of distinct projects those instances belong to. Include subtotals per reason and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS ( SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), HighRootGBInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.UUID HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > ( SELECT AVG(ROOT_GB) + STDDEV(ROOT_GB) FROM INSTANCES ) ), CombinedInstances AS ( SELECT fwr.uuid AS instance_uuid, fwr.window_column, NULL AS total_root_gb, 'Forge Window Rank' AS reason FROM ForgeWindowRanks fwr UNION ALL SELECT hri.instance_uuid, NULL AS window_column, hri.total_root_gb, 'High Root Disk' AS reason FROM HighRootGBInstances hri ) SELECT instance_uuid, window_column, total_root_gb, reason FROM CombinedInstances ORDER BY instance_uuid, reason ), ReasonRollup AS ( SELECT inner_cte.reason, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances, COUNT(DISTINCT i.project_id) AS total_projects FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances, SUM(total_projects) AS total_projects FROM ReasonRollup GROUP BY reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the top 10 instance display names that (1) have completed migrations with a positive average migration MEMORY_REMAINING and (2) have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', show the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of days from created_at to launched_at, the ratio (coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average days to launch) rounded to 4 decimals, and whether the instance has any non-completed/non-failed active migrations (Yes/No).
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationMemCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), LaunchLagStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC) SELECT mmcv.display_name, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation, lls.avg_days_to_launch, lls.days_to_launch_stddev, ROUND(mmcv.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(lls.avg_days_to_launch, 0), 4) AS cv_to_avg_days_ratio FROM MigrationMemCV mmcv JOIN LaunchLagStats lls ON mmcv.display_name = lls.display_name ORDER BY cv_to_avg_days_ratio DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.cv_to_avg_days_ratio, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.cv_to_avg_days_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, return the coefficient of variation of the instance’s migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) across its migrations, considering only migrations with STATUS = 'completed'.

For each instance display name, what are the average and standard deviation of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'?

For each instance display name that (1) has completed migrations with a positive average migration MEMORY_REMAINING and (2) has system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, the coefficient of variation of migration MEMORY_REMAINING, the average and standard deviation of days from created_at to launched_at, and compute the ratio (coefficient of variation divided by average days to launch) rounded to 4 decimals.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC;

WITH MigrationMemCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), LaunchLagStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC) SELECT mmcv.display_name, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation, lls.avg_days_to_launch, lls.days_to_launch_stddev, ROUND(mmcv.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(lls.avg_days_to_launch, 0), 4) AS cv_to_avg_days_ratio FROM MigrationMemCV mmcv JOIN LaunchLagStats lls ON mmcv.display_name = lls.display_name ORDER BY cv_to_avg_days_ratio DESC;

question: For the top 10 migration statuses with the highest variance in instance memory (MEMORY_MB) among instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, list each migration status with its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also include (for each status) every instance VM state’s memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_migration_status AS ( SELECT status FROM q1 LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tms.status AS migration_status, q1.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_memory_mb_stddev, q2.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, q2.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_migration_status tms JOIN q1 ON q1.status = tms.status CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC, q2.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(migration_status) OVER (ORDER BY migration_memory_mb_variance DESC, vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, instance_vm_state) = migration_status THEN NULL ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, migration_memory_mb_variance, migration_memory_mb_stddev, instance_vm_state, vm_state_memory_mb_variance, vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY migration_memory_mb_variance DESC, vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, instance_vm_state;

question: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return the destination compute name, the number of completed migrations, the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group, whether any of those migrations involve an instance whose display name is one of the “shelved_offloaded” instances (with system metadata key “image_image_type”) whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB, and only keep destination computes whose completed-migration count is greater than the average completed-migration count across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE ), DestComputeAgg AS ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, completed_migration_count, min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM inner_cte ) SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, completed_migration_count, min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM DestComputeAgg WHERE completed_migration_count > (SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) FROM DestComputeAgg) ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also have a migration with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group ordered by instance ID, the migration source and destination compute, the migration status, the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID, and the deviation of that windowed minimum memory from the overall average of these windowed minimum-memory values. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key, fim.metadata_value, fim.power_state, fim.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = fim.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key ), avg_window_mem AS ( SELECT AVG(min_instance_memory_mb_window) AS avg_min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.power_state, ic.running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.migration_status, ic.min_instance_memory_mb_window, (ic.min_instance_memory_mb_window - awm.avg_min_instance_memory_mb_window) AS deviation_from_avg_min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window_mem awm ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (considering only non-deleted instance info cache records), display the instance display name, its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and for each matching non-deleted instance that has system metadata key = 'image_image_type' also show the instance UUID, availability zone, metadata entry count, total vCPUs, and whether the instance has a config drive enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH mem_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), meta_vcpu AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), top10_by_variance AS ( SELECT display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_stats ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.display_name, t.memory_mb_variance, t.memory_mb_stddev, mv.instance_uuid, mv.availability_zone, mv.metadata_entry_count, mv.total_vcpus FROM top10_by_variance AS t JOIN meta_vcpu AS mv ON t.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY t.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, c.instance_uuid, c.availability_zone, c.metadata_entry_count, c.total_vcpus, CASE WHEN i.config_drive IN ('True', 'true', '1', 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_config_drive FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each non-deleted security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to” port across its rules is greater than the average of the per-(security group, protocol) maximum “to” ports (computed across all non-deleted security groups), list the security group name, the protocol, that maximum “to” port, and (for tcp rules) the range and variance of the “from” port values for the same security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC ), AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS ( SELECT i.PROTOCOL, AVG(i.max_to_port * 1.0) AS avg_max_to_port FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PROTOCOL ) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol a ON a.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.max_to_port > ( SELECT a2.avg_max_to_port FROM AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol a2 WHERE a2.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL ) ORDER BY i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port DESC;

WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC;

i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_stddev_by_display_name) AS display_names_with_memory_stddev_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_migrations_with_window_avg cm JOIN instance_extra ie ON cm.UUID = ie.instance_uuid JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = cm.UUID WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded') AS completed_migrations_shelved_offloaded_with_extra_count ), per_display_name_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations_count FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed' WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), avg_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migrations_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_display_name FROM per_display_name_completed_migrations ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_mb_stddev, pdn.completed_migrations_count, acm.avg_completed_migrations_per_display_name, inner_cte.display_names_with_memory_stddev_count, inner_cte.completed_migrations_shelved_offloaded_with_extra_count FROM ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) ms JOIN per_display_name_completed_migrations pdn ON pdn.display_name = ms.display_name CROSS JOIN avg_completed_migrations acm CROSS JOIN inner_cte ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_stddev DESC;
