sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT csm.status AS migration_status, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.instance_uuid, csm.display_name, csm.memory_mb, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.instance_extra_id, csm.key AS system_metadata_key, csm.value AS system_metadata_value, csm.window_column AS migration_window_min_memory_mb, fi.window_column AS instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON csm.instance_uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY csm.instance_uuid, fi.instance_extra_id), ForgeShelvedAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_forge_shelved_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.system_metadata_key, ic.system_metadata_value, ic.migration_window_min_memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_forge_shelved_memory_mb FROM ForgeShelvedAvg) ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance_extra record ID, along with the running average of memory within the "forge" display-name group (ordered by memory) and the overall average and variance of memory (MB) for that same display name among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Also include, for each returned instance, the deviation of its memory (MB) from the overall average memory (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.id AS instance_extra_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.uuid, fi.display_name, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.window_column, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON fi.display_name = ms.display_name ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY display_name, memory_mb) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb - ic.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryByName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS HighMemoryAverages ) ORDER BY i.instance_display_name, i.migration_id;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', show each instance UUID and display name along with the display-name-level ROOT_GB range and variance, plus each instance’s system metadata key/value and its row number ordered by metadata key (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Also include the deviation of that display name’s ROOT_GB range from the average ROOT_GB range across all display names that have 'image_image_type' metadata, ordering results by the ROOT_GB range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT q2.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.root_gb_range, q1.root_gb_variance, q2.KEY AS system_metadata_key, q2.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, q2.window_column FROM q2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = q2.UUID JOIN q1 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism_img ON ism_img.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism_img.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.root_gb_range DESC, q2.window_column ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(root_gb_range) AS avg_root_gb_range FROM ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) AS per_display_name ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, ic.system_metadata_key, ic.system_metadata_value, ic.window_column, (ic.root_gb_range - ar.avg_root_gb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_root_gb_range FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges AS ar ORDER BY ic.root_gb_range DESC, ic.window_column;

COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_windowed_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindowedMins cmwm JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceNetworkCache AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.DISPLAY_NAME, inc.vm_state, inc.memory_mb, inc.network_info, ifm.FLAVOR, ifm.KEY, inc.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_dense_rank FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS ifm JOIN InstanceNetworkCache AS inc ON ifm.DISPLAY_NAME = inc.display_name ORDER BY ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY key_sort, metadata_key) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, total_rows, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.KEY END AS key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.KEY END AS metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.KEY WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY key_sort;

WITH InstanceNetworkCache AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.DISPLAY_NAME, inc.vm_state, inc.memory_mb, inc.network_info, ifm.FLAVOR, ifm.KEY, inc.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_dense_rank FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS ifm JOIN InstanceNetworkCache AS inc ON ifm.DISPLAY_NAME = inc.display_name ORDER BY ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.KEY;

question: For each active migration status (excluding accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed) where the geometric mean of migrated instances’ memory is greater than 0 MB, show the status, the geometric mean memory (MB), the average memory (MB), the memory variance, the memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the total number of non-deleted migrations, and the average number of non-deleted migrations per status. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemoryStatsByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.status, gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM MemoryStatsByStatus ms JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus gm ON ms.status = gm.status WHERE gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_variance DESC ), migration_counts AS ( SELECT m.status, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ), avg_migrations_per_status AS ( SELECT AVG(status_migration_count) AS avg_non_deleted_migrations_per_status FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS status_migration_count FROM migrations WHERE deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY status ) AS sub ) SELECT ic.status, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, mc.total_non_deleted_migrations, am.avg_non_deleted_migrations_per_status FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN migration_counts AS mc ON mc.status = ic.status CROSS JOIN avg_migrations_per_status AS am ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;

WITH GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemoryStatsByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.status, gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM MemoryStatsByStatus ms JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus gm ON ms.status = gm.status WHERE gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each VM state of non-deleted instances that currently have an active (non-terminal) migration, list the VM state, the migration memory_total variance, and the total number of non-deleted instances in that VM state. Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all VM states. Only include VM states where (variance ÷ total instances) is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory_total computed for instance display names matching 'prime' that have more than one 'image_image_type' system-metadata row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), VMStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VMStateTotalInstances AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT vsmv.VM_STATE, vsmv.memory_total_variance, vsti.total_instance_count FROM VMStateMemoryVariance vsmv JOIN VMStateTotalInstances vsti ON vsmv.VM_STATE = vsti.VM_STATE WHERE (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) > ( SELECT AVG(dnms.memory_total_stddev) FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev dnms ) ORDER BY (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, memory_total_variance, total_instance_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, VARIANCE(inner_cte.memory_total_variance) AS memory_total_variance, SUM(inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS total_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name;

WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), VMStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VMStateTotalInstances AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT vsmv.VM_STATE, vsmv.memory_total_variance, vsti.total_instance_count FROM VMStateMemoryVariance vsmv JOIN VMStateTotalInstances vsti ON vsmv.VM_STATE = vsti.VM_STATE WHERE (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) > ( SELECT AVG(dnms.memory_total_stddev) FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev dnms ) ORDER BY (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) DESC;

question: For each system metadata key among non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12" whose display name matches the pattern "prime" and that have completed migrations, find the metadata key and the maximum memory variance (MB) observed across those instances’ display names; only include keys where this maximum variance is greater than 0, ordered by the maximum variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), BlazeHostNonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT bhndim.INSTANCE_UUID, bhndim.DISPLAY_NAME, bhndim.FLAVOR, bhndim.KEY, bhndim.window_column, pcmms.avg_memory_mb, pcmms.memory_mb_variance FROM BlazeHostNonDeletedInstanceMetadata bhndim JOIN PrimeCompletedMigrationMemoryStats pcmms ON bhndim.DISPLAY_NAME = pcmms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE pcmms.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY pcmms.memory_mb_variance DESC, bhndim.KEY, bhndim.window_column, bhndim.INSTANCE_UUID) SELECT inner_cte.KEY, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS max_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.KEY HAVING MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) > 0 ORDER BY max_memory_mb_variance DESC, inner_cte.KEY;

WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), BlazeHostNonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT bhndim.INSTANCE_UUID, bhndim.DISPLAY_NAME, bhndim.FLAVOR, bhndim.KEY, bhndim.window_column, pcmms.avg_memory_mb, pcmms.memory_mb_variance FROM BlazeHostNonDeletedInstanceMetadata bhndim JOIN PrimeCompletedMigrationMemoryStats pcmms ON bhndim.DISPLAY_NAME = pcmms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE pcmms.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY pcmms.memory_mb_variance DESC, bhndim.KEY, bhndim.window_column, bhndim.INSTANCE_UUID;

question: For the combined result set of (1) flare3 instances with completed migrations whose display name matches 'flare' and (2) completed migrations whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12', return only the rows where the instance’s memory is at least 75% of the maximum instance memory observed in that combined set, and include the instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, running memory sum within migration type, migration ID, source compute, destination compute, migration rank within status, the maximum memory in the combined set, and the memory utilization ratio (instance_memory / max_memory). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Flare3CompletedFlareInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.instance_display_name, f.migration_status, f.window_column AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS migration_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS source_compute, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS dest_compute, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Flare3 flare* instances (completed migrations)' AS reason FROM Flare3CompletedFlareInstances f UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS CHAR(36)) AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS migration_status, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, c.migration_id, c.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, c.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, c.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Completed migrations on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost c ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_display_name, migration_id) , CombinedWithMemory AS ( SELECT inner_cte.*, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid OR i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.instance_display_name ), MaxMem AS ( SELECT MAX(instance_memory_mb) AS max_instance_memory_mb FROM CombinedWithMemory ) SELECT cwm.instance_uuid, cwm.instance_display_name, cwm.migration_status, cwm.running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, cwm.migration_id, cwm.source_compute, cwm.dest_compute, cwm.migration_rank_within_status, cwm.reason, cwm.instance_memory_mb, mm.max_instance_memory_mb, (cwm.instance_memory_mb * 1.0 / mm.max_instance_memory_mb) AS memory_utilization_ratio FROM CombinedWithMemory cwm CROSS JOIN MaxMem mm WHERE cwm.instance_memory_mb IS NOT NULL AND (cwm.instance_memory_mb * 1.0 / mm.max_instance_memory_mb) >= 0.75 ORDER BY memory_utilization_ratio DESC, cwm.reason, cwm.instance_display_name, cwm.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', list the migration status, instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache (computed over non-deleted instances), the cached network info, the instance flavor JSON from instance_extra, and the row number ordered by instance display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT cpm.migration_status, cpm.instance_display_name, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cpm.instance_network_info, cpm.window_column FROM CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow cpm JOIN CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName cov ON cov.display_name = cpm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cpm.instance_display_name ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.instance_display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.instance_network_info, ie.flavor AS instance_flavor, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.instance_display_name AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC, ic.instance_display_name;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMetadataSummary AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ims.instance_uuid, ims.display_name, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus, dms.min_instance_id, dms.avg_memory_mb, ROUND(ims.total_vcpus / NULLIF(ims.metadata_entry_count, 0), 2) AS avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM InstanceMetadataSummary ims JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON ims.display_name = dms.display_name ORDER BY avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.metadata_entry_count, inner_cte.total_vcpus, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry DESC;

question: For instances hosted on prime-35 (and having system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type'), for each instance display name and availability zone show the ROOT_GB range and variance, and across the instances with that display name and availability zone how many instances are there, how many completed migrations occurred in total, and how much memory was processed in total. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH root_stats_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), migration_stats_by_instance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT r.display_name, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance, COUNT(ms.instance_uuid) AS instance_count, SUM(ms.migration_count) AS total_migration_count, SUM(ms.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM root_stats_by_display_name r JOIN migration_stats_by_instance ms ON ms.display_name = r.display_name GROUP BY r.display_name, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance ORDER BY total_migration_count DESC, total_memory_processed DESC ), display_name_az_breakdown AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, MAX(i.root_gb) - MIN(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count, COUNT(m.id) AS total_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid LEFT JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed' WHERE i.host = 'prime-35' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(d.display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE d.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(d.availability_zone) = 1 AND GROUPING(d.display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(d.availability_zone) = 1 AND GROUPING(d.display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE d.availability_zone END AS availability_zone, SUM(d.root_gb_range) AS root_gb_range, SUM(d.root_gb_variance) AS root_gb_variance, SUM(d.instance_count) AS instance_count, SUM(d.total_migration_count) AS total_migration_count, SUM(d.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM display_name_az_breakdown d JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.display_name = d.display_name GROUP BY d.display_name, d.availability_zone WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare') SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q1.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state, q2.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(q2.vcpus / NULLIF(q2.memory_mb, 0), 6) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid WHERE q2.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, q1.instance_uuid), avg_density AS ( SELECT AVG(vcpus_per_mb_ratio) AS avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state, ic.max_metadata_id_next_2, ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio, ad.avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio AS benchmark_vcpus_per_mb_ratio, CASE WHEN ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio > ad.avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DENSITY' WHEN ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio < ad.avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DENSITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DENSITY' END AS density_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_density ad ORDER BY ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, ic.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceNameStateCounts AS (SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE), InstanceDetailsWindowed AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT d.instance_id, d.instance_uuid, d.user_id, d.project_id, d.display_name, d.vm_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.info_cache_id, d.max_instance_id_next_2, c.instance_count, c.earliest_created_at FROM InstanceDetailsWindowed AS d JOIN InstanceNameStateCounts AS c ON c.DISPLAY_NAME = d.display_name AND c.VM_STATE = d.vm_state ORDER BY d.display_name, d.vm_state, d.instance_id ), AvgGroupInstanceCount AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT display_name, vm_state, MAX(instance_count) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, vm_state ) grouped_counts ) SELECT i.instance_id, i.instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.info_cache_id, i.max_instance_id_next_2, i.instance_count, i.earliest_created_at, (i.instance_count - a.avg_instance_count) AS deviation_from_avg_group_instance_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgGroupInstanceCount a ORDER BY i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.instance_id;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH windowed_instances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), host_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM windowed_instances) AS flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_memory_stats) AS blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM windowed_instances wi CROSS JOIN host_memory_stats hms LIMIT 1 ) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations, inner_cte.flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, inner_cte.blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id, inner_cte.flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, inner_cte.blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations ORDER BY total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 5;

source_compute, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS dest_compute, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS memory_total, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS migration_memory_total_window_avg, 'System Metadata (ranked)' AS reason question: For each instance display name returned by the existing geometric-mean vs. range/variance comparison, show the display name, geometric-mean memory (MB), memory range (MB), memory variance (MB), the rounded ratio of geometric-mean memory to memory range, the overall average of that ratio across all returned display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_RATIO' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_RATIO' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_RATIO'.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeomMeanMemByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemRangeVarByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT gm.display_name, gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, rv.memory_range_mb, rv.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb / NULLIF(rv.memory_range_mb, 0), 4) AS GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio FROM GeomMeanMemByDisplayName gm JOIN MemRangeVarByDisplayName rv ON gm.display_name = rv.display_name ORDER BY GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio DESC), AverageRatio AS (SELECT AVG(GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ic.GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio, ar.avg_ratio AS benchmark_ratio, CASE WHEN ic.GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio > ar.avg_ratio * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RATIO' WHEN ic.GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio < ar.avg_ratio * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RATIO' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RATIO' END AS ratio_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRatio ar ORDER BY ic.GeomMean_to_Range_Ratio DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMemoryCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN MigrationMemoryCV AS mmcv ON ims.display_name = mmcv.display_name ORDER BY mmcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, ims.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC, inner_cte.display_name;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most instance info cache records among instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare', show each display name, its cache record count, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) for that same display name among instances on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata key = 'image_image_type' and memory_mb > 0, the overall average cache record count across these top 10 display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_CACHE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_CACHE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_CACHE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH top_cache_by_display_name AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), geom_mean_memory_by_display_name AS ( SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT t.display_name, t.cache_records, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM top_cache_by_display_name AS t LEFT JOIN geom_mean_memory_by_display_name AS g ON t.display_name = g.display_name ORDER BY t.cache_records DESC ), avg_cache AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records AS benchmark, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.cache_records > ac.avg_cache_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE' WHEN ic.cache_records < ac.avg_cache_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE' END AS cache_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cache AS ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" that have a completed migration, return each instance’s display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with the average, range, and variance of instance memory (MB) for that same migration status among instances on "blaze8-12" that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, and also include (for each migration status) the total number of such non-deleted instance info cache records and the average of those per-status totals across all migration statuses on "blaze8-12". sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMigrations AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), MigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT im.DISPLAY_NAME, im.HOSTNAME, im.VM_STATE, im.MEMORY_MB, im.VCPUS, im.UUID, im.STATUS, im.max_migration_id_next2, mms.avg_memory_mb, mms.memory_mb_range, mms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceMigrations AS im JOIN MigrationMemoryStats AS mms ON im.STATUS = mms.migration_status) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, status_ic_counts.total_non_deleted_info_cache_records, avg_status_ic_counts.avg_non_deleted_info_cache_records_per_status FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_info_cache_records FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ) AS status_ic_counts ON inner_cte.STATUS = status_ic_counts.migration_status JOIN ( SELECT AVG(per_status.total_non_deleted_info_cache_records) AS avg_non_deleted_info_cache_records_per_status FROM ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_info_cache_records FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ) AS per_status ) AS avg_status_ic_counts;

question: For each instance display name matching the pattern 'prime', return the migration-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for completed migrations per instance, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record; then, for each such display name, report the maximum of the per-metric values (migration-count range vs. MEMORY_MB variance) to identify which metric is larger. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, mem.memory_mb_variance, mem.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MemoryStats mem ON ms.display_name = mem.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.migration_count_range) AS max_migration_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS max_memory_mb_variance, CASE WHEN MAX(inner_cte.migration_count_range) >= MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) THEN 'migration_count_range' ELSE 'memory_mb_variance' END AS larger_metric FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ic2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DaysToLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), HostInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT hi.uuid) AS host_instance_count, AVG(hi.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb_on_host, AVG(hi.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus_on_host FROM HostInstances hi JOIN DaysToLaunchStats dls ON hi.display_name = dls.display_name GROUP BY hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev ORDER BY dls.days_to_launch_stddev DESC) , PerProjectHostCounts AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS host_instances_in_project FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.project_id ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host, MAX(pphc.host_instances_in_project) AS max_host_instance_count_in_any_project FROM inner_cte ic JOIN PerProjectHostCounts pphc ON pphc.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host ORDER BY ic.days_to_launch_stddev DESC;

question: For each quota usage record with a positive in-use amount, list the quota usage ID, project ID, and resource type, along with the number of linked reservations and the total reserved delta across those reservations (only including reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH UsageReservationStats AS ( SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE ), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, question: For host "blaze8-12", among VM states whose total instance memory (across non-deleted instances) is greater than the host’s overall average instance memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), show the VM state, each active (non-hidden) migration status for that VM state, the number of instances in those migrations, the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL, the total instance memory for the VM state, the ratio of minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL to total instance memory, and (for context) the total vCPUs and the number of distinct projects contributing instances in that VM state on that host.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ), HighMemoryStatesOnHost AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ) SELECT hm.vm_state, am.migration_status, am.instance_count, am.min_memory_total, hm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(am.min_memory_total / NULLIF(hm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HighMemoryStatesOnHost hm JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState am ON hm.vm_state = am.vm_state ORDER BY MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio DESC ), HostStateContext AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_on_host_for_state, COUNT(DISTINCT i.project_id) AS distinct_projects_on_host_for_state FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_total, ic.total_memory_mb, ic.MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio, hsc.total_vcpus_on_host_for_state, hsc.distinct_projects_on_host_for_state FROM inner_cte ic JOIN HostStateContext hsc ON ic.vm_state = hsc.vm_state ORDER BY ic.MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio DESC, ic.vm_state, ic.migration_status;

question: For completed migrations on instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', list the migration ID, instance display name, system metadata key and value, and the rank of each metadata row within its metadata key group ordered by migration ID, and also include (for the same metadata key) the migrated-instances memory range (max minus min) and memory variance in MB computed from completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12'. Additionally, for each metadata key, include a rollup-style summary that shows the total number of distinct migrations and distinct instances represented in the result set, with subtotals per metadata key and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime'), MetadataKeyMemoryStats AS (SELECT ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ism.KEY ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT pcm.migration_id, pcm.instance_display_name, pcm.metadata_key, pcm.metadata_value, pcm.window_column, mkms.memory_mb_range, mkms.memory_mb_variance FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationMetadata pcm JOIN MetadataKeyMemoryStats mkms ON pcm.metadata_key = mkms.metadata_key ), KeyLevelCounts AS ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(DISTINCT migration_id) AS distinct_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_display_name) AS distinct_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.metadata_value) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.metadata_value END AS metadata_value, COUNT(DISTINCT i.migration_id) AS distinct_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT i.instance_display_name) AS distinct_instances, MAX(i.memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, MAX(i.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN KeyLevelCounts klc ON i.metadata_key = klc.metadata_key GROUP BY i.metadata_key, i.metadata_value WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each availability zone and display name, classify whether the display name has any completed migrations (label as 'Active' if at least one completed migration exists for that display name in that availability zone, otherwise 'Inactive'), and report the number of distinct instances in each category. Include subtotals per availability zone and a grand total. Use the existing combined instance/migration result set as the inner CTE and roll up the counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare'), PrimeMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), CombinedInstanceView AS ( SELECT fi.instance_uuid, fi.hostname, fi.display_name, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.flavor_json, fi.numa_topology_json, fi.network_info_json, fi.window_column, 'Flare AZ Instance Details' AS reason FROM FlareInstances fi UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS hostname, pms.display_name AS display_name, NULL AS memory_mb, NULL AS vcpus, NULL AS flavor_json, NULL AS numa_topology_json, NULL AS network_info_json, NULL AS window_column, 'Prime Completed Migration Memory Stats' AS reason FROM PrimeMigrationStats pms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY reason, display_name, hostname, instance_uuid), DisplayNameZoneStatus AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, ic.display_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.availability_zone = i.availability_zone AND i2.display_name = ic.display_name ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.availability_zone, ic.display_name, migration_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM DisplayNameZoneStatus GROUP BY availability_zone, display_name, migration_status WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), top10 AS ( SELECT sq1.DISPLAY_NAME, sq1.metadata_count_range FROM sq1 ORDER BY sq1.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DISPLAY_NAME, sq1.metadata_count_range, sq1.metadata_count_variance, sq1.metadata_count_stddev, sq2.cache_count_range, sq2.cache_count_variance, sq2.cache_count_stddev FROM top10 AS t JOIN sq1 ON sq1.DISPLAY_NAME = t.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN sq2 ON sq2.DISPLAY_NAME = t.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY t.metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 THEN 'ALL TOP10' ELSE 'DETAIL' END AS row_type, SUM(inner_cte.metadata_count_range) AS sum_metadata_count_range, AVG(inner_cte.metadata_count_variance) AS avg_metadata_count_variance, AVG(inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev) AS avg_metadata_count_stddev, SUM(inner_cte.cache_count_range) AS sum_cache_count_range, AVG(inner_cte.cache_count_variance) AS avg_cache_count_variance, AVG(inner_cte.cache_count_stddev) AS avg_cache_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH completed_migrations_on_blaze AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), memory_stddev_by_display_name_on_blaze AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.HOSTNAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.UUID, cm.STATUS, cm.max_migration_id_next2, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM completed_migrations_on_blaze AS cm JOIN memory_stddev_by_display_name_on_blaze AS ms ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, completed_migrations, avg_memory_mb, max_of_max_migration_id_next2 FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(max_migration_id_next2) AS max_of_max_migration_id_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, uuid WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, uuid;

question: For each quota usage record with a positive in-use amount, return the quota usage ID, project ID, and resource type, along with the number of linked reservations and the total reserved delta across those reservations (only counting reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59). Also include, for that resource type, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, and the average reserved delta per reservation. Finally, only keep those usage records whose average reserved delta per reservation is greater than the overall average reserved delta per reservation across all such usage records, ordering by delta variance descending.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH UsageReservationStats AS ( SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE ), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC ) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC) SELECT i.usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.reservation_count, i.total_reserved_delta, i.delta_variance, i.delta_stddev, i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM inner_cte i JOIN QUOTA_USAGES qu ON qu.ID = i.usage_id WHERE i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation > (SELECT AVG(i2.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation * 1.0) FROM inner_cte i2 JOIN QUOTA_USAGES qu2 ON qu2.ID = i2.usage_id) ORDER BY i.delta_variance DESC;

question: For the host "blaze8-12", for each active migration status and instance VM state (only for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type'), return the number of active migrations and the minimum instance memory (in MB), along with the variance of instance memory (in MB) for that VM state among instances on "blaze8-12" that have a corresponding network info cache record; also include the deviation of that VM-state memory variance from the average VM-state memory variance on "blaze8-12". sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH VmStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), ActiveMigrationStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ) SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb, vsmv.memory_mb_variance FROM ActiveMigrationStats ams JOIN VmStateMemoryVariance vsmv ON ams.instance_vm_state = vsmv.VM_STATE ORDER BY ams.migration_count DESC, vsmv.memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.migration_count DESC, ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For the same set of instance display names that (1) are not deleted and are running on host 'blaze8-12' with extra metadata present, and (2) have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and a display name matching the pattern 'prime' across migrations, list the display name, a migration activity status ('Active' if any non-deleted, non-completed/failed/error migrations exist for that instance and 'Inactive' otherwise), and the host-level variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) along with the migration-level variance of instance memory (MB). Include subtotals for each migration activity status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HostInstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), MigrationInstanceMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT hims.display_name, hims.memory_mb_variance AS host_memory_mb_variance, hims.memory_mb_stddev AS host_memory_mb_stddev, mimv.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance FROM HostInstanceMemoryStats hims JOIN MigrationInstanceMemoryVariance mimv ON hims.display_name = mimv.display_name), InstanceMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT ic.display_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m JOIN instances i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_status, ic.host_memory_mb_variance, ic.host_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(host_memory_mb_variance) AS avg_host_memory_mb_variance, AVG(host_memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_host_memory_mb_stddev, AVG(migration_memory_mb_variance) AS avg_migration_memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceMigrationStatus GROUP BY migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the non-deleted instances (DELETED = 0) on host "blaze8-12" that also have a completed migration (status = "completed") on that same host, return only those rows where the instance’s VM state is different from the most common VM state among these instances; include the instance UUID, display name, VM state, system metadata key and value (with the rank of each metadata row within its metadata-key group ordered by instance UUID), plus the migration status, source compute, destination compute, and the instance flavor JSON (with the dense rank for the migration status). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.VM_STATE, imr.KEY AS system_metadata_key, imr.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, imr.window_column AS metadata_rank_within_key, cmwf.status AS migration_status, cmwf.source_compute, cmwf.dest_compute, cmwf.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, cmwf.window_column AS migration_status_dense_rank FROM InstanceMetadataRanks AS imr JOIN CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor AS cmwf ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = cmwf.display_name ), VmStateCounts AS ( SELECT i.host, i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS vm_state_count FROM INSTANCES i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.host, i.vm_state ), MostCommonVmState AS ( SELECT vsc.host, vsc.vm_state FROM VmStateCounts vsc WHERE vsc.vm_state_count = ( SELECT MAX(vsc2.vm_state_count) FROM VmStateCounts vsc2 WHERE vsc2.host = vsc.host ) ) SELECT ic.UUID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.VM_STATE, ic.system_metadata_key, ic.system_metadata_value, ic.metadata_rank_within_key, ic.migration_status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_flavor_json, ic.migration_status_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.uuid = ic.UUID JOIN MostCommonVmState mcvs ON mcvs.host = i2.host WHERE ic.VM_STATE <> mcvs.vm_state;

question: For instance display names that appear on both host 'prime-35' and host 'blaze8-12' (considering only instances with system metadata key = 'image_image_type', and for blaze8-12 only non-deleted instance info cache rows), return each display name along with the root disk size (ROOT_GB) range and variance on prime-35 and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB on blaze8-12; additionally, include the count of distinct image types (INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA.VALUE for key = 'image_image_type') observed for that display name across both hosts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Prime35Stats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ), Blaze812CV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT p.DISPLAY_NAME, p.root_gb_range, p.root_gb_variance, b.coefficient_of_variation FROM Prime35Stats p JOIN Blaze812CV b ON b.display_name = p.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, ic.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT ism_all.VALUE) AS distinct_image_types_across_hosts FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i_all ON i_all.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i_all.host IN ('prime-35', 'blaze8-12') JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism_all ON ism_all.INSTANCE_UUID = i_all.UUID AND ism_all.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY distinct_image_types_across_hosts DESC, ic.root_gb_range DESC;

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12" that (a) have a completed migration and (b) have a display name that appears in more than one instance with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name (computed over the KEY = 'image_image_type' instances on "blaze8-12"), along with the deviation of that display name’s memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such display names on "blaze8-12"; order by the deviation descending and then by instance UUID. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS AS migration_status, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_stddev DESC, q1.UUID ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.HOSTNAME, ic.VM_STATE, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.VCPUS, ic.UUID, ic.migration_status, ic.max_migration_id_next2, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC, ic.UUID;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' ), VMStateGeoMean AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT id.display_name, id.availability_zone, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.uuid, id.max_metadata_id_next_2, vmg.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM InstanceDetails id LEFT JOIN VMStateGeoMean vmg ON id.vm_state = vmg.vm_state ) SELECT display_name, availability_zone, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, uuid, max_metadata_id_next_2, geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_memory_mb IS NOT NULL);

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that have completed migrations and also have system metadata key image_image_type, show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the instance system metadata key, the image_image_type metadata value, and cached network info, along with the migration dense rank and the image-type row number; additionally, include the overall average of the migration dense rank and each row’s deviation from that average. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), ImageTypeMetadata AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, itm.metadata_value, itm.network_info, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, itm.window_column AS image_type_row_number FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN ImageTypeMetadata itm ON md.display_name = itm.display_name ORDER BY md.display_name, itm.metadata_value ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_dense_rank) AS avg_migration_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.instance_system_metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.migration_dense_rank, ic.image_type_row_number, ar.avg_migration_dense_rank, (ic.migration_dense_rank - ar.avg_migration_dense_rank) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.metadata_value;

question: For each VM state, among instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' while running on host 'blaze8-12', return the maximum (across display names in that VM state) of the per-display-name range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of network-info cache records per instance, along with the maximum instance count and maximum minimum-memory (in MB) observed for any display name in that VM state.
