sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CacheStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), InstanceCountsAndMinMemory AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, cs.cache_count_range, cs.cache_count_variance, cs.cache_count_stddev FROM InstanceCountsAndMinMemory ic JOIN CacheStatsByDisplayName cs ON cs.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT VM_STATE, MAX(cache_count_range) AS max_cache_count_range_across_display_names, MAX(cache_count_variance) AS max_cache_count_variance_across_display_names, MAX(cache_count_stddev) AS max_cache_count_stddev_across_display_names, MAX(instance_count) AS max_instance_count_across_display_names, MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_of_min_memory_mb_across_display_names FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VM_STATE;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH instance_details AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), memory_variance_by_state AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT id.UUID, id.DISPLAY_NAME, id.VM_STATE, id.MEMORY_MB, id.NETWORK_INFO, id.window_column, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM instance_details AS id JOIN memory_variance_by_state AS mv ON id.VM_STATE = mv.VM_STATE ORDER BY mv.memory_mb_variance DESC, id.VM_STATE, id.window_column ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance_across_states FROM ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS sub ) SELECT ic.UUID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.VM_STATE, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance_across_states FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance AS av;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance system metadata key, the dense-rank window value per instance UUID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB for that same instance display name (computed only from system-metadata rows with key = 'image_image_type' on host 'blaze8-12'). Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per migration status showing the number of rows and the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_details AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, md.window_column, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM migration_details md JOIN root_gb_cov_by_display_name rgb ON md.display_name = rgb.display_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status_name) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status_name, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, instance_system_metadata_key, window_column) = status_name THEN NULL ELSE status_name END AS status, source_compute, dest_compute, display_name, instance_system_metadata_key, window_column, coefficient_of_variation, subtotal_row_count, subtotal_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.status END AS status_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.instance_system_metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.status) AS subtotal_row_count, AVG(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.status) AS subtotal_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.instance_system_metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status_name, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, instance_system_metadata_key, window_column;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, md.NETWORK_INFO, md.window_column, imv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(md.migration_id / NULLIF(imv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryVariation imv ON md.instance_display_name = imv.display_name ORDER BY migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio DESC) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio, ism.value AS image_image_type_value FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.instance_display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio DESC;

WITH PrimeInstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), CompletedFlareMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare') SELECT cfm.migration_id, cfm.migration_status, cfm.source_compute, cfm.dest_compute, cfm.instance_uuid, cfm.instance_display_name, cfm.instance_memory_mb, cfm.instance_extra_id, cfm.window_column, pims.memory_range_mb, pims.memory_variance_mb FROM CompletedFlareMigrations cfm LEFT JOIN PrimeInstanceMemoryStats pims ON cfm.instance_display_name = pims.display_name ORDER BY cfm.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are on host 'blaze8-12' (and with non-deleted instance info cache records), which migration types have at least 2 such migrations, and for each of those migration types return the migration type, the total count of completed migrations, the minimum MEMORY_TOTAL value within that migration type, and the deviation of that minimum MEMORY_TOTAL from the overall average MEMORY_TOTAL across all migrations returned by the base result set? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, MIN(md.window_column) AS Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN MigrationRanks mr ON md.migration_id = mr.migration_id GROUP BY md.MIGRATION_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC, md.MIGRATION_TYPE), AverageMemoryTotal AS ( SELECT AVG(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS avg_memory_total FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cte.MIGRATION_TYPE, cte.Completed_Migration_Count, cte.Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type, (cte.Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type - amt.avg_memory_total) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_total FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN AverageMemoryTotal amt ORDER BY cte.Completed_Migration_Count DESC, cte.MIGRATION_TYPE;

question: For completed migrations of instances hosted on "blaze8-12", show each instance display name, migration status, migration destination compute host, the row number ordered by destination compute using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for that instance (restricted to instances with instance system metadata key "image_image_type"). Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per destination compute showing the number of instances and the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMigrationWindow AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMigrationMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT imw.DISPLAY_NAME, imw.STATUS, imw.DEST_COMPUTE, imw.window_column, imcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationWindow imw JOIN InstanceMigrationMemoryCV imcv ON imw.DISPLAY_NAME = imcv.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.DEST_COMPUTE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, status, dest_compute, window_column, coefficient_of_variation, instances_in_dest_compute, avg_cv_in_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.dest_compute) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.dest_compute END AS dest_compute_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.dest_compute) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.dest_compute END AS dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS instances_in_dest_compute, AVG(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute, display_name;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" that are not deleted, and whose display name is among the top 10 display names with the most system metadata entries in availability zone 'flare3' matching the pattern 'flare', compute (per display name) the maximum of the per-instance rounded ratio of metadata entries divided by that instance’s dense rank, and return the display name along with that maximum ratio.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopMetadataDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), HostInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT him.uuid, him.display_name, tmdn.metadata_entries, him.key, him.value, him.window_column, ROUND(tmdn.metadata_entries / NULLIF(him.window_column, 0), 2) AS metadata_entries_per_dense_rank FROM HostInstanceMetadata him JOIN TopMetadataDisplayNames tmdn ON him.display_name = tmdn.display_name ORDER BY tmdn.metadata_entries DESC, him.display_name, him.uuid, him.window_column) SELECT display_name, MAX(metadata_entries_per_dense_rank) AS max_metadata_entries_per_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ORDER BY max_metadata_entries_per_dense_rank DESC, display_name;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12', list the instance UUID, display name, key name, the number of system metadata entries and total vCPUs (from those metadata rows), along with the minimum instance ID and average memory (MB) for that display name among non-deleted instances on 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata key 'image_image_type', compute the average vCPUs per metadata entry (total vCPUs divided by metadata entry count) rounded to 2 decimals, and also include the overall average of this per-instance ratio across all such instances.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMetadataSummary AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ims.instance_uuid, ims.display_name, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus, dms.min_instance_id, dms.avg_memory_mb, ROUND(ims.total_vcpus / NULLIF(ims.metadata_entry_count, 0), 2) AS avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM InstanceMetadataSummary ims JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON ims.display_name = dms.display_name ORDER BY avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.metadata_entry_count, inner_cte.total_vcpus, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry, overall_avg.avg_avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry) AS avg_avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry DESC;

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', list only those instances where the completed-migration memory processed ratio (memory_processed divided by memory_total) is greater than 75%, and for each such instance show the instance display name, migration count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed migrations per instance, the completed migration status, the instance cached network info, the window row number (ordered by instance display name with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the memory utilization ratio. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationCountDispersion AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), CompletedPrimeMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT mcd.display_name AS instance_display_name, mcd.migration_count_range, mcd.migration_count_variance, mcd.migration_count_stddev, cpmd.migration_status, cpmd.instance_network_info, cpmd.window_column FROM MigrationCountDispersion AS mcd JOIN CompletedPrimeMigrationDetails AS cpmd ON mcd.display_name = cpmd.instance_display_name ORDER BY mcd.migration_count_range DESC, cpmd.window_column) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.migration_count_range, ic.migration_count_variance, ic.migration_count_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_network_info, ic.window_column, (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = ic.instance_display_name JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_total IS NOT NULL AND m.memory_total <> 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75 ORDER BY ic.migration_count_range DESC, ic.window_column, memory_processed_ratio DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC;

SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime';

WITH MigrationCountDispersion AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), CompletedPrimeMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT mcd.display_name AS instance_display_name, mcd.migration_count_range, mcd.migration_count_variance, mcd.migration_count_stddev, cpmd.migration_status, cpmd.instance_network_info, cpmd.window_column FROM MigrationCountDispersion AS mcd JOIN CompletedPrimeMigrationDetails AS cpmd ON mcd.display_name = cpmd.instance_display_name ORDER BY mcd.migration_count_range DESC, cpmd.window_column;

question: For each instance display name matching the pattern "prime" (with non-deleted instances and only completed migrations), show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory in MB. Then, for each such display name, report whether there exist any "flare" instances in availability zone "flare3" whose memory in MB equals that average, along with the count of those matching flare3/flare instances and the average of their windowed memory column. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, inner_cte.Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count, AVG(fw.window_column) AS avg_flare3_window_memory_mb FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN INSTANCES p ON p.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND p.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = p.UUID AND ism2.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ) fw ON fw.memory_mb = inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, inner_cte.Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each migration status among instances on host blaze8-12 that have a completed migration, return the migration status and the maximum number of distinct (non-deleted) instances (grouped by display name and VM state) that have the system metadata key image_image_type for any instance participating in that status. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceImageTypeStats AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ), CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), TotalCompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT cmh.UUID AS instance_uuid, cmh.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, cmh.STATUS AS migration_status, cmh.DEST_COMPUTE AS destination_compute_host, cmh.window_column AS migration_status_rank, iits.VM_STATE AS vm_state, iits.instance_count AS distinct_instance_count_for_display_name_and_state, iits.earliest_created_at AS earliest_instance_created_at_for_display_name_and_state FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cmh JOIN InstanceImageTypeStats iits ON cmh.DISPLAY_NAME = iits.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cmh.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT migration_status, MAX(distinct_instance_count_for_display_name_and_state) AS max_distinct_instances_with_image_image_type_per_display_name_and_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_status;

WITH InstanceImageTypeStats AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ), CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), TotalCompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT cmh.UUID AS instance_uuid, cmh.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, cmh.STATUS AS migration_status, cmh.DEST_COMPUTE AS destination_compute_host, cmh.window_column AS migration_status_rank, iits.VM_STATE AS vm_state, iits.instance_count AS distinct_instance_count_for_display_name_and_state, iits.earliest_created_at AS earliest_instance_created_at_for_display_name_and_state FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cmh JOIN InstanceImageTypeStats iits ON cmh.DISPLAY_NAME = iits.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cmh.STATUS = 'completed';

question: For the combined instance/metadata report, keep the original two-part output exactly as-is, and extend it by adding a third part that lists (for the same “top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the instance is not deleted, the host is 'prime-35', and the metadata key is 'image_image_type'”) the detailed system-metadata rows for those instances (including instance UUID, display name, memory, vCPUs, flavor JSON, metadata key/value, and a row number per metadata key ordered by instance UUID), with a “reason” column indicating which part of the report each row came from. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopImageTypeMetadataByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), Flare3Blaze8_12InstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT t.DISPLAY_NAME AS name_or_display_name, t.metadata_entries AS metric_value, 'Top 10 by image_image_type metadata entries on prime-35 (not deleted)' AS reason, NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS memory_mb, NULL AS vcpus, NULL AS flavor, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS metadata_value, NULL AS window_column FROM TopImageTypeMetadataByDisplayName t UNION ALL SELECT f.display_name AS name_or_display_name, f.window_column AS metric_value, 'Instance metadata rows in flare3 on blaze8-12' AS reason, f.instance_uuid, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.window_column FROM Flare3Blaze8_12InstanceMetadata f ) SELECT name_or_display_name, metric_value, reason, instance_uuid, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, name_or_display_name), Top10DisplayNames AS ( SELECT DISTINCT name_or_display_name AS display_name FROM inner_cte WHERE reason = 'Top 10 by image_image_type metadata entries on prime-35 (not deleted)' ), Top10Prime35ImageTypeMetadataDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM Top10DisplayNames t JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = t.display_name JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), ExtendedCombinedResults AS ( SELECT name_or_display_name, metric_value, reason, instance_uuid, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT d.display_name AS name_or_display_name, d.window_column AS metric_value, 'Detailed image_image_type metadata rows for the top-10 display names on prime-35' AS reason, d.instance_uuid, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.flavor, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_value, d.window_column FROM Top10Prime35ImageTypeMetadataDetails d ) SELECT name_or_display_name, metric_value, reason, instance_uuid, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM ExtendedCombinedResults ORDER BY reason, name_or_display_name, instance_uuid, metadata_key, window_column;

question: For host "blaze8-12", among instances that have a completed migration and also have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, plus the number of instances and minimum memory (MB) for that same VM state and display name group; additionally, only return rows where the instance’s memory utilization ratio (memory_remaining / memory_total) for its completed migration is greater than 0.10. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), ImageTypeInstancesOnBlaze AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), CombinedInstanceInfo AS ( SELECT cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.HOSTNAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.UUID, cm.STATUS, cm.max_migration_id_next2, iti.instance_count, iti.min_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze cm JOIN ImageTypeInstancesOnBlaze iti ON cm.VM_STATE = iti.VM_STATE AND cm.DISPLAY_NAME = iti.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceInfo ORDER BY UUID) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.HOSTNAME, ic.VM_STATE, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.VCPUS, ic.UUID, ic.STATUS, ic.max_migration_id_next2, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, m.MEMORY_REMAINING, (m.MEMORY_REMAINING * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) AS memory_remaining_ratio FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.UUID AND m.STATUS = ic.STATUS WHERE (m.MEMORY_REMAINING * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) > 0.10 ORDER BY ic.UUID;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH VmStateMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), FlareInstancesWithMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare') SELECT vms.VM_STATE, vms.avg_memory_mb, vms.memory_mb_variance, vms.memory_mb_stddev, fim.metadata_key, COUNT(DISTINCT fim.instance_uuid) AS flare3_matching_instances, AVG(fim.memory_mb) AS flare3_avg_memory_mb, AVG(fim.vcpus) AS flare3_avg_vcpus, MIN(fim.window_column) AS min_row_number_in_key_group, MAX(fim.window_column) AS max_row_number_in_key_group FROM VmStateMemoryStats vms JOIN FlareInstancesWithMetadata fim ON fim.vm_state = vms.VM_STATE GROUP BY vms.VM_STATE, vms.avg_memory_mb, vms.memory_mb_variance, vms.memory_mb_stddev, fim.metadata_key ORDER BY vms.memory_mb_variance DESC, flare3_matching_instances DESC ) SELECT VM_STATE, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev, metadata_key, flare3_matching_instances, flare3_avg_memory_mb, flare3_avg_vcpus, min_row_number_in_key_group, max_row_number_in_key_group FROM inner_cte WHERE flare3_matching_instances > (SELECT AVG(flare3_matching_instances) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC, flare3_matching_instances DESC;

ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb ) SELECT vsm.VM_STATE, vsm.memory_mb_variance, vsm.memory_mb_stddev, amsb.migration_status, amsb.migration_count, amsb.min_instance_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats vsm LEFT JOIN active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 amsb ON amsb.instance_vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE ORDER BY vsm.memory_mb_variance DESC, amsb.migration_count DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH FlareLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), PrimeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), FlarePrimeOverlap AS ( SELECT f.display_name FROM FlareLaunchStats f INNER JOIN PrimeMemoryStats p ON p.display_name = f.display_name ) SELECT o.display_name, f.avg_days_to_launch, f.days_to_launch_stddev, p.memory_range_mb, p.memory_variance_mb FROM FlarePrimeOverlap o JOIN FlareLaunchStats f ON f.display_name = o.display_name JOIN PrimeMemoryStats p ON p.display_name = o.display_name ORDER BY o.display_name) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN (SELECT MAX(avg_days_to_launch) AS max_avg_days_to_launch FROM inner_cte) mx ON 1 = 1 WHERE ic.avg_days_to_launch > 0.75 * mx.max_avg_days_to_launch ORDER BY ic.avg_days_to_launch DESC;

WITH FlareLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), PrimeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), FlarePrimeOverlap AS ( SELECT f.display_name FROM FlareLaunchStats f INNER JOIN PrimeMemoryStats p ON p.display_name = f.display_name ) SELECT o.display_name, f.avg_days_to_launch, f.days_to_launch_stddev, p.memory_range_mb, p.memory_variance_mb FROM FlarePrimeOverlap o JOIN FlareLaunchStats f ON f.display_name = o.display_name JOIN PrimeMemoryStats p ON p.display_name = o.display_name ORDER BY o.display_name;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', return the combined instance memory summary (high-vCPU instance counts/minimum memory by VM_STATE and DISPLAY_NAME, plus MEMORY_MB variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) by DISPLAY_NAME for instances with a non-deleted 'image_image_type' system metadata key), but only include rows whose DISPLAY_NAME has a higher average MEMORY_MB than the overall average MEMORY_MB across all rows in that combined summary. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH HighVcpuInstancesByStateAndName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStatsByName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), CombinedInstanceMemorySummary AS ( SELECT hv.VM_STATE, hv.DISPLAY_NAME, hv.instance_count, hv.min_memory_mb, NULL AS memory_mb_variance, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High VCPU Instances' AS reason FROM HighVcpuInstancesByStateAndName hv UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS VM_STATE, ms.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS instance_count, NULL AS min_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, 'Has image_image_type Metadata' AS reason FROM ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStatsByName ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceMemorySummary ORDER BY DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, reason ), DisplayNameAverages AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_memory_mb_for_name FROM INSTANCES i WHERE i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallCombinedAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(COALESCE(d.avg_memory_mb_for_name, 0) * 1.0) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte s JOIN DisplayNameAverages d ON d.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT s.*, d.avg_memory_mb_for_name FROM inner_cte s JOIN DisplayNameAverages d ON d.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE d.avg_memory_mb_for_name > (SELECT overall_avg_memory_mb FROM OverallCombinedAverage) ORDER BY s.DISPLAY_NAME, s.VM_STATE, s.reason;

WITH HighVcpuInstancesByStateAndName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStatsByName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), CombinedInstanceMemorySummary AS ( SELECT hv.VM_STATE, hv.DISPLAY_NAME, hv.instance_count, hv.min_memory_mb, NULL AS memory_mb_variance, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High VCPU Instances' AS reason FROM HighVcpuInstancesByStateAndName hv UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS VM_STATE, ms.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS instance_count, NULL AS min_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, 'Has image_image_type Metadata' AS reason FROM ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStatsByName ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceMemorySummary ORDER BY DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, reason;

question: For each system metadata key found on instances running on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" that have a system metadata entry with key = "image_image_type", list the system metadata key, a migration activity label ("Active" if any non-completed/non-failed/non-error migrations exist for instances in that key group and "Inactive" otherwise), and the number of distinct instances. Include subtotals per system metadata key and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationStats AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ), MetadataWindowStats AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ms.instance_uuid, ms.instance_display_name, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.total_memory_processed, mws.KEY AS system_metadata_key, mws.window_column FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MetadataWindowStats mws ON ms.instance_uuid = mws.UUID ORDER BY ms.instance_uuid, ms.migration_status, mws.KEY, mws.window_column ), KeyMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT i.system_metadata_key, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte x WHERE x.system_metadata_key = i.system_metadata_key AND x.migration_status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT i.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.system_metadata_key, migration_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(system_metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE system_metadata_key END AS system_metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(system_metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity END AS migration_activity, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM KeyMigrationStatus GROUP BY system_metadata_key, migration_activity WITH ROLLUP;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceExtraDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT mm.migration_id, mm.INSTANCE_UUID, mm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, mm.DEST_COMPUTE, mm.instance_display_name, mm.metadata_key, mm.metadata_value, mm.window_column AS avg_migration_id_within_instance_uuid, ied.VM_STATE, ied.MEMORY_MB, ied.VCPUS, ied.KEY_NAME, ied.instance_extra_id, ied.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpus FROM MigrationMetadata AS mm JOIN InstanceExtraDetails AS ied ON mm.INSTANCE_UUID = ied.UUID ORDER BY mm.migration_id) SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, MAX(inner_cte.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_per_instance_uuid FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name;

question: For each quota usage record with a positive in-use amount, list the quota usage ID, project ID, and resource type, along with the number of linked reservations and the total reserved delta across those reservations (only including reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59). Also show, for that resource type, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, compute the average reserved delta per reservation, and include the overall average reserved delta per reservation across all such usage records as a benchmark. Finally, categorize each usage record as 'HIGH_AVG_DELTA' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_AVG_DELTA' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_AVG_DELTA', ordering by delta variance descending.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH UsageReservationStats AS ( SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE ), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC ) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation) AS benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.reservation_count, i.total_reserved_delta, i.delta_variance, i.delta_stddev, i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation, b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation > b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_DELTA' WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation < b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_AVG_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_AVG_DELTA' END AS avg_delta_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY i.delta_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.memory_mb_stddev, cmm.status AS migration_status, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM InstanceMemoryStddev ims JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory cmm ON ims.display_name = cmm.display_name ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_stddev DESC, cmm.max_memory_total DESC, cmm.created_at DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.migration_created_at, ic.network_info FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC, inner_cte.max_memory_total DESC, inner_cte.migration_created_at DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT q1.UUID AS instance_uuid, q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.STATUS AS migration_status, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q2.key_name, q2.metadata_entry_count, q2.total_vcpus FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.UUID = q2.instance_uuid ORDER BY q1.UUID ), HostAzVcpuAverages AS ( SELECT i.host, i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.host, i.availability_zone ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.migration_status, ic.max_migration_id_next2, ic.key_name, ic.metadata_entry_count, ic.total_vcpus FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.vcpus > ( SELECT ha.avg_vcpus FROM HostAzVcpuAverages ha WHERE ha.host = i.host AND ha.availability_zone = i.availability_zone ) ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid;

question: For completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", considering only instances whose display name also appears among instances on "blaze8-12" with non-empty cached network information, list the migration ID, instance display name, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) for that display name, the instance system metadata key and value, and the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, but only for display names whose geometric mean memory is greater than the overall average of these geometric means. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mimw.migration_id, mimw.instance_display_name, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, mimw.metadata_key, mimw.metadata_value, mimw.window_column FROM MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS mimw JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS gmm ON mimw.instance_display_name = gmm.display_name ORDER BY mimw.instance_display_name, mimw.migration_id, mimw.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, geometric_mean_memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte);

question: For instances hosted on "blaze8-12" that have completed migrations (and have instance system metadata key "image_image_type"), show each instance’s UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, its rank within the completed-status group ordered by instance UUID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for that instance’s completed migrations; additionally, include the instance’s project ID and the total number of non-deleted instances in that same project. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), InstanceMigrationRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.STATUS, imr.DEST_COMPUTE, imr.window_column, mmv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationRanks imr JOIN MigrationMemoryVariation mmv ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = mmv.display_name ORDER BY mmv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imr.window_column, imr.UUID) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, i.project_id, proj_counts.total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.UUID JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) AS proj_counts ON proj_counts.project_id = i.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.UUID;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH top_cache AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), host_instances AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT hi.display_name, tc.cache_records, hi.vm_state, hi.memory_mb, hi.network_info, hi.window_column FROM top_cache tc JOIN host_instances hi ON tc.display_name = hi.display_name ORDER BY tc.cache_records DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, ie.flavor AS instance_flavor_json FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;

question: For migrations that are completed and whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12', return the migration ID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, and the migration’s rank within its status group ordered by migration ID, along with (for any active, not-deleted migrations that share the same instance display name) the active migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance VM state, system metadata key/value, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over the current row through the next 2 rows ordered by migration ID. Also include the overall average of these “next-2-rows max memory” values as a benchmark, and categorize each joined row as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), ActiveNotDeletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.key, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.source_compute AS completed_source_compute, cm.dest_compute AS completed_dest_compute, cm.instance_display_name, cm.window_column AS completed_status_rank_by_migration_id, anm.status AS active_migration_status, anm.source_compute AS active_source_compute, anm.dest_compute AS active_dest_compute, anm.dest_host AS active_dest_host, anm.instance_uuid AS active_instance_uuid, anm.display_name AS active_instance_display_name, anm.vm_state AS active_instance_vm_state, anm.key AS system_metadata_key, anm.value AS system_metadata_value, anm.max_memory_mb_next2 FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cm JOIN ActiveNotDeletedMigrations anm ON cm.instance_display_name = anm.display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id ), AvgMaxMem AS ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb_next2) AS avg_max_memory_mb_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.migration_id, i.completed_source_compute, i.completed_dest_compute, i.instance_display_name, i.completed_status_rank_by_migration_id, i.active_migration_status, i.active_source_compute, i.active_dest_compute, i.active_dest_host, i.active_instance_uuid, i.active_instance_display_name, i.active_instance_vm_state, i.system_metadata_key, i.system_metadata_value, i.max_memory_mb_next2, a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 AS benchmark_avg_max_memory_mb_next2, CASE WHEN i.max_memory_mb_next2 > a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN i.max_memory_mb_next2 < a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgMaxMem a ORDER BY i.migration_id;

question: Using the VM-state variance-per-instance results for non-deleted instances with active (non-terminal) migrations, list each VM state along with its migration memory-total variance, total instance count, and the deviation of its variance-per-instance from the overall average variance-per-instance across the returned VM states; only include VM states where (variance ÷ total instances) is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory total computed for instance display names matching 'prime' that have more than one 'image_image_type' system-metadata row. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), VMStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VMStateTotalInstances AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT vsmv.VM_STATE, vsmv.memory_total_variance, vsti.total_instance_count FROM VMStateMemoryVariance vsmv JOIN VMStateTotalInstances vsti ON vsmv.VM_STATE = vsti.VM_STATE WHERE (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) > ( SELECT AVG(dnms.memory_total_stddev) FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev dnms ) ORDER BY (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) DESC ), AverageVariancePerInstance AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, inner_cte.total_instance_count, (inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS variance_per_instance, ((inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) - avpi.avg_variance_per_instance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN AverageVariancePerInstance avpi ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_details AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), host_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT id.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM migration_details md CROSS JOIN instance_details id ) SELECT hs.completed_migration_count, hs.active_instance_count FROM host_summary hs ), HostActiveInstances AS ( SELECT i.host, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host IS NOT NULL AND i.host <> '' GROUP BY i.host ), AverageHostInstances AS ( SELECT AVG(active_instance_count) AS avg_active_instances FROM HostActiveInstances ) SELECT 'blaze8-12' AS host, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.active_instance_count, ahi.avg_active_instances AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.active_instance_count > ahi.avg_active_instances * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN ic.active_instance_count < ahi.avg_active_instances * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageHostInstances ahi;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT sq1.instance_uuid, sq1.display_name, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.instance_extra_id, sq1.window_column, sq2.availability_zone, sq2.metadata_entry_count, sq2.total_vcpus FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.instance_uuid = sq2.instance_uuid WHERE sq2.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY sq1.vm_state, sq1.window_column, sq1.instance_uuid), zone_avg AS ( SELECT inner_cte.availability_zone, AVG(inner_cte.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.availability_zone ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.metadata_entry_count, inner_cte.total_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN zone_avg ON zone_avg.availability_zone = inner_cte.availability_zone WHERE inner_cte.vcpus > ( SELECT zone_avg.avg_vcpus_in_zone FROM zone_avg WHERE zone_avg.availability_zone = inner_cte.availability_zone ) ORDER BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), VmStateHighTotalMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ) SELECT vhtm.vm_state, vhtm.total_memory_mb, vmgmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM VmStateHighTotalMemory vhtm JOIN VmStateGeometricMeanMemory vmgmm ON vhtm.vm_state = vmgmm.vm_state ORDER BY vhtm.total_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, (inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 / host_totals.host_total_memory_mb) AS pct_of_host_total_memory FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS host_total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_totals ON host_totals.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12" that have a completed migration and whose total migration memory processed is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean MEMORY_PROCESSED across all migrations, show the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, the dense-rank of migrations within each instance UUID (ordered by that UUID), and the instance’s total migration memory processed. Do not repeat the instance UUID if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), HighMemoryProcessedInstances AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations ) ) SELECT c.display_name, c.availability_zone, c.status, c.migration_type, c.uuid, c.window_column, h.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost c JOIN HighMemoryProcessedInstances h ON c.uuid = h.instance_uuid ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(uuid) OVER (ORDER BY uuid, window_column) = uuid THEN NULL ELSE uuid END AS uuid, display_name, availability_zone, status, migration_type, window_column, total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ORDER BY uuid, window_column;

question: From the top 10 instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' with the largest active keyed-instance memory range, show each display name, the completed-migration average and variance of instance memory (MB), the active keyed-instance memory range and variance (MB), and whether that display name has any non-completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance AS completed_migrations_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_range_mb, q2.memory_variance_mb AS active_keyed_instances_memory_variance_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.completed_migrations_memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.active_keyed_instances_memory_variance_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_noncompleted_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_range_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row that sums the total_memory_mb across all returned VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), VmStateTotalMemory AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT gmm.vm_state, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, tms.total_memory_mb FROM VmStateGeometricMeanMemory gmm JOIN VmStateTotalMemory tms ON gmm.vm_state = tms.vm_state ORDER BY tms.total_memory_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, geometric_mean_memory_mb, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state;

question: For each VM state on host "blaze8-12", report (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (STDDEV(MEMORY_REMAINING) divided by AVG(MEMORY_REMAINING)) for completed migrations and (2) the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'; then, across those per-VM-state results, return the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) observed for each geometric-mean-memory bucket (rounded to the nearest 1024 MB).
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_mem_cv_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), geom_mean_mem_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mmc.vm_state, mmc.coefficient_of_variation, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migration_mem_cv_by_vm_state mmc JOIN geom_mean_mem_by_vm_state gmm ON mmc.vm_state = gmm.vm_state ) SELECT ROUND(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb / 1024.0) * 1024 AS geom_mean_memory_mb_bucket_1024, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ROUND(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb / 1024.0) * 1024 ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances running on host 'blaze8-12', return each instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, flavor JSON, and the dense-rank-by-project window column, and also include (by matching display name) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (STDDEV(root_gb)/AVG(root_gb)) computed only from instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and a non-deleted instance info cache row.
