question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that have at least 1 completed migration, show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, along with the completed migration status, the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, the row number over instance display name (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following row), and the total count of completed migrations for that instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationsWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' ), ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column AS forge_min_memory_mb_window, cmw.migration_status, cmw.instance_flavor_json, cmw.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, fcmc.completed_migration_count FROM ForgeInstancesWindow fiw JOIN ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts fcmc ON fcmc.instance_uuid = fiw.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsWindow cmw ON cmw.instance_display_name = 'forge' WHERE fcmc.completed_migration_count >= 1 ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id;
sub_questions: For instances whose display name is 'forge', show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, and the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID.

For migrations that are marked as completed, list the migration status, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, and assign row numbers ordered by the instance display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge';

SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed';

question: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the row number within the "completed" migration-status group (ordered by instance UUID), and also include the maximum memory (MB) and launched-at timestamp for matching display-name groups where the instance was launched in 2014 and the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH HighMemory2014 AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT csm.instance_uuid, csm.instance_display_name, csm.instance_vm_state, csm.migration_status, csm.migration_source_compute, csm.migration_dest_compute, csm.window_column, hm.max_memory_mb, hm.LAUNCHED_AT AS launched_at_2014 FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN HighMemory2014 hm ON csm.instance_display_name = hm.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY instance_uuid;
sub_questions: For each instance display name and its launched-at timestamp, find the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were launched in 2014, and only return those groups where the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB.

For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, and assign row numbers within each migration status group ordered by instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed';

question: For instances with a completed migration, list the instance UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, and the rank within the 'completed' status group, but only for display names whose total summed root disk size across instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' is greater than 50 GB (also show that total root disk size). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT subq2.UUID, subq2.DISPLAY_NAME, subq1.total_root_gb, subq2.STATUS, subq2.DEST_COMPUTE, subq2.window_column FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.DISPLAY_NAME = subq1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_root_gb DESC, subq2.window_column ASC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, calculate the total root disk size (in GB) across instances that have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type', and only include display names where the summed root disk size is greater than 50 GB.

For instances that have a migration with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, and the rank of each instance within its migration status group ordered by instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50;

SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed';

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are in the VM state 'shelved_offloaded', find only those whose display name appears among display names with more than 5 instances that have both extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry in 'flare3'. For each such instance, return the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), instance-extra record ID, its rank within its memory size group (ordered by UUID), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.MEMORY_MB ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT soi.UUID, soi.DISPLAY_NAME, soi.MEMORY_MB, soi.instance_extra_id, soi.window_column, msbdn.memory_mb_stddev FROM ShelvedOffloadedInstances soi JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName msbdn ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = msbdn.display_name JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = soi.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY msbdn.memory_mb_stddev DESC, soi.MEMORY_MB, soi.UUID;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry, considering only instances in the availability zone 'flare3'.

For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, list the instance UUID, display name, memory in MB, the instance-extra record ID, and the rank of each instance within its memory size group ordered by UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.MEMORY_MB ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded';

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also appear among instances with system metadata key image_image_type, return the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), instance extra record ID, the windowed minimum memory (ordered by instance extra ID with 3 preceding and 1 following rows), along with the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, and the row number ordered by the metadata value (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type'), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column AS forge_min_memory_window, im.metadata_value, im.NETWORK_INFO, im.window_column AS image_type_row_number_window FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS f JOIN ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS im ON im.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_uuid;
sub_questions: For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type, list the instance display name, the metadata value, and the cached network info, and assign row numbers ordered by the metadata value using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row.

For instances whose display name is 'forge', show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, and the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type';

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge';

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted, show the availability zone and VM state, the total number of instances and the earliest instance creation time (using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), along with the number of distinct instances that have a completed migration and the average of the migration window minimum instance memory (in MB) for those completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceZoneStateStats AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE), CompletedMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), CompletedMigrationZoneState AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmw.uuid) AS completed_migration_instance_count, AVG(cmw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindow cmw JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ins.UUID = cmw.uuid WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izss.VM_STATE, izss.instance_count, izss.earliest_created_at, cmzs.completed_migration_instance_count, cmzs.avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM InstanceZoneStateStats izss JOIN CompletedMigrationZoneState cmzs ON izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmzs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND izss.VM_STATE = cmzs.VM_STATE ORDER BY izss.instance_count DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted, return the number of instances and the earliest instance creation time, using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache.

For migrations with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, the instance display name, the migration source compute, destination compute, migration status, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE;

SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed';

question: For each instance display name that (1) has a non-deleted network info cache and (2) has a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', show the metadata-entry count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (counting only non-deleted metadata rows) and also the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the days between instance creation and launch. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), DaysToLaunchStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), CombinedInstanceDisplayNameStats AS ( SELECT ms.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev, dt.avg_days_to_launch, dt.days_to_launch_stddev FROM MetadataStatsByDisplayName ms JOIN DaysToLaunchStatsByDisplayName dt ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = dt.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceDisplayNameStats ORDER BY display_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of system-metadata entries per instance (counting only non-deleted metadata rows) for instances that have a non-deleted network info cache?

For each instance display name, what are the average and standard deviation of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'?
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC;

question: From the top 10 VM states with the largest range of total memory moved during completed migrations, show each VM state along with (1) the migration memory_total range (max minus min MEMORY_TOTAL), (2) the variance of migration MEMORY_TOTAL, and (3) the variance of instance MEMORY_MB among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH mig_stats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), inst_mem_var AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance, imv.memory_mb_variance FROM mig_stats AS ms JOIN inst_mem_var AS imv ON ms.VM_STATE = imv.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute (1) the range of total memory moved during its migrations (maximum minus minimum MIGRATIONS.MEMORY_TOTAL) and (2) the variance of total memory moved during its migrations, considering only migrations with status 'completed'.
For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the variance of the instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC;

SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', list each VM state and availability zone (with its instance count and minimum memory in MB) only when that state/zone accounts for more than 10% of all such instances, and for those qualifying rows also show the migration status along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), MigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), TotalImageTypeInstances AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, mms.status AS migration_status, mms.avg_memory_mb, mms.memory_mb_variance, mms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz CROSS JOIN TotalImageTypeInstances ti JOIN MigrationMemoryStats mms ON (isaz.instance_count * 1.0 / ti.total_instance_count) > 0.10 ORDER BY (isaz.instance_count * 1.0 / ti.total_instance_count) DESC, mms.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB) among those instances.

sql: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), InstanceSystemMetadataRanked AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT ism.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.display_name, msd.memory_mb_stddev, ism.key AS system_metadata_key, ism.value AS system_metadata_value, ism.window_column FROM InstanceSystemMetadataRanked ism JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName msd ON ism.display_name = msd.display_name ORDER BY msd.memory_mb_stddev DESC, ism.uuid, ism.window_column, ism.key;

question: From the top 10 migration statuses with the highest variance in instance memory (MEMORY_MB) among instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, display each migration status along with its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also show (for each status) every instance VM state’s memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_migration_status AS ( SELECT status FROM q1 LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tms.status AS migration_status, q1.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_memory_mb_stddev, q2.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, q2.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_migration_status tms JOIN q1 ON q1.status = tms.status CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC, q2.memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH InstanceCacheAndImageType AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedInstanceImageTypeAndMemoryStats AS ( SELECT icait.instance_uuid, icait.display_name, icait.image_type_value, icait.cache_record_count, icait.total_memory_mb, msbdn.memory_mb_variance, msbdn.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceCacheAndImageType icait JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName msbdn ON msbdn.display_name = icait.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceImageTypeAndMemoryStats ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid;

question: For instances named 'forge' that also have completed migrations while in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), hostname, VM state, instance extra record ID, the system metadata key and value, and both windowed minimum memory values (one ordered by migration ID and one ordered by instance extra ID). sql: WITH CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT csm.status AS migration_status, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.instance_uuid, csm.display_name, csm.memory_mb, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.instance_extra_id, csm.key AS system_metadata_key, csm.value AS system_metadata_value, csm.window_column AS migration_window_min_memory_mb, fi.window_column AS instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON csm.instance_uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY csm.instance_uuid, fi.instance_extra_id;

sql: WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.USER_ID, fi.PROJECT_ID, fi.HOSTNAME, fi.VM_STATE, fi.POWER_STATE, fi.MEMORY_MB, fi.VCPUS, fi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fi.info_cache_id, fi.NETWORK_INFO, fi.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(fi.MEMORY_MB / NULLIF(fi.window_column, 0), 2) AS memory_to_project_min_ratio FROM ForgeInstances fi JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY memory_to_project_min_ratio DESC;

question: Show a combined list of non-deleted instances that either (a) are in VM state shelved_offloaded and include their UUID, project ID, power state, system metadata key/value, and the max memory over the current and next 2 UUID-ordered rows, or (b) include their instance cache details (display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, and the dense-rank window column). Also include a “reason” column indicating which condition each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceCacheDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), ShelvedOffloadedMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), CombinedInstanceViews AS (SELECT sm.instance_uuid AS instance_uuid, sm.display_name AS display_name, sm.project_id AS project_id, sm.power_state AS power_state, sm.metadata_key AS metadata_key, sm.metadata_value AS metadata_value, sm.max_memory_mb_next_2 AS max_memory_mb_next_2, icd.vm_state AS vm_state, icd.memory_mb AS memory_mb, icd.network_info AS network_info, icd.window_column AS window_column, 'Shelved Offloaded With Metadata' AS reason FROM ShelvedOffloadedMetadata sm JOIN InstanceCacheDetails icd ON icd.display_name = sm.display_name AND icd.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, icd.display_name AS display_name, NULL AS project_id, NULL AS power_state, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS metadata_value, NULL AS max_memory_mb_next_2, icd.vm_state AS vm_state, icd.memory_mb AS memory_mb, icd.network_info AS network_info, icd.window_column AS window_column, 'Non-deleted Instance Cache Details' AS reason FROM InstanceCacheDetails icd) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceViews ORDER BY display_name, reason;

question: List each instance display name that appears in either (a) the non-deleted instances-with-system-metadata memory-size standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) result (only display names with more than 5 rows) or (b) the completed-migrations MEMORY_REMAINING coefficient-of-variation result (only where average MEMORY_REMAINING is greater than 0), and show the metric value along with a reason indicating which calculation produced the row. sql: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedInstanceVariability AS ( SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev AS metric_value, 'Instance Memory MB Stddev (non-deleted instances with system metadata; >5 rows)' AS reason FROM MemoryStddevByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Migration MEMORY_REMAINING Coefficient of Variation (completed migrations; avg>0)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByDisplayName ) SELECT display_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedInstanceVariability ORDER BY display_name, reason;

question: For security group rules belonging to the security group named "aurum-xenon", and only if that security group is among the top 10 security groups with the most non-deleted rules, show the security group name, the rule protocol, the rule from port, the running sum of from ports within each protocol ordered by from port, the group’s total rule count, and a normalized metric (running sum divided by rule count) rounded to 2 decimals.
sql: WITH RuleWindow AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ), TopRuleCounts AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY rule_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.window_column, trc.rule_count, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(trc.rule_count, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_from_port_per_rule FROM RuleWindow rw JOIN TopRuleCounts trc ON rw.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name ORDER BY normalized_running_from_port_per_rule DESC, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT;

sql: WITH MemoryVarianceFromMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT mv.DISPLAY_NAME, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, mr.memory_range_mb, mr.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(mv.memory_mb_variance / NULLIF(mr.memory_range_mb, 0), 4) AS variance_to_range_ratio FROM MemoryVarianceFromMetadata mv JOIN MemoryRangeAndVariance mr ON mv.DISPLAY_NAME = mr.display_name ORDER BY variance_to_range_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH ShelvedCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ), MigrationStatusVmStateStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ) SELECT scm.status, scm.source_compute, scm.dest_compute, scm.instance_uuid, scm.display_name, scm.memory_mb, scm.key, scm.value, scm.window_column, msvs.migration_count, msvs.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ShelvedCompletedMigrations scm JOIN MigrationStatusVmStateStats msvs ON msvs.migration_status = scm.status AND msvs.instance_vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded';

sql: WITH MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance, COUNT(*) AS flare3_instance_count FROM MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = msmv.status JOIN Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f ON f.UUID = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY msmv.memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH AZInstanceWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), NotDeletedInstanceDenseRank AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), NotDeletedInstanceDenseRankWithUUID AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT az.uuid, az.display_name, az.vm_state, az.memory_mb, az.network_info, az.window_column AS Avg_MemoryMB_Window_2_Preceding_2_Following_By_VMState, nd.window_column AS Dense_Rank_By_Project FROM AZInstanceWindow az JOIN NotDeletedInstanceDenseRankWithUUID nd ON az.uuid = nd.uuid ORDER BY az.memory_mb;

sql: WITH az_instances_with_metadata_window AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ), shelved_offloaded_instances_with_network_rank AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_shelved_offloaded_instances_with_metadata_and_network_count FROM az_instances_with_metadata_window az JOIN shelved_offloaded_instances_with_network_rank so ON az.uuid = ( SELECT i2.uuid FROM instances i2 WHERE i2.id = so.id AND i2.availability_zone = 'flare3' );

question: List a combined report that UNION ALLs (1) per-migration-status instance memory statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), for instances with a matching migration record and non-NULL memory) and (2) per-VM-state instance root disk statistics (average, range, and variance, for non-deleted instances with an INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA key of 'image_image_type' and a matching INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES row), including a “reason” column indicating which set each row came from. sql: WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), VMStateRootDiskStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT status AS category, avg_memory_mb AS avg_value, memory_mb_variance AS variance_value, memory_mb_stddev AS stddev_value, NULL AS range_value, 'Migration Status Memory Stats' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryStats UNION ALL SELECT vm_state AS category, avg_root_gb AS avg_value, root_gb_variance AS variance_value, NULL AS stddev_value, root_gb_range AS range_value, 'VM State Root Disk Stats' AS reason FROM VMStateRootDiskStats ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY reason, category;

sql: WITH MetadataStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), NetworkWindow AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), CombinedInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT ms.instance_uuid, ms.display_name, ms.key_name, ms.metadata_entry_count, ms.total_vcpus, nw.NETWORK_INFO, nw.window_column FROM MetadataStats ms JOIN NetworkWindow nw ON ms.instance_uuid = nw.instance_uuid ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceDetails ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid;

sql: WITH ForgeSystemMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), Flare3InstanceNetworkInfo AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT fn.DISPLAY_NAME, fn.instance_uuid, fsm.KEY AS system_metadata_key, fsm.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, fn.NETWORK_INFO, fsm.window_column AS metadata_window_row_number, fn.window_column AS network_window_row_number FROM Flare3InstanceNetworkInfo fn JOIN ForgeSystemMetadata fsm ON fn.instance_uuid = fsm.UUID WHERE fn.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY fn.instance_uuid, fsm.KEY;

question: For availability zone "flare3", list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), cached network info, and its row number within the VM state ordered by memory (descending), along with the geometric mean of memory (MB) for that VM state computed over non-deleted instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT id.UUID, id.DISPLAY_NAME, id.VM_STATE, id.MEMORY_MB, id.NETWORK_INFO, id.window_column, gm.geometric_mean FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS gm ON id.VM_STATE = gm.vm_state;

question: For migrations with status equal to "completed", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration instance UUID, the instance display name, instance VM state, instance memory (MB), instance vCPUs, the system metadata key and value for that instance, and the minimum migration memory remaining within each destination compute group (ordered by destination compute), but only for instances whose display name is among those where the total memory (in MB) across “shelved_offloaded” instances with at least one system metadata entry keyed “image_image_type” exceeds 20000 MB; also include that total memory per display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH completed_migrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), high_memory_shelved_display_names AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.instance_uuid, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_vm_state, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.instance_vcpus, cm.metadata_key, cm.metadata_value, cm.migration_memory_remaining, cm.window_column, hmsdn.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN high_memory_shelved_display_names hmsdn ON cm.instance_display_name = hmsdn.display_name ORDER BY cm.dest_compute;

question: For instance VM states and display names (considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs), for display names that also have a non-deleted network info cache and non-deleted system-metadata rows, return the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), and the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of per-instance system-metadata entry counts, but only for groups where the instance count is greater than 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceStateNameStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), DisplayNameMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT isns.VM_STATE, isns.DISPLAY_NAME, isns.instance_count, isns.min_memory_mb, dnms.metadata_count_range, dnms.metadata_count_variance, dnms.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceStateNameStats AS isns JOIN DisplayNameMetadataStats AS dnms ON isns.DISPLAY_NAME = dnms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE isns.instance_count > 1 ORDER BY isns.instance_count DESC, dnms.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance (and non-deleted system metadata row), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key/value, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA row ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, along with (for that same display name) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of network-info cache records per instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceMetadataAndExtraWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 ), DisplayNameCacheStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ) SELECT im.instance_uuid, im.display_name, im.vm_state, im.power_state, im.memory_mb, im.vcpus, im.metadata_key, im.metadata_value, im.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, dn.cache_count_range, dn.cache_count_variance, dn.cache_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataAndExtraWindow AS im JOIN DisplayNameCacheStats AS dn ON im.display_name = dn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY dn.cache_count_range DESC, im.instance_uuid;

question: For each migration status, list the migration status along with (1) the average, range, and variance of instance memory (MB) for migrations of type 'resize', and (2) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for instances that have at least one system metadata entry with the key 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ResizeMigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC ), ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT r.migration_status, r.avg_instance_memory_mb, r.instance_memory_mb_range, r.instance_memory_mb_variance, it.avg_memory_mb AS avg_memory_mb_with_image_image_type_metadata, it.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance_with_image_image_type_metadata, it.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_image_image_type_metadata FROM ResizeMigrationMemoryStats r JOIN ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStats it ON r.migration_status = it.status ORDER BY r.instance_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: List instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key/value, and the windowed max INSTANCE_EXTRA ID (current row through next 2 by instance UUID) for non-deleted instances with non-deleted system metadata, and also include (as separate UNION ALL rows) any matching instances that have at least one completed migration where the maximum migration MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than 0, showing that max MEMORY_TOTAL and the instance creation timestamp along with a reason indicating which condition produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 ), CombinedInstanceReport AS ( SELECT aim.instance_uuid, aim.display_name, aim.vm_state, aim.power_state, aim.memory_mb, aim.vcpus, aim.metadata_key, aim.metadata_value, aim.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at AS instance_created_at, 'Has Completed Migration Max Memory' AS reason FROM ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow aim JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory cmm ON aim.display_name = cmm.display_name UNION ALL SELECT aim.instance_uuid, aim.display_name, aim.vm_state, aim.power_state, aim.memory_mb, aim.vcpus, aim.metadata_key, aim.metadata_value, aim.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, NULL AS max_memory_total, NULL AS instance_created_at, 'Active Instance Metadata Window' AS reason FROM ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow aim ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, max_instance_extra_id_next_2, max_memory_total, instance_created_at, reason FROM CombinedInstanceReport ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid, metadata_key;

sql: WITH MigrationStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), MemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, mem.memory_mb_range, mem.memory_mb_variance, mem.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MemoryStats mem ON ms.display_name = mem.display_name ORDER BY ms.migration_count_range DESC, mem.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID) among instances with a non-null key name, list the instance display name, the completed migration count, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) computed across instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, and compute a normalized ratio (completed migrations divided by memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) rounded to 2 decimals.
sql: WITH MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(ms.memory_mb_stddev, 0), 2) AS Migrations_Per_MemoryStdDev FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN MemoryStats ms ON tcm.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY Migrations_Per_MemoryStdDev DESC;

question: For completed migrations, show each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, and instance VM state, along with (1) the maximum instance memory (MB) over the window ordered by migration id from the current row through the next 2 rows, and (2) the instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, and the average instance memory (MB) over the window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationWindowMaxMemory AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), MigrationMetadataWindowAvgMemory AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT mwmm.migration_id, mwmm.status, mwmm.source_compute, mwmm.dest_compute, mwmm.dest_host, mwmm.display_name, mwmm.vm_state, mwmm.max_memory_mb_next_2, mmwam.memory_mb, mmwam.metadata_key, mmwam.metadata_value, mmwam.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_status_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM MigrationWindowMaxMemory AS mwmm JOIN MigrationMetadataWindowAvgMemory AS mmwam ON mwmm.migration_id = mmwam.migration_id ORDER BY mwmm.migration_id, mmwam.metadata_key;
sub_questions: For each migration record that is completed, list the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, the instance display name, the instance VM state, and the maximum instance memory (in MB) over a window ordered by migration id that includes the current row and the next 2 rows.

For migrations with status = 'completed', list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the instance system metadata key and value, and the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id.

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded" whose display name appears among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID, and the average and variance of memory (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT sq2.ID AS instance_id, sq2.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, sq2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, sq2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, sq2.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_id, sq1.avg_memory_mb, sq1.memory_mb_variance FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.DISPLAY_NAME = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, sq2.window_column, sq1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances that have a completed migration and also have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, the dense-rank value per instance UUID, and the root disk size (ROOT_GB) range and variance for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC) SELECT cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status, cm.migration_type, cm.uuid, cm.window_column, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON cm.display_name = rgb.display_name ORDER BY rgb.root_gb_range DESC, cm.display_name, cm.uuid;

question: For each migration status that appears among “completed” migrations for instances in availability zone “flare3”, show the migration status, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for non-deleted migrations, and the average running-sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type (ordered by instance memory). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationStatusMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC), CompletedFlare3InstanceMemoryRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT msms.status AS migration_status, msms.avg_instance_memory_mb, msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev, AVG(cfis.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb_within_migration_type FROM MigrationStatusMemoryStats msms JOIN CompletedFlare3InstanceMemoryRunningSum cfis ON msms.status = cfis.migration_status GROUP BY msms.status, msms.avg_instance_memory_mb, msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration ID, instance display name, the instance’s availability zone and VM state, the number of non-deleted instances in that availability zone and VM state (only keeping groups with at least 2 instances), the earliest creation time in that group, and the instance system metadata key/value with the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CompletedMigrationInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceCountsByAZAndState AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE) SELECT cmim.migration_id, cmim.instance_display_name, icb.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, icb.VM_STATE, icb.instance_count, icb.earliest_created_at, cmim.metadata_key, cmim.metadata_value, cmim.window_column FROM CompletedMigrationInstanceMetadata cmim JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = cmim.instance_display_name JOIN InstanceCountsByAZAndState icb ON icb.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND icb.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE icb.instance_count >= 2 ORDER BY icb.instance_count DESC, cmim.migration_id, cmim.metadata_key;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance UUID, hostname, memory in MB, the system metadata key and value, the average memory in MB over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the metadata key and ordered by memory in MB, and also include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (in MB) for the "forge" display name computed across instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH forge_instances_window AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.key ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), display_name_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT fiw.uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.key, fiw.value, fiw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM forge_instances_window fiw JOIN display_name_memory_stats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge';

question: For migrations whose status is "completed", list the migration ID, the instance display name, the system metadata key, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group ordered by migration ID, and (for the same instance display name) the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CompletedMigrationMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceLaunchDelayStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ) SELECT cmm.migration_id, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.metadata_key, cmm.window_column, ilds.avg_days_to_launch, ilds.days_to_launch_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationMetadata cmm JOIN InstanceLaunchDelayStats ilds ON cmm.instance_display_name = ilds.display_name ORDER BY cmm.metadata_key, cmm.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the 2-preceding/2-following window average of instance memory (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id), and that instance’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (stddev/avg), but only for instances whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0.5. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationWindowedMemory AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceMigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT mwm.migration_id, mwm.source_compute, mwm.dest_compute, mwm.dest_host, mwm.display_name, mwm.memory_mb, mwm.window_column AS avg_instance_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following, imcv.coefficient_of_variation AS memory_remaining_coefficient_of_variation_for_instance FROM MigrationWindowedMemory mwm JOIN InstanceMigrationMemoryRemainingCV imcv ON mwm.display_name = imcv.display_name WHERE imcv.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, mwm.migration_id;

For each instance display name, return the instance display name and the coefficient of variation of migration memory remaining (standard deviation divided by average) for completed migrations of that instance.

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only migrations with status = 'completed', return the VM state, availability zone, total instance count, minimum instance memory (MB), and completed migration count for those instances, but only for state/zone groups where completed migrations account for more than 75% of the instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, cmc.completed_migration_count FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ cmc ON isaz.VM_STATE = cmc.VM_STATE AND isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmc.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE (cmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / isaz.instance_count) > 0.75;
