question: For instances in availability zone flare3 that are running on host blaze8-12 and have system metadata key image_image_type, list the instance UUID, the image_image_type metadata value, the dense rank of the instance when ordering by instance memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, along with the instance display name, the metadata key, the cached network info, and the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the metadata value and ordered by the instance created-at timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceMemoryDenseRank AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), InstanceNetworkAndAvgMemory AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ) SELECT imdr.instance_uuid, imdr.metadata_value, imdr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, inam.instance_display_name, inam.metadata_key, inam.network_info, inam.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window FROM InstanceMemoryDenseRank imdr JOIN InstanceNetworkAndAvgMemory inam ON imdr.instance_uuid = inam.instance_uuid AND imdr.metadata_value = inam.metadata_value ORDER BY imdr.instance_uuid;

question: How many instances in availability zone "flare3" have a completed migration and a display name matching the pattern "flare", and how many instance display names on host "blaze8-12" have completed migrations (with average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining computed per display name)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH windowed_instances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), host_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM windowed_instances) AS flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_memory_stats) AS blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM windowed_instances wi CROSS JOIN host_memory_stats hms LIMIT 1;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', for each VM state show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB), and also list (by migration status) the count of active migrations and the minimum instance memory (MB) for that same VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), active_migration_stats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 AS ( SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb FROM active_migration_stats ams JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = ams.instance_vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb ) SELECT vsm.VM_STATE, vsm.memory_mb_variance, vsm.memory_mb_stddev, amsb.migration_status, amsb.migration_count, amsb.min_instance_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats vsm LEFT JOIN active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 amsb ON amsb.instance_vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE ORDER BY vsm.memory_mb_variance DESC, amsb.migration_count DESC;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that had completed migrations with positive memory processed, show each instance’s UUID, display name, and availability zone, along with its completed migration count and total memory processed (bytes), plus (for that same display name on blaze8-12 among non-deleted instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type') the minimum instance ID and the average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH completed_migrations_per_instance AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.availability_zone, c.completed_migration_count, c.total_memory_processed, s.min_instance_id, s.avg_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_per_instance c JOIN instance_memory_stats_by_display_name s ON c.instance_display_name = s.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.completed_migration_count DESC, c.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For active (not deleted) migrations whose status is not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed'), list each migration’s status along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for that status, and also show the migration’s source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance display name, VM state, system metadata key/value, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over a window ordered by migration ID covering the current row and the next 2 rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MemoryStatsByMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), ActiveMigrationDetailsWithWindowMax AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.key, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) SELECT amd.status, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, amd.source_compute, amd.dest_compute, amd.dest_host, amd.instance_uuid, amd.display_name, amd.vm_state, amd.key, amd.value, amd.max_memory_mb_next2 FROM ActiveMigrationDetailsWithWindowMax AS amd JOIN MemoryStatsByMigrationStatus AS ms ON amd.status = ms.status;

question: For destination compute hosts that have at least 2 completed migrations for instances on host "ether-18", list the destination compute, the number of those completed migrations, and whether there is any completed migration to the same destination compute for an instance on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) AS Ether_Completed_Migration_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT bcm.DISPLAY_NAME) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Blaze8_12_Completed_Migration_To_Same_Dest_Compute FROM EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata ecmwm LEFT JOIN BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations bcm ON ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE = bcm.DEST_COMPUTE GROUP BY ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Ether_Completed_Migration_Count DESC, ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" that also have a completed migration, show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, key name, and instance_extra ID, along with the minimum memory_mb within each vCPU group and the migration’s availability zone, status, type, and dense-rank within each instance UUID. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT subq2.UUID AS instance_uuid, subq2.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, subq2.VM_STATE, subq2.MEMORY_MB, subq2.VCPUS, subq2.KEY_NAME, subq2.instance_extra_id, subq2.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, subq1.availability_zone AS migration_availability_zone, subq1.status AS migration_status, subq1.migration_type, subq1.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_instance_uuid FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.UUID = subq1.uuid ORDER BY subq2.UUID, subq1.window_column;

question: For completed migrations involving instances on host "blaze8-12", list each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over a window ordered by migration id that includes the current row and the next 2 rows, but only for VM states that account for more than 10% of all completed migrations on "blaze8-12"; also include, per VM state, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining and the completed migration count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), VMStateVariation AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), VMStateMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.max_memory_mb_next_2, vsv.coefficient_of_variation, vsmc.completed_migration_count FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN VMStateVariation AS vsv ON md.vm_state = vsv.vm_state JOIN VMStateMigrationCounts AS vsmc ON md.vm_state = vsmc.vm_state WHERE (vsmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(completed_migration_count) FROM VMStateMigrationCounts)) > 0.10 ORDER BY vsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, md.migration_id;

sql: WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT dms.DISPLAY_NAME, dms.memory_mb_stddev, ndm.INSTANCE_UUID, ndm.FLAVOR, ndm.KEY AS system_metadata_key, ndm.window_column FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS dms JOIN NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS ndm ON ndm.DISPLAY_NAME = dms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE ndm.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY dms.memory_mb_stddev DESC, ndm.DISPLAY_NAME, ndm.INSTANCE_UUID;

sql: WITH memory_stats_by_vm_state AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), root_disk_stats_by_vm_state AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT ms.vm_state, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, rs.avg_root_gb, rs.root_gb_range, rs.root_gb_variance FROM memory_stats_by_vm_state ms JOIN root_disk_stats_by_vm_state rs ON rs.VM_STATE = ms.vm_state;

sql: WITH InstanceCacheAndImageType AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), DisplayNameLaunchDelayStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC) SELECT icit.instance_uuid, icit.display_name, icit.image_type_value, icit.cache_record_count, icit.total_memory_mb, dnl.avg_days_to_launch, dnl.days_to_launch_stddev FROM InstanceCacheAndImageType icit JOIN DisplayNameLaunchDelayStats dnl ON icit.display_name = dnl.display_name ORDER BY icit.cache_record_count DESC;

sql: WITH MigrationStatusRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'prime3-77'), InstanceMetadataMemoryAvgs AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT msr.migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT msr.migration_id) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT imam.instance_uuid) AS total_instances_with_metadata, AVG(imam.window_column) AS avg_running_avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(msr.window_column) AS max_migration_rank_within_status FROM MigrationStatusRanks AS msr CROSS JOIN InstanceMetadataMemoryAvgs AS imam GROUP BY msr.migration_status ORDER BY total_completed_migrations DESC;

question: From the top 10 instance display names (matching the regular expression 'prime' and not deleted) with the largest range in network-info cache record counts per instance, show each display name along with the cache-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for those same display names among not-deleted instances running on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH cache_metrics AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), memory_cv AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), top_cache_range AS ( SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, cache_count_range FROM cache_metrics ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tcr.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.cache_count_range, cm.cache_count_variance, cm.cache_count_stddev, mc.coefficient_of_variation FROM top_cache_range tcr JOIN cache_metrics cm ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcr.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN memory_cv mc ON mc.display_name = tcr.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cm.cache_count_range DESC;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are hosted on 'blaze8-12', list each migration’s id, instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, system metadata key/value, and the per-instance-UUID running average of migration id; also include (when available for that same instance display name on 'blaze8-12' with non-deleted instances and system metadata key 'image_image_type') the minimum instance id and average memory (MB), ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT md.migration_id, md.INSTANCE_UUID, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, md.metadata_key, md.metadata_value, md.window_column, ims.min_instance_id, ims.avg_memory_mb FROM MigrationDetails md LEFT JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON md.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id;

question: For the top 10 instance display names (in availability zone 'flare3' with display names matching the pattern 'flare') that have the highest number of system metadata entries, show the display name and its metadata entry count, along with each matching instance’s UUID, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and each system metadata key/value pair with a row number per metadata key ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopInstanceMetadataCounts AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare') SELECT t.display_name, t.metadata_entries, d.instance_uuid, d.vm_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_value, d.window_column FROM TopInstanceMetadataCounts t JOIN InstanceMetadataDetails d ON t.display_name = d.display_name ORDER BY t.metadata_entries DESC, t.display_name, d.metadata_key, d.window_column, d.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT md.instance_uuid, md.instance_display_name, md.instance_hostname, md.migration_source_compute, md.migration_dest_compute, md.migration_dest_host, md.migration_type, md.memory_total, md.memory_processed, md.memory_remaining, md.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value, imn.NETWORK_INFO, imn.window_column AS metadata_value_row_number_window FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork imn ON md.instance_display_name = imn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY md.instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value;

question: For completed migrations, combine the results for instances on host 'prime3-77' and instances on host 'blaze8-12' by returning (for each pair of rows) the prime migration id, prime instance display name, prime availability zone, migration status, and the rank of the prime migration within its status group, along with the blaze migration’s source compute, destination compute, destination host, blaze instance display name, blaze instance memory in MB, and the blaze windowed average memory in MB (2 preceding and 2 following rows) partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. sql: WITH PrimeCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'prime3-77' ), BlazeCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ) SELECT pcm.migration_id, pcm.instance_display_name AS prime_instance_display_name, pcm.instance_availability_zone AS prime_instance_availability_zone, pcm.migration_status, pcm.window_column AS prime_status_rank, bcm.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS blaze_source_compute, bcm.DEST_COMPUTE AS blaze_dest_compute, bcm.DEST_HOST AS blaze_dest_host, bcm.DISPLAY_NAME AS blaze_instance_display_name, bcm.MEMORY_MB AS blaze_instance_memory_mb, bcm.window_column AS blaze_avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM PrimeCompletedMigrations pcm CROSS JOIN BlazeCompletedMigrations bcm ORDER BY pcm.migration_id, bcm.migration_id;

question: For each instance display name, show the instance memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MEMORY_MB) for instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'blaze8-12', along with the instance UUID, availability zone, number of completed migrations, and total memory processed for matching instances running on host 'prime-35'. sql: WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), InstanceMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT ims.DISPLAY_NAME, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev, imigs.instance_uuid, imigs.availability_zone, imigs.migration_count, imigs.total_memory_processed FROM InstanceMemoryStats ims JOIN InstanceMigrationStats imigs ON ims.DISPLAY_NAME = imigs.display_name ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name and system metadata key on host blaze8-12 (considering only non-deleted instances whose maximum memory per group is greater than 16000 MB), list the maximum instance memory (MB) and launched timestamp, along with the number of completed migrations for that same instance/metadata key, the maximum running sum of migration IDs within the metadata key group, and the ratio of that maximum running sum to the maximum memory.
sql: WITH MaxInstanceMemory AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT mim.DISPLAY_NAME, mim.metadata_key, mim.max_memory_mb, mim.LAUNCHED_AT, COUNT(cm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MAX(cm.window_column) AS max_migration_id_running_sum, ROUND(MAX(cm.window_column) / NULLIF(mim.max_memory_mb, 0), 6) AS running_sum_per_mb FROM MaxInstanceMemory mim LEFT JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.instance_display_name = mim.DISPLAY_NAME AND cm.metadata_key = mim.metadata_key GROUP BY mim.DISPLAY_NAME, mim.metadata_key, mim.max_memory_mb, mim.LAUNCHED_AT ORDER BY running_sum_per_mb DESC;

question: For the host blaze8-12 and instances that have system metadata key image_image_type, list the top 10 instance display names by number of completed migrations, and for those instances also show the instance UUID, the metadata key and value, the cached network info, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of instance memory (MB) partitioned by the metadata value and ordered by instance created-at. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopMigratedInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), InstanceMetadataNetworkWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT tmi.display_name, tmi.migrations, imnw.instance_uuid, imnw.metadata_key, imnw.metadata_value, imnw.network_info, imnw.window_column FROM TopMigratedInstances tmi JOIN InstanceMetadataNetworkWindow imnw ON tmi.display_name = imnw.instance_display_name ORDER BY tmi.migrations DESC, imnw.instance_uuid;
sub_questions: List the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations, considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata and are hosted on `blaze8-12`.

For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type and that are running on host blaze8-12, list the instance UUID, the instance display name, the metadata key and value, and the cached network info, along with the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the metadata value and ordered by the instance created-at timestamp.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT;

question: List a combined report that (1) shows the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the instance is not deleted, the host is 'prime-35', and the metadata key is 'image_image_type', and (2) shows all instance system-metadata rows for instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12' (including UUID, display name, memory, vCPUs, flavor JSON, metadata key/value, and a row number per metadata key ordered by instance UUID), with a “reason” column indicating which part of the report each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopImageTypeMetadataByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), Flare3Blaze8_12InstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT t.DISPLAY_NAME AS name_or_display_name, t.metadata_entries AS metric_value, 'Top 10 by image_image_type metadata entries on prime-35 (not deleted)' AS reason, NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS memory_mb, NULL AS vcpus, NULL AS flavor, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS metadata_value, NULL AS window_column FROM TopImageTypeMetadataByDisplayName t UNION ALL SELECT f.display_name AS name_or_display_name, f.window_column AS metric_value, 'Instance metadata rows in flare3 on blaze8-12' AS reason, f.instance_uuid, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.window_column FROM Flare3Blaze8_12InstanceMetadata f ) SELECT name_or_display_name, metric_value, reason, instance_uuid, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, name_or_display_name;
sub_questions: List the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries, considering only instances that are not deleted, only instances hosted on 'prime-35', and only metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'. Return each instance display name and the count of matching metadata rows.

For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are running on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra flavor JSON, the system metadata key and value, and assign row numbers within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' that also have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', return each display name along with (1) the average and variance of instance memory_mb and (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory_remaining across completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), MigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PrimeInstancesWithImageType AS ( SELECT DISTINCT i.display_name FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmrcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats ims JOIN MigrationMemoryRemainingCV mmrcv ON ims.display_name = mmrcv.display_name WHERE ims.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM PrimeInstancesWithImageType) ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmrcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, calculate the average and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', restricting results to instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.

For each instance display name, return the coefficient of variation of the instance’s migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) across its migrations, considering only migrations with STATUS = 'completed' and only instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that have non-deleted system metadata with key image_image_type and also had completed migrations with positive memory processed, show the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, completed migration count, total memory processed (bytes), and the dense-rank window value computed by ordering instances by memory (MB) using the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT subq2.instance_uuid, subq2.instance_display_name, subq2.availability_zone, subq2.completed_migration_count, subq2.total_memory_processed, subq1.window_column AS memory_dense_rank_window FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.instance_uuid = subq1.instance_uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_processed DESC;
sub_questions: For non-deleted instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, show the instance UUID and the dense rank of each instance when ordering by the instance memory (in MB), using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows.

For each instance on host blaze8-12 that had a completed migration, list the instance UUID, the instance display name, and the instance availability zone, along with the number of completed migrations for that instance and the total memory processed (in bytes) across those migrations.

question: For the top 10 non-deleted instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' (counting only system metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'), list each instance display name, its total number of such metadata records, and the average metadata rank (by metadata key, ordered by instance UUID) for matching non-deleted instances on host 'blaze8-12'.
sql: WITH TopPrimeImageTypeMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10), HostBlazeMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT tpm.DISPLAY_NAME, tpm.metadata_records, ROUND(AVG(hbmr.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Metadata_Rank_On_Host FROM TopPrimeImageTypeMetadata tpm JOIN HostBlazeMetadataRanks hbmr ON hbmr.DISPLAY_NAME = tpm.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY tpm.DISPLAY_NAME, tpm.metadata_records ORDER BY Avg_Metadata_Rank_On_Host DESC, tpm.metadata_records DESC;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is hosted on blaze8-12, show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the minimum instance ID and average instance memory (MB) for that display name among instances in availability zone flare3 with system metadata KEY = image_image_type (also hosted on blaze8-12), along with the instance memory (MB), instance network_info, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, ims.min_instance_id, ims.avg_memory_mb, md.instance_memory_mb, md.NETWORK_INFO, md.window_column FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON md.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare' and that also appear in completed migrations for instances on host 'blaze8-12', list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, the maximum system-metadata ID over the current row and next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, along with the migration ID, source compute, destination compute, and the migration’s rank within the completed-status group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' ), CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT imw.uuid AS instance_uuid, imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, cmh.migration_id, cmh.source_compute, cmh.dest_compute, cmh.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw JOIN CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS cmh ON imw.display_name = cmh.instance_display_name ORDER BY imw.uuid, cmh.migration_id;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose display name matches the pattern "flare", and that also have a "completed" migration with an instance display name matching "flare", provide the instance UUID, hostname, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance-extra flavor JSON, the instance-extra NUMA topology JSON, the cached network_info JSON, the minimum memory (MB) within each vCPU count, along with the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance-extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (MB) in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare'), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare') SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.hostname, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor_json, id.numa_topology_json, id.network_info_json, id.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpu_count, cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_in_migration_window FROM InstanceDetails id JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.INSTANCE_UUID = id.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare', list the instance display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, the maximum system-metadata ID over a window covering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, and (when available) the variance of memory_mb for display names that match the pattern 'prime' and have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' ), PrimeMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, pmv.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceMetadataWindow imw LEFT JOIN PrimeMemoryVariance pmv ON imw.display_name = pmv.display_name ORDER BY imw.uuid;
sub_questions: For each instance, show its display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window that includes the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, considering only instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'.

For each instance display name, show the variance of the instance memory size in MB, considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, and only for instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare';

SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For completed migrations of instances whose display name matches the pattern "flare", list each instance display name along with its total number of completed migrations and average instance memory (MB), and include the migration details (migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance memory in MB, instance extra id, and the 3-preceding/1-following minimum-memory window value), keeping only rows where the instance’s average memory is more than 75% of the window minimum memory value. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PrimeInstanceMaxMemory AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), FlareCompletedMigrationsWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare'), FlareInstanceMemorySummary AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS flare_completed_migration_count, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT fms.instance_display_name, fms.flare_completed_migration_count, fms.avg_instance_memory_mb, fcmw.migration_id, fcmw.migration_status, fcmw.source_compute, fcmw.dest_compute, fcmw.instance_uuid, fcmw.instance_memory_mb, fcmw.instance_extra_id, fcmw.window_column FROM FlareInstanceMemorySummary fms JOIN FlareCompletedMigrationsWindow fcmw ON fms.instance_display_name = fcmw.instance_display_name WHERE (fms.avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.0 / fcmw.window_column) > 0.75;
sub_questions: For each instance display name and migration status, show the maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) among its migrations and the instance creation timestamp, considering only migrations with status = 'completed' for instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', and keeping only groups where the maximum total memory is greater than 0.

For migrations whose status is "completed" and whose instance display name matches the pattern "flare", show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, the instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance memory in MB, the instance extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0;

SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare';

question: For each image_image_type metadata value on host blaze8-12, show the metadata value, the number of distinct instances that also had at least one completed migration with positive memory processed, the average and maximum completed-migration count per instance, the total memory processed (in bytes) across those instances’ completed migrations, and the average of the 2-preceding/2-following windowed instance memory (in MB) for that metadata value. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CompletedMigrationsPerInstance AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), ImageTypeMetadataWithWindowMem AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ) SELECT im.metadata_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.instance_uuid) AS instances_with_completed_migrations, AVG(cm.completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_instance, MAX(cm.completed_migration_count) AS max_completed_migrations_per_instance, SUM(cm.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed_bytes, AVG(im.window_column) AS avg_window_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationsPerInstance cm JOIN ImageTypeMetadataWithWindowMem im ON cm.instance_uuid = im.instance_uuid GROUP BY im.metadata_value ORDER BY instances_with_completed_migrations DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance on host blaze8-12 that had a completed migration, list the instance UUID, the instance display name, and the instance availability zone, along with the number of completed migrations for that instance and the total memory processed (in bytes) across those migrations.

For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type and that are running on host blaze8-12, list the instance UUID, the instance display name, the metadata key and value, and the cached network info, along with the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the metadata value and ordered by the instance created-at timestamp.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT;

question: For each VM state and availability zone on host 'prime-35' (restricted to instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), and for each active (non-hidden) migration status for that same VM state, list the VM state, availability zone, migration status, the instance count on 'prime-35', the instance count involved in active migrations, the minimum instance memory (MB), the minimum migration total memory, and the ratio (rounded) of minimum migration total memory to minimum instance memory.
sql: WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ), HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT h.VM_STATE, h.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, a.migration_status, h.instance_count AS prime35_instance_count, a.instance_count AS active_migration_instance_count, h.min_memory_mb, a.min_memory_total, ROUND(a.min_memory_total / NULLIF(h.min_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ h JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState a ON h.VM_STATE = a.vm_state ORDER BY Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio DESC;
domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
sub_questions: For each instance VM state and migration status, considering only migrations that are not hidden and only **active** migrations (i.e., migration status not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')), return the number of instances involved and the minimum total memory recorded for the migration.

For each instance VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and that are running on host 'prime-35', return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB) among those instances.

SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' (and with MEMORY_MB > 0 for the geometric mean calculation), list each VM_STATE along with the variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and geometric mean of instance MEMORY_MB, ordered by memory variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MemoryVarianceStddevByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT mvs.VM_STATE, mvs.memory_mb_variance, mvs.memory_mb_stddev, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM MemoryVarianceStddevByState mvs JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByState gmm ON mvs.VM_STATE = gmm.vm_state ORDER BY mvs.memory_mb_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute both the variance and the standard deviation of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) for instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'blaze8-12'.

For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', where the instance memory is greater than 0, and only for instances running on host 'blaze8-12'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and also include (when available) the root disk size (ROOT_GB) range and variance computed per display name for instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' and are hosted on “prime-35”. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedInstanceView AS ( SELECT idfb.instance_uuid, idfb.display_name, idfb.vm_state, idfb.power_state, idfb.memory_mb, idfb.vcpus, idfb.instance_extra_id, idfb.max_instance_id_next_2, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS idfb LEFT JOIN RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON rgb.DISPLAY_NAME = idfb.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY instance_uuid;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, compute the range and variance of the instance root disk size (ROOT_GB) for instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are hosted on "prime-35".

For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” that is running on host “blaze8-12”, show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, and the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12" that also have a non-deleted instance info cache record, find those whose display name is one of the 'prime' display names (matching the pattern 'prime') that appears more than 5 times. For each such instance, return the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH HostInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), PrimeDisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT h.instance_id, h.instance_uuid, h.user_id, h.project_id, h.display_name, h.vm_state, h.memory_mb, h.vcpus, h.info_cache_id, h.max_instance_id_next_2, p.memory_mb_stddev FROM HostInstanceDetails h JOIN PrimeDisplayNameMemoryStddev p ON h.display_name = p.display_name ORDER BY h.instance_id;
sub_questions: For each non-deleted instance on host "blaze8-12", show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the instance info cache record ID, along with the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID.

For each instance display name, show the standard deviation of the instance memory (in MB) across its instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, considering only instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and only display names that appear more than 5 times.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12';

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose display name matches the pattern "flare", and whose display name is also a "prime" display name in the same availability zone, show the instance UUID, hostname, memory in MB, instance extra record ID, instance extra created timestamp, the 2-preceding/2-following window average memory (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory), and the completed-migration average and variance of MEMORY_TOTAL for that instance display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH FlareZoneInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), PrimeMigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), FlareZonePrimeDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name FROM instances AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name) SELECT fzi.instance_uuid, fzi.hostname, fzi.memory_mb, fzi.instance_extra_id, fzi.instance_extra_created_at, fzi.window_column, pmms.display_name, pmms.avg_memory_total, pmms.memory_total_variance FROM FlareZoneInstances AS fzi JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = fzi.instance_uuid JOIN FlareZonePrimeDisplayNames AS fzpdn ON fzpdn.display_name = i.display_name JOIN PrimeMigrationMemoryStats AS pmms ON pmms.display_name = i.display_name ORDER BY pmms.memory_total_variance DESC, fzi.memory_mb;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" that are not deleted and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', list the instance UUID, display name, the range and variance of total migration memory across completed migrations for that display name, and each system metadata key/value (including the dense-rank window column), ordering results by the memory total range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC), InstanceMetadataOnHost AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imoh.uuid, imoh.display_name, msbdn.memory_total_range, msbdn.memory_total_variance, imoh.key, imoh.value, imoh.window_column FROM InstanceMetadataOnHost imoh JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName msbdn ON imoh.display_name = msbdn.display_name WHERE imoh.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ORDER BY msbdn.memory_total_range DESC, imoh.uuid, imoh.key;

question: For host blaze8-12, for each instance display name and VM state (considering only non-deleted instances that have the system metadata key image_image_type), return the distinct instance count and earliest creation time, along with (for availability zone flare3) the number of matching instances, the total number of system metadata entries, and the total vCPUs summed across those instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceStateSummary AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ), InstanceMetadataVcpuSummary AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT iss.DISPLAY_NAME, iss.VM_STATE, iss.instance_count, iss.earliest_created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT imvs.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instance_count, SUM(imvs.metadata_entry_count) AS flare3_metadata_entry_count, SUM(imvs.total_vcpus) AS flare3_total_vcpus FROM InstanceStateSummary iss JOIN InstanceMetadataVcpuSummary imvs ON imvs.display_name = iss.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY iss.DISPLAY_NAME, iss.VM_STATE, iss.instance_count, iss.earliest_created_at;

question: For the top 10 instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' that have a non-empty key name, show each display name’s total number of completed migrations, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration counts per instance (counted per destination compute), but only include display names whose migration-count range is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceMigrationDispersion AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, imd.migration_count_range, imd.migration_count_variance, imd.migration_count_stddev FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN InstanceMigrationDispersion imd ON tcm.display_name = imd.display_name WHERE imd.migration_count_range > 0 ORDER BY tcm.completed_migrations DESC;
