question: For instance display names that match the pattern 'prime' (and have at least 3 system metadata rows) and also appear on host 'blaze8-12' with system-metadata key 'image_image_type', return each display name along with (1) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across its system metadata rows and (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB across those 'image_image_type' system-metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MemoryStddevPrime AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT msp.display_name, msp.memory_mb_stddev, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM MemoryStddevPrime AS msp JOIN RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS rgb ON rgb.display_name = msp.display_name ORDER BY msp.memory_mb_stddev DESC, rgb.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor, id.window_column, dms.avg_memory_mb, dms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats AS dms ON id.display_name = dms.display_name ORDER BY dms.memory_mb_variance DESC, id.display_name, id.uuid;

sql: WITH InstanceRootGbStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC ), InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT irs.display_name, irs.avg_root_gb, irs.root_gb_stddev, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column FROM InstanceRootGbStats irs JOIN InstanceDetails id ON irs.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY irs.root_gb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances running on host blaze8-12 that are not deleted (and where the maximum instance memory per display name and metadata key is greater than 16000 MB), list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, system metadata entry count (for key 'image_image_type'), total vCPUs, the metadata key, the maximum memory (MB), the launched timestamp, and compute the vCPUs-per-MB ratio (total vCPUs divided by max memory).
sql: WITH MaxMemoryByDisplayAndKey AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), InstanceAZMetadataAndVcpus AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT ia.instance_uuid, ia.display_name, ia.availability_zone, ia.metadata_entry_count, ia.total_vcpus, mm.metadata_key, mm.max_memory_mb, mm.launched_at, ROUND(ia.total_vcpus / NULLIF(mm.max_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM InstanceAZMetadataAndVcpus ia JOIN MaxMemoryByDisplayAndKey mm ON ia.display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, mm.max_memory_mb DESC;

sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT sq1.DISPLAY_NAME, sq1.metadata_entries, sq2.UUID, sq2.VM_STATE, sq2.MEMORY_MB, sq2.NETWORK_INFO, sq2.window_column FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.DISPLAY_NAME = sq2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY sq1.metadata_entries DESC, sq2.VM_STATE, sq2.window_column;

sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT sq1.instance_uuid, sq1.instance_display_name, sq1.migration_status, sq1.window_column, sq2.memory_mb_stddev FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.instance_display_name = sq2.display_name ORDER BY sq2.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For each instance display name matching the regular expression 'prime', among instances that are not deleted and have a non-deleted network info cache record, return the instance’s average memory (MB) and memory variance, and also the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING across that instance’s completed migrations. sql: WITH MigrationMemoryCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN MigrationMemoryCV AS mmcv ON ims.display_name = mmcv.display_name ORDER BY mmcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, ims.display_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, return the coefficient of variation of the instance’s migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) across its migrations, considering only migrations with STATUS = 'completed' and only instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.

For each instance display name, calculate the average and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted, that have a network info cache record, and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each active migration status (excluding accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed), show the status, the geometric mean of migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where instance memory is greater than zero, and also the instance-memory range (max minus min) and variance (in MB) for non-deleted migrations whose instances have a non-deleted instance info cache entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemoryRangeVarianceByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT g.status, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance FROM GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus g JOIN MemoryRangeVarianceByStatus r ON g.status = r.status ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC;
domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
sub_questions: For each migration status, show the status and the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero, considering only active migrations (i.e., excluding statuses accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed).

For each migration status, show the status and compute (1) the range (maximum minus minimum) of the instance memory in MB for instances involved in those migrations, and (2) the variance of that instance memory in MB, considering only migrations that are not deleted, whose instance has a non-deleted instance info cache entry, and only **active migrations** (i.e., migrations whose status is not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')).
sub_sqls: SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12”, return the instance UUID, display name, and network_info cache, along with the count of linked instance_extra records and the total memory (MB) across those linked records, plus the instance’s VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window covering the current instance and the next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceExtrasByAZHost AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info), InstanceWindowMaxExtra AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT a.instance_uuid, a.display_name, a.network_info, a.extra_record_count, a.total_memory_mb, w.vm_state, w.power_state, w.memory_mb, w.vcpus, w.max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM InstanceExtrasByAZHost a JOIN InstanceWindowMaxExtra w ON w.uuid = a.instance_uuid;

For each compute instance that is not deleted and is hosted on "blaze8-12", show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window that includes the current instance and the next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info;

SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12';

question: For compute instances on host "blaze8-12" that are not deleted, show each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window covering the current instance and the next 2 instances (ordered by instance UUID), and also the average and variance of memory (MB) for that instance’s display name among instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' on the same host. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceDetails AS id LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON id.display_name = ms.display_name;
sub_questions: For each compute instance that is not deleted and is hosted on "blaze8-12", show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window that includes the current instance and the next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID.

SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For migrations with status = "completed" whose instance is on host "blaze8-12", list migration details and include a reason showing whether the row comes from (1) the 2-preceding/2-following window average of instance memory (MB) by migration status ordered by migration id, or (2) the running sum of migration IDs within each instance system metadata key group ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MemoryWindow AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), MetadataRunningSum AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedMigrations AS ( SELECT mw.migration_id, mw.SOURCE_COMPUTE, mw.DEST_COMPUTE, mw.DEST_HOST, mw.DISPLAY_NAME, mw.MEMORY_MB, mw.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS running_sum_migration_id_by_key, 'Memory Window Avg' AS reason FROM MemoryWindow mw UNION ALL SELECT mrs.migration_id, NULL AS SOURCE_COMPUTE, NULL AS DEST_COMPUTE, NULL AS DEST_HOST, mrs.instance_display_name AS DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS MEMORY_MB, NULL AS avg_memory_mb_window, mrs.metadata_key, mrs.window_column AS running_sum_migration_id_by_key, 'Metadata Key Running Sum' AS reason FROM MetadataRunningSum mrs ) SELECT migration_id, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, MEMORY_MB, avg_memory_mb_window, metadata_key, running_sum_migration_id_by_key, reason FROM CombinedMigrations ORDER BY migration_id, reason;
sub_questions: For migrations whose status is "completed" and whose instance is on host "blaze8-12", show the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, the instance display name, the instance memory in MB, and the average instance memory in MB over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id.

For migrations whose status is "completed" and whose instance host is "blaze8-12", list the migration ID, the instance display name, the system metadata key, and the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group ordered by migration ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID;

question: For host "blaze8-12", for each VM state whose total instance memory (across non-deleted instances) is greater than the host’s overall average instance memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), list the VM state along with each active (non-hidden) migration status for that VM state, the number of instances involved in those migrations, the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL, the total instance memory for the VM state, and the ratio of minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL to total instance memory.
sql: WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ), HighMemoryStatesOnHost AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ) SELECT hm.vm_state, am.migration_status, am.instance_count, am.min_memory_total, hm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(am.min_memory_total / NULLIF(hm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HighMemoryStatesOnHost hm JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState am ON hm.vm_state = am.vm_state ORDER BY MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio DESC;

For each instance VM state on host "blaze8-12", return the VM state and the total amount of memory (in MB) across instances that are not deleted, but only include VM states whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (computed across all non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12").

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12" that (a) have a completed migration and (b) have a display name that appears in more than one instance with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name (computed over the KEY = 'image_image_type' instances on "blaze8-12"), ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS AS migration_status, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_stddev DESC, q1.UUID;

SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances running on host blaze8-12 that are not deleted (and where the instance has extra metadata and the system metadata key image_image_type), for each instance display name and VM state list the distinct instance count, the earliest creation time, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB), and the rounded standard-deviation-to-variance ratio, ordered by that ratio descending.
sql: WITH MemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), StateCounts AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT sc.DISPLAY_NAME, sc.VM_STATE, sc.instance_count, sc.earliest_created_at, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(ms.memory_mb_stddev / NULLIF(ms.memory_mb_variance, 0), 4) AS Stddev_to_Variance_Ratio FROM StateCounts sc JOIN MemoryStats ms ON sc.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY Stddev_to_Variance_Ratio DESC;

SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE;

question: On host "prime-35", for each instance (UUID, display name, and availability zone) that has completed migrations, show its migration count and total memory processed, and also include (for the same availability zone) the VM state breakdown with the number of non-deleted instances and the earliest instance creation time. sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), q2 AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.availability_zone, q2.vm_state, q2.instance_count, q2.earliest_created_at, q1.migration_count, q1.total_memory_processed FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.availability_zone = q2.availability_zone ORDER BY q1.total_memory_processed DESC, q1.migration_count DESC, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12' (considering only instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'), list the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB), the average/range/variance of root disk size (GB), and compute the normalized ratio of average memory to average root disk (avg_memory_mb divided by avg_root_gb), ordered by this ratio descending.
sql: WITH MemoryStatsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), RootDiskStatsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, rd.avg_root_gb, rd.root_gb_range, rd.root_gb_variance, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_mb / NULLIF(rd.avg_root_gb, 0), 2) AS Avg_Memory_MB_Per_Root_GB FROM MemoryStatsByState ms JOIN RootDiskStatsByState rd ON ms.VM_STATE = rd.VM_STATE ORDER BY Avg_Memory_MB_Per_Root_GB DESC;

sql: WITH HostInstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), MigrationInstanceMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT hims.display_name, hims.memory_mb_variance AS host_memory_mb_variance, hims.memory_mb_stddev AS host_memory_mb_stddev, mimv.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance FROM HostInstanceMemoryStats hims JOIN MigrationInstanceMemoryVariance mimv ON hims.display_name = mimv.display_name;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance network info, along with the average migration id within each status group, and also include (per instance display name) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining; finally compute the ratio of migration id to that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) and order by this ratio descending.
sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, md.NETWORK_INFO, md.window_column, imv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(md.migration_id / NULLIF(imv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryVariation imv ON md.instance_display_name = imv.display_name ORDER BY migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio DESC;

question: Give the number of instance display names in the top 10 list by completed migrations for instances with a non-empty key name whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', and the number of instance display names with memory range/variance statistics for not-deleted instances whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. sql: WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.metadata_count_range, m.metadata_count_variance, m.metadata_count_stddev, s.memory_mb_stddev FROM MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS m JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS s ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = s.display_name ORDER BY m.metadata_count_range DESC;

sql: WITH RootGBStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), MigrationCountStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), Prime35MigrationCountStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT rgs.DISPLAY_NAME, rgs.root_gb_range, rgs.root_gb_variance, pmcs.migration_count_range, pmcs.migration_count_variance, pmcs.migration_count_stddev FROM RootGBStats AS rgs JOIN Prime35MigrationCountStats AS pmcs ON rgs.DISPLAY_NAME = pmcs.display_name ORDER BY rgs.root_gb_range DESC;

sql: WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationMemoryStatsOnHost AS (SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status, cm.migration_type, cm.uuid, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cm JOIN MigrationMemoryStatsOnHost ms ON cm.status = ms.status ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY status, uuid, window_column;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern "prime", list each 2014-created instance display name and system-metadata key where the maximum instance memory is greater than 16000 MB, along with the minimum completed migration ID and the average instance memory (MB) for completed migrations (considering only non-deleted instances). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq2.key AS system_metadata_key, sq1.min_migration_id, sq1.avg_instance_memory_mb, sq2.max_memory_mb FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.max_memory_mb DESC, sq2.display_name, sq2.key;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance extra record ID, and its row number within the VM state (ordered by instance UUID), along with the variance of active-migration MEMORY_TOTAL for that VM state (considering only non-deleted instances and excluding migrations in accepted/confirmed/reverted/error/failed/completed status). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateMigrationVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.window_column, smv.memory_total_variance FROM InstanceDetails AS id LEFT JOIN StateMigrationVariance AS smv ON id.vm_state = smv.VM_STATE ORDER BY id.vm_state, id.window_column, id.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataWindow imw JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON imw.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY imw.display_name, imw.uuid;

sql: WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), vm_state_displayname_counts AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT vms.VM_STATE, vms.avg_memory_mb, vms.memory_mb_range, vms.memory_mb_variance, vdc.DISPLAY_NAME, vdc.instance_count, vdc.min_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats AS vms JOIN vm_state_displayname_counts AS vdc ON vdc.VM_STATE = vms.VM_STATE ORDER BY vms.memory_mb_range DESC, vdc.instance_count DESC;

sql: WITH completed_migrations_on_blaze AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), flare3_instances_metadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fim.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instance_count FROM completed_migrations_on_blaze cm CROSS JOIN flare3_instances_metadata fim;

sql: WITH MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), VMStateCounts AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT vsc.VM_STATE, vsc.DISPLAY_NAME, vsc.instance_count, vsc.min_memory_mb, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(vsc.min_memory_mb / NULLIF(ms.memory_range_mb, 0), 2) AS MinMemory_to_Range_Ratio FROM VMStateCounts vsc JOIN MemoryStats ms ON vsc.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY MinMemory_to_Range_Ratio DESC;

sql: WITH FlareZoneInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare'), HostImageTypeDenseRanks AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT fzi.display_name, fzi.availability_zone, fzi.vm_state, fzi.memory_mb, fzi.vcpus, fzi.uuid AS instance_uuid, fzi.max_metadata_id_next_2, hir.window_column AS dense_rank_memory_window FROM FlareZoneInstances fzi JOIN HostImageTypeDenseRanks hir ON fzi.uuid = hir.instance_uuid WHERE fzi.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY fzi.uuid;

sql: WITH InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMigrationCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.VM_STATE, imr.KEY, imr.VALUE, imr.window_column, imcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMetadataRanks AS imr JOIN InstanceMigrationCV AS imcv ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = imcv.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imr.UUID, imr.KEY, imr.window_column;

sql: WITH TopMetadataDisplayNames AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), Flare3BlazeInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), TopMetadataInstancesOnPrime35 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME FROM INSTANCES i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME IN (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME FROM TopMetadataDisplayNames) ) SELECT f.UUID, f.DISPLAY_NAME, f.VM_STATE, f.MEMORY_MB, f.VCPUS, f.KEY_NAME, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column FROM Flare3BlazeInstances f WHERE f.DISPLAY_NAME IN (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME FROM TopMetadataDisplayNames) ORDER BY f.VCPUS, f.UUID;

sql: WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), HighMemoryProcessedInstances AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations ) ) SELECT c.display_name, c.availability_zone, c.status, c.migration_type, c.uuid, c.window_column, h.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost c JOIN HighMemoryProcessedInstances h ON c.uuid = h.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance display name on host "blaze8-12" that has non-empty cached network information and is in availability zone "flare3" with system metadata KEY = "image_image_type", what are the geometric mean of instance memory (MB), the minimum instance ID, and the average memory (MB)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), min_id_and_avg_memory_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT g.display_name, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, m.min_instance_id, m.avg_memory_mb FROM geometric_mean_by_display_name g JOIN min_id_and_avg_memory_by_display_name m ON g.display_name = m.display_name ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For completed migrations where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', return the migration status, the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache (computed over non-deleted instances), the cached network info, and the row number ordered by instance display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT cpm.migration_status, cpm.instance_display_name, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cpm.instance_network_info, cpm.window_column FROM CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow cpm JOIN CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName cov ON cov.display_name = cpm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cpm.instance_display_name;

question: For instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' and considering only migrations with status = 'completed', return the top 10 display names (restricted to instances with a non-empty key name) along with their completed migration count and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata rows per migration, but only for those display names where the top-10 completed-migration count represents more than 75% of the total completed migrations for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PerInstanceMetadataDispersion AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10), AllPrimeCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, pimd.metadata_count_range, pimd.metadata_count_variance, pimd.metadata_count_stddev FROM TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm JOIN PerInstanceMetadataDispersion AS pimd ON tcm.display_name = pimd.display_name JOIN ( SELECT instance_uuid, COUNT(migration_id) AS total_completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM AllPrimeCompletedMigrations GROUP BY instance_uuid ) AS apcm ON apcm.instance_uuid IN ( SELECT i.uuid FROM instances AS i WHERE i.display_name = tcm.display_name AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ) WHERE (tcm.completed_migrations * 1.0 / apcm.total_completed_migrations_for_display_name) > 0.75 ORDER BY tcm.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12", list each instance UUID and display name along with its VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, extra flavor JSON, and system metadata key, and also show the dense-rank window values from the project_id-based ranking and the metadata-key-based ranking. sql: WITH InstanceNetworkCache AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.DISPLAY_NAME, inc.vm_state, inc.memory_mb, inc.network_info, ifm.FLAVOR, ifm.KEY, inc.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_dense_rank FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS ifm JOIN InstanceNetworkCache AS inc ON ifm.DISPLAY_NAME = inc.display_name ORDER BY ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.KEY;

sql: WITH InstanceMetadataRows AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare'), HighMemoryVmStates AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT imr.instance_uuid, imr.display_name, imr.vm_state, imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.metadata_key, imr.metadata_value, imr.window_column, hms.total_memory_mb FROM InstanceMetadataRows imr JOIN HighMemoryVmStates hms ON imr.vm_state = hms.VM_STATE ORDER BY imr.vm_state, imr.metadata_key, imr.window_column, imr.instance_uuid;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12”, list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and also include (by display name on host “blaze8-12”) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), DisplayNameMetaStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT d.instance_uuid, d.display_name, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.instance_extra_id, d.max_instance_id_next_2, ms.meta_count_range, ms.meta_count_variance, ms.meta_count_stddev FROM InstanceDetails AS d JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS ms ON ms.display_name = d.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name, d.instance_uuid;

SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that have completed migrations and also have system metadata key image_image_type, show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the instance system metadata key, the image_image_type metadata value, and cached network info, along with the migration dense rank and the image-type row number. sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), ImageTypeMetadata AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, itm.metadata_value, itm.network_info, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, itm.window_column AS image_type_row_number FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN ImageTypeMetadata itm ON md.display_name = itm.display_name ORDER BY md.display_name, itm.metadata_value;

sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.status AS migration_status, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.avg_memory_mb, sq2.memory_mb_variance FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE hcm.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC;

sql: WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC ), Flare3FlareInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ) SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH migration_details AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, md.window_column, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM migration_details md JOIN root_gb_cov_by_display_name rgb ON md.display_name = rgb.display_name;

sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare') SELECT md.migration_id, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.DISPLAY_NAME AS migrated_instance_display_name, md.MEMORY_MB AS migrated_instance_memory_mb, md.metadata_key, md.metadata_value, md.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, imr.instance_uuid, imr.vm_state, imr.memory_mb AS az_instance_memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, ROUND(md.MEMORY_MB / NULLIF(imr.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS migrated_to_az_memory_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMetadataRanks imr ON md.metadata_key = imr.metadata_key AND md.metadata_value = imr.metadata_value ORDER BY migrated_to_az_memory_ratio DESC, md.migration_id, imr.instance_uuid;

sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' ), VMStateGeoMean AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT id.display_name, id.availability_zone, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.uuid, id.max_metadata_id_next_2, vmg.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM InstanceDetails id LEFT JOIN VMStateGeoMean vmg ON id.vm_state = vmg.vm_state;

sql: WITH Prime35InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Blaze812InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT p.display_name, p.memory_mb_variance AS prime35_memory_mb_variance, p.memory_mb_stddev AS prime35_memory_mb_stddev, b.avg_memory_mb AS blaze812_avg_memory_mb, b.memory_mb_variance AS blaze812_memory_mb_variance FROM Prime35InstanceMemoryStats p JOIN Blaze812InstanceMemoryStats b ON p.display_name = b.display_name ORDER BY p.memory_mb_variance DESC;

sql: WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC;
