sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", which VM states have an average instance memory greater than 16000 MB, and for each such VM state return the VM state, the average memory in MB, the number of distinct instances, and whether any of those instances have system metadata key image_image_type on host blaze8-12. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ImageTypeMetadataOnHost AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstancesInAZOnHost AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT iaoh.vm_state, AVG(iaoh.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT iaoh.instance_uuid) AS instance_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT itmo.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_ImageType_Metadata_On_Host FROM InstancesInAZOnHost iaoh LEFT JOIN ImageTypeMetadataOnHost itmo ON iaoh.display_name = itmo.display_name WHERE iaoh.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY iaoh.vm_state HAVING AVG(iaoh.memory_mb) > 16000 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC;
sub_questions: For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type and whose host is blaze8-12, list the instance display name, the metadata value, and the cached network info, and assign row numbers ordered by the metadata value using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row.

For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are running on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, the instance extra record ID, and assign row numbers within each VM state ordered by instance UUID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12';

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: List (1) instances in availability zone 'flare3' with a completed migration whose display name matches the pattern 'flare' (including the instance UUID, display name, migration status, and the running sum of MEMORY_MB within each migration type ordered by instance memory) and (2) completed migrations whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12' (including migration ID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, and the rank within the completed-status group), combined into a single result set with a reason indicating which condition each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Flare3CompletedFlareInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.instance_display_name, f.migration_status, f.window_column AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS migration_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS source_compute, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS dest_compute, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Flare3 flare* instances (completed migrations)' AS reason FROM Flare3CompletedFlareInstances f UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS CHAR(36)) AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS migration_status, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, c.migration_id, c.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, c.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, c.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Completed migrations on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost c ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_display_name, migration_id;
sub_questions: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed" and whose display name matches the pattern "flare", show the instance UUID, its display name, the migration status, and the running sum of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory.

For migrations that have status = 'completed' and whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12', show the migration ID, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the rank of each migration within its status group ordered by migration ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare';

SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and are not deleted, and restricting to those running on host "blaze8-12" with more than 8 VCPUs, provide the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH InstanceTimeVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), HostVcpuStateSummary AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT hvss.VM_STATE, hvss.DISPLAY_NAME, hvss.instance_count, hvss.min_memory_mb, itv.coefficient_of_variation FROM HostVcpuStateSummary hvss JOIN InstanceTimeVariation itv ON hvss.DISPLAY_NAME = itv.display_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, show the coefficient of variation of the time (in days) between when the instance was created and when its instance info cache record was last updated, considering only instances that are not deleted and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'.

For each instance VM state and display name, considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs that are running on host "blaze8-12", return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB) among those instances.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME;
